title: Senior Engineering Manager, Customer Observability
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX |  New York, NY | Lisbon, Portugal | London, UK</p> <h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4> <p>As the Engineering Manager for our Developer Observability Platform you will manage a high-velocity customer-obsessed team. Your mission will be to empower customers by making their telemetry discoverable and actionable in one place. </p> <p>The team is international and distributed, they move fast and are deeply attuned to customer feedback. They bring a deep range of observability experience from major companies and fast-moving startups. This is a deeply cross-functional role that will need to understand the nuances of monitoring some of our most complex and high volume primitives such as Workers, Workers for Platforms, Agents, and Durable Objects. This is a high-visibility role that will be directly interfacing with some of our biggest customers.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p>Deliver excellent customer outcomes above all else. Whatever is required - building, planning, deciding, designing, communicating - you are accountable and get it done.</p> </li> <li>Set the technical and product vision along with your PM and Engineers. Build the right thing at the right time.</li> <li> <p>Building an observability platform for the current AI driven ecosystem. Agents empower new types of platforms capabilities even as they require new types of observability.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own the operational aspects of your platform such as SLOs, incident response, customer escalations, and technical debt. Reliability is its own feature.</p> </li> <li> <p>Recruit, mentor, and grow engineers. We have a high bar and expect you to raise it.</p> </li> <li> <p>Cultivate a team culture that values fast iteration, high agency, and ownership.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work cross-functionally with a range of platform and product teams to instrument and surface meaningful data in actionable ways.</p> </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p>A minimum of 8 years of relevant industry experience, including at least 4 years managing software engineering teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven track record leading teams that have shipped and operated complex, large-scale systems and data-driven applications. Preferably in observability, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, edge/proxy systems, or high-scale APIs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Significant technical depth, with the ability to guide architectural discussions, make credible technical decisions, review designs, and unblock your team.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong developer tools taste. You have used and built enough observability products to know what makes them delightful or painful.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, and develop senior engineers, and to build high-performing, inclusive teams that ship. You care about teams and team culture.</p> </li> <li> <p>A hands-on approach to leadership: you consider yourself a builder, stay close to the code, know the numbers, know the customer, and know what to build next.</p> </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points </strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p>Working on hosted customer-facing observability products</p> </li> <li> <p>Instrumenting observability in global-scale, production environments </p> </li> <li> <p>Implementing observability (OTLP, OLAP databases such as Clickhouse, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Kibana, etc)</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building with Cloudflare’s Developer Platform and have opinions on where we could improve, especially with respect to observability.</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For NY-based hires: Estimated annual salary of $220,000 - $303,000</li> <li>For Portugal-based hires: Estimated annual salary of €89,000 - €122,000</li> </ul> <h4>Equity</h4> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h4>Benefits</h4> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. title: Social Media Content Creator (m/w/d) – Minijob
description: Über Heless Heless entwickelt und produziert seit 1949 in Schwetzingen hochwertige Spielwaren und Produkte für Kinder. Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen in der dritten Frauengeneration legen wir großen Wert auf Qualität, Innovation und pädagogischen Wert, um Familien auf der ganzen Welt zu begleiten und zu inspirieren. Unser Team in Schwetzingen arbeitet mit viel Engagement daran, Kinderaugen zum Leuchten zu bringen. Für unser Marketing suchen wir jemanden, der DIY-Ideen in kurze Videos für Instagram und TikTok umsetzt und auf LinkedIn Inhalte für Handelspartner und Branchenkontakte erstellt. Sie betreuen Ihre Beiträge vom ersten Entwurf bis zum Austausch mit der Community und setzen gemeinsam mit unserem Marketing Kooperationen um. Ihre Aufgaben Sie entwickeln DIY-Formate für Instagram und TikTok, etwa kurze Anleitungen und Reels. Sie probieren Ihre Ideen selbst aus, filmen und fotografieren die wichtigsten Schritte und erstellen daraus Beiträge, die Lust aufs Nachmachen machen. Sie erstellen B2B-Content für LinkedIn, etwa zu Messeauftritten, Händleraktionen oder Einblicken in unsere Arbeit. Dafür schreiben Sie Texte und erstellen passende Fotos, Grafiken oder kurze Videos. Sie recherchieren passende Kooperationspartner, sprechen sie in Abstimmung mit unserem Marketing an und begleiten gemeinsame Aktionen wie Gewinnspiele von der Planung bis zur Auswertung. Sie betreuen Kommentare, Direktnachrichten und eingehende Anfragen über unsere Social-Media-Kanäle. Sie beantworten Fragen von Kunden, Interessenten und Kooperationspartnern und leiten Anliegen bei Bedarf an die zuständige Stelle weiter. Sie stimmen Beiträge mit unserem Marketing ab, veröffentlichen sie nach Redaktionsplan und werten aus, welche Inhalte auf den jeweiligen Kanälen gut ankommen. Ihr Profil Sie haben bereits selbst Social-Media-Inhalte erstellt und können eigene Beispiele zeigen. Sie haben Freude an DIY-Projekten und ein Gespür dafür, wie Sie einzelne Schritte einfach und anschaulich zeigen. Sie filmen und fotografieren sicher mit dem Smartphone und schneiden kurze Videos eigenständig, etwa mit CapCut. Mit Canva oder einem vergleichbaren Tool können Sie einfache Grafiken erstellen. Sie schreiben stilsicher auf Deutsch und finden sowohl für einen Instagram-Beitrag als auch für eine Händleranfrage den passenden Ton. Sie arbeiten selbstständig und zuverlässig und behalten bei laufenden Aktionen und offenen Anfragen den Überblick. Erfahrung mit LinkedIn, B2B-Kommunikation oder Social-Media-Kooperationen ist willkommen. Das erwartet Sie Raum für eigene Ideen und die Möglichkeit, verschiedene Content-Formate auszuprobieren. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Marketing. Ein Minijob in Schwetzingen. Drehtermine und Arbeitszeiten stimmen wir gemeinsam ab. Interesse? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung über JOIN. Schicken Sie uns gerne zwei bis drei Beispiele für Inhalte, die Sie selbst erstellt haben , etwa ein kurzes Video und eine Textprobe für Social Media. Beiträge aus privaten Projekten sind willkommen. Teilen Sie uns bitte auch Ihren möglichen Starttermin mit. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Commercial Account Executive (Austin, TX or Raleigh, NC)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX or Raleigh, NC</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Department</strong></h3> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <p><strong>About this Role</strong></p> <p>AEs are positioned to drive in-depth product discussions while communicating and demonstrating value quickly to customers.  This role within this segment focuses on both the acquisition of prospective Commercial accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts.  The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.  </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop, execute, and maintain your territory plan to exceed quarterly sales targets and annual quota assignment.</li> <li>Be an expert in three unique sales motions; new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory.</li> <li>Build a robust sales pipeline utilizing the four sourcing funnels: AE led outbound, BDR, Channel, and Marketing Inbound.</li> <li>Develop and strategically leverage a deep technical understanding of the problems Cloudflare solves in order to drive a consultative sales motion.</li> <li>Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. description: Jobbeschreibung Tausende Männer haben bei Lovebetter Hilfe bei Erektionsproblemen oder vorzeitigem Samenerguss gesucht und mit unserem Online-Programm und unseren Coachings an sich gearbeitet. Du hinterfragst, was heute läuft, machst es mit den Heads besser und siehst an den Zahlen, ob es wirkt. Vision übersetzen: Du trägst Vision und Mission ins Team, leitest Business-Initiativen ab und weißt, welche operativen Hebel du aktivieren musst, um die Unternehmensziele voranzutreiben. Hinterfragen und verbessern: Du prüfst bestehende Prozesse, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale, entwickelst Konzepte und Umsetzungspläne. Zahlen & Finance: Du analysierst Daten sicher, bist stark in Excel und liest P&L, Cashflow und Forecasts so, dass du daraus Entscheidungen ableitest. Eine CFO-Laufbahn brauchst du dafür nicht. title: Head of Customer Experience & Trust
description: <p><em><strong>This role can be based in our Rotterdam HQ or in our Cergy office.</strong></em></p> <p>We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.</p> <p>With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.</p> <p>We're looking for a<strong> Head of Customer Experience & Trust </strong>to be the guardian of the tenant experience on our unified platform. As we consolidate the HousingAnywhere and Studapart operations teams, you will lead a multi-site support and trust organisation across Rotterdam and Cergy and own not just how we respond to our users, but the content, policies, and safeguards that shape their experience before they ever contact us.</p> <h2>Your role and impact</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead the shift to AI-first support:</strong> Make our AI agent the first point of resolution for tenants and landlords, across all channels. Report on automated resolution, quality and CSAT as seriously as on human SLAs, and prioritise support needs in the Ops automation roadmap.</li> <li><strong>Set the direction for our AI agent:</strong> Decide what the AI agent should resolve, what it must never do, and when it hands over to a human. Set its resolution and quality targets, and approve how our policies are explained. Work with the Ops Project Manager, who owns the knowledge base and runs the AI agent day to day.</li> <li><strong>Redesign the team around AI:</strong> Lead the CS Team Managers in Cergy and Rotterdam and, through them, a team of experts with local market knowledge. Evolve roles so agents spend their time on complex, sensitive and high-value cases, and on training and supervising the AI. Build one standard way of working across both sites.</li> <li><strong>Own the rules:</strong> Own T&Cs and service policies with Legal, and approve how they are explained to users. The Ops Project Manager turns them into help content for users, our AI agent and our teams. </li> <li><strong>Get ready for high season:</strong> Build data-based capacity plans that factor in automation rates, and prepare each peak well ahead: staffing, AI agent coverage, and processes. Select, onboard and manage BPO partners to absorb peak volumes, with clear quality standards, SLAs and costs. Work with the Quality & Training Manager to train BPO agents and monitor their quality, and with the Ops Project Manager to give them the knowledge base and tools they need.</li> <li><strong>Raise the quality bar:</strong> Use the Voice of Customer insights and AI-assisted quality reviews led by the Quality & Training Manager to drive change in your teams and raise quality of service and all departments.</li> <li><strong>Own Trust & Safety, AI-assisted:</strong> Steer the content integrity and T&S vertical through the dedicated Team Lead in Rotterdam, who manages both sites. This covers listing moderation, fraud prevention and dispute handling. Use AI-based detection and moderation so we always display real content from real users, with human judgement on the final call.</li> <li><strong>Own the cancellation flows:</strong> All cancellation assessment and resolution flows sit with you, including post-cancellation retention and relocation. Automate what’s simple and keep a human touch where tenants need it most.</li> <li><strong>Protect our reputation:</strong> Protects the platform’s reputation on Trustpilot and Google, and acts on Voice of Customer insights from the Quality & Training Manager.</li> </ul> <h2>Your profile</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Professional experience:</strong> 5+ years in customer operations, with 2+ years leading multi-team or multi-site support organisations, ideally in a marketplace, travel or high-volume consumer platform.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on AI deployment:</strong> You have deployed an AI support agent in production, not just piloted one. You can show how you improved its resolution rate and quality over time.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge and content ownership:</strong> You have shaped T&Cs, help content or service policies with Legal and Product. You write rules that both people and AI can follow.</li> <li><strong>Trust & safety literacy :</strong> You have owned or worked hands-on with moderation, fraud prevention and dispute resolution, and can balance protection with conversion.</li> <li><strong>Data-driven:</strong> You run on SLAs, CSAT, automation and cancellation metrics. You know how to hold quality through seasonal peaks.</li> <li><strong>Peak and partner management:</strong> You have prepared support teams for seasonal peaks, and have selected and managed BPO partners, holding them to the same quality standard as your own team.</li> <li><strong>Change leadership:</strong> You lead through team leads and have taken a team through a change in roles driven by automation, keeping people engaged along the way.</li> <li><strong>Responsible AI:</strong> You know where AI should stop and a human should take over. You are familiar with GDPR and EU AI Act transparency requirements for customer-facing AI.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluent English required; French a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h2>What's in it for you</h2> <ul> <li>Position based in our Cergy office (hybrid working policy), with visits to HQ in Rotterdam.</li> <li>Executive status with 218 workdays/year (with RTT days off).</li> <li>50% transport costs covered.</li> <li>70% health insurance coverage.</li> <li>Meal vouchers.</li> <li>Contribution to fitness membership costs.</li> <li>Christmas gift vouchers.</li> <li>Team-building events and much more!</li> </ul> <p>Read more about our France-based teams <a href="https://www.welcometothejungle.com/en/companies/studapart">here</a>.</p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: [Paris] Applied AI Architect, Industries
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic, you will be a pre-sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.</p> <p>Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack</p> </li> <li> <p>Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building</p> </li> <li> <p>Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns</p> </li> </ul> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you have:</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p>5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager</p> </li> <li> <p>Native or fluent French speaker (C1 or above)</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience working with enterprise customers, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders</p> </li> <li> <p>Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfortable with python</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science</p> </li> <li> <p>A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. <br><br></p> <p><strong>À propos du poste</strong></p> <p>Au sein de l’équipe Applied AI d’Anthropic, vous intervenez comme architecte avant-vente, avec un objectif : devenir le conseil technique de confiance des grandes entreprises. systèmes d’IA.</p> <p>Vos responsabilités</p> <ul> <li>Travailler avec les account executives pour comprendre en profondeur les besoins des clients et les traduire en solutions techniques, en alignant objectifs métier et mise en œuvre</li> <li>Être le conseil technique principal des grands comptes tout au long de leur adoption de Claude, du cadrage à l’évaluation initiale puis au déploiement, en coordonnant en interne les différentes équipes et parties prenantes pour assurer leur réussite</li> <li>Accompagner les clients qui développent aussi bien avec l’API Claude qu’avec Claude for Work</li> <li>Créer et présenter des contenus techniques, adaptés à chaque public : aussi à l’aise dans une session technique approfondie avec des équipes d’ingénierie que dans une discussion sur la valeur métier avec des dirigeants</li> <li>Orienter les choix d’architecture et aider les clients à intégrer efficacement Claude dans leur environnement technologique existant</li> <li>Aider les clients à mettre en place des cadres d’évaluation pour mesurer la performance de Claude sur leurs cas d’usage</li> <li>Identifier les schémas d’intégration récurrents et faire remonter ces enseignements à nos équipes Produit et Engineering</li> <li>Vous déplacer ponctuellement chez les clients pour des ateliers, des sessions techniques et pour développer la relation</li> <li>Vous tenir à jour des dernières évolutions des LLM, de leurs capacités et de leurs modes de mise en œuvre</li> </ul> <p>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous avez</p> <ul> <li>Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans des des interlocuteurs techniques et métier</li> <li>L’expérience de la conception d’architectures cloud évolutives et de l’intégration aux systèmes d’entreprise</li> <li>De l’aisance avec Python</li> Les candidatures sont étudiées au fil de l’eau.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. </p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€190.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€220.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study: </strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. description: <p><strong>About the team:</strong></p> <p>The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success.</p> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter.</p> <p>We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. In this role, you’ll drive high-quality decision-making to maximise impact. </p> <p>We’re hiring multiple Senior Data Scientists across different areas of the business. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope, remit and team.</p> <p><strong>About Our Data Science Organisation</strong></p> <p>We have an outstanding Data Science organisation, with a mission to drive the highest quality decision-making across our marketplace. We work throughout the company, in product, operations, and platform teams and are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Wolt. We are great communicators, and move fast to serve our customers a little better every day.</p> <p>Our community is highly active, and Data Scientists can progress equally as IC leads or managers. </p> <p>Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science; many are not. </p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the front lines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.</p> <p><strong>Our humble expectations</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science position.</li> <li>Expertise in statistical analysis, including hypothesis testing and experimentation (A/B testing and causal inference) using statistical software packages in Python, R, or equivalent for product development.</li> <li>Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets.</li> <li>Prior experience building intuitive data visualizations and dashboards that influence business decisions, utilizing tools like Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, or similar.</li> <li>Clear and concise communication with strong cross-functional partnership experience.</li> <li>Relentless pursuit of new ideas and data sources, and the ability to systematically tackle ambiguous problems with a data-driven, hypothesis-based approach.</li> <li>Ability to work and communicate effectively in English.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <ul> <li>The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.</li> <li>You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, Helsinki or Stockholm. title: Hardware Engineering Graduate - Robotics & Automation 2027
description: <p>Looking to kickstart your career and make a global impact? Join Ocado Group’s Graduate Programme and become a driving force in the future of technology.</p> <h3><strong>Programme Overview</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Start Date: Early September 2027 </li> <li>Duration: 2 years (Fixed-term, full-time)</li> <li>Location: Hatfield, Welwyn Garden City, and our cutting edge Customer Fulfilment Centres (CFCs) </li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>Ocado Group delivers innovative technology solutions powered by the latest advancements in automation, robotics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence, catering to the online grocery and non-grocery distribution sectors. With over 20 years of experience in the online grocery industry and a portfolio of patented technologies, we strive to transform the economics and service standards of grocery ecommerce on a global scale A workplace culture that celebrates diversity, collaboration, and creativity.</p> <p>Discover more about Ocado Group’s story<a href="https://www.ocadogroup.com/"> here</a>. </p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>Over four 6-month rotations, you’ll help develop, deliver, and support Ocado Group’s automated engineering systems. Working alongside experienced engineers, you’ll tackle real-world challenges across specialisms ranging from electrical and verification engineering to data analysis and live robotics.</p> <p>This isn’t just an office-based role. You’ll get hands-on experience in our automated Customer Fulfilment Centres (CFCs) working on construction, commissioning, and live operations with potential opportunities to travel to global manufacturers and client sites.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Gain</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Varied Experience</strong>: Four tailored placements designed to help you discover your strengths and build a strong engineering foundation.</li> <li><strong>Structured Growth:</strong> Personalised development plans, targeted training modules, and leadership opportunities to accelerate your career.</li> <li><strong>Wider Impact:</strong> Chances to collaborate across our graduate network, volunteer, and get involved in wider business initiatives.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About You</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Hold an accredited Engineering degree aligned with UK Engineering Council standards (or Washington Accord international equivalent)</li> <li>A valid UK driving licence is <em>desirable</em></li> <li>Self-starter and problem-solver </li> <li>A creator, thinker, and doer ready to make an impact</li> </ul> <p><em>Note: This role does not qualify for Skilled Worker Sponsorship and requires full right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme.</em></p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What We Offer</strong></h3> <p>We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. title: Analytics Engineer
description: <p><strong>Analytics Engineer | Tech Ops | Hybrid Working | Hatfield</strong></p> <p><strong>Introduction:</strong></p> <p>We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.</p> <p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p> <p>As an Analytics Engineer for Tech Ops and OMRS, you will bridge the gap between data producers and data consumers, transforming complex data from our robotics and automated systems into trusted, certified data foundations. Focusing on bot, grid, and maintenance telemetry, you will design reporting layers in dbt and implement standardized definitions in the semantic layer to ensure metrics remain consistent across all dashboards, analysts, and AI tools.</p> <p>In this role, you will act as the key liaison between Data Engineering and business analysts, establishing robust data models and governing metric changes. You will play a pivotal role in enabling self-service analytics, triaging domain requests, and using modern AI-assisted engineering tools to build reliable, high-performing data pipelines that support our global operations.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain layered dbt models in BigQuery, balancing query performance with long-term maintainability.</li> <li>Implement and govern standardized business metrics within the dbt semantic layer (MetricFlow).</li> <li>Migrate existing metric logic into the semantic layer while resolving data duplication.</li> <li>Elevate analyst workflows into certified, production-ready reporting marts with full documentation and lineage.</li> <li>Implement automated data quality testing and monitoring, escalating issues to upstream data producers.</li> <li>Serve as the primary point of contact to triage and scope data requests across Tech Ops and OMRS.</li> <li>Translate operational processes into clear data requirements in collaboration with subject matter experts.</li> <li>Enable and coach analysts on dbt best practices, conducting merge request reviews.</li> <li>Maintain metadata to ensure compatibility with AI tools and automated analytics plugins.</li> <li>Utilize AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude Code) to accelerate data modelling and migration.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For:</strong></p> <p><em>Essential</em></p> <ul> <li>Strong hands-on experience with SQL (BigQuery preferred) and dbt, including models, macros, testing, and documentation.</li> <li>Proven background in dimensional data modelling (Kimball or Inmon methodologies) and Git version control workflows.</li> <li>Solid understanding of BI platforms (such as Looker) to align reports with semantic layers.</li> <li>Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into precise technical data structures.</li> <li>Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Degree in a numerate discipline or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p><em>Nice to Haves</em></p> <ul> <li>Experience working with metric/semantic layers (MetricFlow, LookML) or data quality tools (e.g., Validio).</li> <li>Proficiency with Python, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or data modelling tools such as SQLdbm.</li> <li>Familiarity with using AI development tools to write, optimize, or review analytics code.</li> <li>Prior exposure to telemetry, robotics, warehouse automation, or maintenance data.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:</p> <ul> <li>Time to recharge:<br>25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.</li> <li>Health & wellbeing:<br>Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.</li> <li>Family-first policies:<br>22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave</li> <li>Financial support:<br>Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.</li> <li>Commuter perks:<br>Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.</li> <li>Exclusive discounts:<br>15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).</li> </ul> <p>Be bold, be unique, be brilliant, be you. We are looking for individuality and we value diversity. We are an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to treating all applicants and employees fairly and equally. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment process and supportive work environment. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application.</p> <p>#LI-HYBRID</p> <p>#LI-JT1</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt.</p> <p>You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others.</p> <p>You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.</p> <p><strong>This is a step-up opportunity.</strong> We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.</p> <p><strong>Key tasks and accountabilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Build and ship</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build and run AI-powered products, tools and services from prototype to production</li> <li>Own outcomes end to end: problem framing, architecture, implementation, evaluation, release and operation</li> <li>Run fast, time-boxed experiments; scale what works and stop what doesn't, with the evidence to back either call</li> <li>Set up and evolve the AI infrastructure these builds rely on: model access, evaluation tooling, observability and guardrails</li> </ul> <p><strong>Shape direction</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with the VP Technology to set Awin's engineering-specific AI direction, grounded in what has actually been built and measured</li> <li>Scope strategic opportunities early with product and commercial leaders, with effort, cost and value made explicit</li> <li>Make clear recommendations on build vs buy, model and vendor choice, and where AI should not be used</li> </ul> <p><strong>Architecture and design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design new capability so it connects safely to the existing platform: APIs, events, data and identity</li> <li>Select tools and technologies, and define the patterns and practices for AI-native development at Awin</li> <li>Weigh long-term maintainability, economic viability and reuse against speed, and document the trade-offs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Spread what works</strong></p> <ul> <li>Turn proven builds into reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, and share them so other teams can adopt them without hand-holding</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ways of working</strong></p> <ul> <li>Works autonomously, guided by the VP Technology's priorities rather than team-level delivery processes</li> <li>Engages directly with engineering, product, data, security and commercial stakeholders as each build requires</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Expertise</strong></p> <p><strong>AI-native engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Builds with coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as the default way of working. Can show how they decompose work, manage context and review agent output to get production-quality code at pace</li> <li>Has shipped LLM-powered features to production: prompt and context engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval (RAG) and multi-step agent workflows</li> <li>Builds evaluations first: test sets, automated evals and regression checks for non-deterministic behaviour, with quality measured before and after release</li> <li>Connects models to enterprise systems and data safely, e.g. MCP servers, internal APIs and event streams, with clear permissions and audit trails</li> <li>Understands model selection, token economics, latency, caching and fallback strategies, and can explain cost and benefit trade-offs to commercial stakeholders</li> <li>Designs for AI-specific security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling under GDPR, and guardrails on what models can do</li> </ul> <p><strong>Engineering foundations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating</li> <li>Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)</li> <li>Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores</li> <li>Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry</li> <li>Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ways of building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop</li> <li>Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft skills</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Bias to action:</strong> ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements</li> <li><strong>Comfortable with ambiguity:</strong> frames vague opportunities into concrete, testable bets</li> <li><strong>Commercially minded:</strong> connects technical choices to revenue, cost and customer outcomes, and balances effort against value</li> <li><strong>Intellectually honest:</strong> kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer</li> <li><strong>Clear communicator:</strong> explains technical trade-offs to executives, engineers and commercial teams in language each understands, in writing and in person</li> <li><strong>Influences without authority:</strong> gets teams to adopt new patterns because they work, not because they're mandated</li> </ul> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Our Offer</strong></div> <ul class="RichTextList-bulleted"> <li> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Flexi-Week</strong>: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.</div> </li> <li> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Flexi-office</strong>: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.</div> </li> <li> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture</strong>: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.</div> </li> <li> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Health and Wellbeing</strong>: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.</div> </li> <li> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Development</strong>: We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.</div> </li> <li> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Appreciation</strong>: Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.</div> </li> </ul> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><em>We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview.</em></div> <p>Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.</p> <p>Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.</p> <p>Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.</p> <p><span class="TextRun Highlight SCXW248400944 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8">Awin is part of the Axel Springer group.</span></span> <span class="TextRun Highlight SCXW248400944 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8">Learn more at </span></span><a class="Hyperlink SCXW248400944 BCX8" href="https://www.axelspringer.com/en/" target="_blank"><span class="TextRun Highlight Underlined SCXW248400944 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8" data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">axelspringer.com/</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8" data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">en</span><span class="NormalTextRun SC

title: Data Protection and Compliance Consultant (m/f/d)
description: <div class="ng-tns-c879422873-771"> <section id="processing-state-26" class="processing-state_container ng-tns-c879422873-771 is-gpi-avatar is-done-processing ng-trigger ng-trigger-processingStateShowHide ng-star-inserted"> <div id="processing-state-26-summary" class="processing-state_details ng-trigger ng-trigger-menuExpansion ng-tns-c879422873-771 is-gpi-avatar ng-star-inserted"> <h2>About Commercetools</h2> </div> </section> </div> <div class="response-content ng-tns-c263290053-769"> <div class="container"> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_bfb50fc8f1f4512c" class="markdown markdown-main-panel stronger enable-updated-hr-color"> <p data-path-to-node="1">Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people. Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers. The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today. At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits. Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.</p> <h2 data-path-to-node="2">Your Impact</h2> <p class="first-token" data-path-to-node="0"><span class="">Hello!</span> I'm <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/emil-pfrang-b8b00a65/">Emil Pfrang</a>,<span class=""> <strong>Director Information Security</strong> at commercetools. Trust is the foundation of modern cloud commerce. My team operates right at the intersection of global privacy law, cloud architecture, and AI innovation—ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains compliant, resilient, and trusted by the world’s most ambitious enterprises. Rather than treating compliance as a static checkbox exercise, we partner closely with product, engineering, and external clients to navigate evolving global regulations and safely bring new AI capabilities to market</span></p> <p>As a <strong>Data Protection and Compliance Consultant</strong>, you will play a critical role in maintaining and elevating commercetools’ global data privacy and compliance framework. Operating at the intersection of legal requirements, cloud technology, and software engineering, you will advise internal teams, work closely with external clients, and ensure our multi-tenant SaaS platform adheres to international data privacy laws (such as GDPR, and relevant global privacy regulations).</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <p><strong>Data protection and privacy advice</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) on global data protection laws (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA where applicable, UK GDPR, etc.) for internal product, engineering, and business teams</li> <li>Advise departments on privacy and data protection topics</li> <li>Work with department heads and process owners to collect all required information about each processing activity</li> <li>Check and assess vendors and assets for data protection and privacy as part of the supplier assessments</li> <li>Monitor and handle the privacy related requests from employees, customers, and authorities, e.g. requests for information, requests for deletion, etc.</li> <li>Prepare and review Data Transfer Impact Assessments </li> <li>Check and assess AI tools and features from a privacy perspective</li> <li>Review customer Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) </li> <li>Support assessments of AI tools and AI features from a privacy perspective</li> </ul> <p><strong>Audits, strategic compliance and maintenance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor global legal developments, court rulings, and regulatory guidance to update commercetools’ internal policies continuously</li> <li>Maintenance of process documentation within data protection</li> <li>Design and manage data protection training together with our external DPO</li> <li>Draft, review, and maintain key privacy documentation, including Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), Privacy Policies, and Privacy Notices</li> <li>Maintain the Record of Processing Activities (RoPA)</li> <li>Support audits from privacy and data protection perspective  </li> <li>Provide data protection evidence for internal and external audits</li> <li>Execute internal compliance audits: Support departments on identifying compliance needs</li> <li>Support compliance policy management</li> <li>Maintenance of whistleblower platform </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What Sets You Apart</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="8">You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork. Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.</p> <p data-path-to-node="9"> <strong data-path-to-node="9" data-index-in-node="0">You bring:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="10"> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Fluent English and German</strong></li> <li>Degree in law, business informatics or a related field, or equivalent experience</li> <li>2+ years of experience in data protection or privacy compliance, ideally at a SaaS or tech company</li> <li>Solid knowledge of the GDPR (Art. 13–21, 28, 30, 35, 44 ff.). Knowledge of the EU AI Act, CCPA or HIPAA is a plus</li> <li>Experience with privacy management tools, ideally OneTrust</li> <li>Understanding of ISMS frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2)</li> <li>Structured, detail-oriented way of working with a strong focus on documentation</li> <li>Professional certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT (IAPP), or CISA are a strong advantage</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="10,13,0"><strong data-path-to-node="11" data-index-in-node="0">AI Aptitude:</strong> A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.</p> <p data-path-to-node="13"><strong>Our Benefits</strong></p> </div> </div> </div> <p>Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.</p> <p>🩺 <strong>Comprehensive health benefits</strong> for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support</p> <p>📚 <strong>Learning and development </strong>opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs</p> <p>🍼 <strong>Family Leave Plus</strong> gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition</p> <p>📈 <strong>Our equity participation program</strong> allows you to share in our success </p> <p>For more information on our benefits, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/our-benefits">visit this page.</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Come as you are. Build with us.</strong></p> <p>Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.</p> <p>We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community. </p> <p>For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/dei-esg">visit this page</a>. </p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. <p><strong>Engineering foundations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating</li> <li>Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)</li> <li>Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores</li> <li>Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry</li> <li>Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ways of building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop</li> <li>Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft title: Product Designer - Paris
description: As a Product Designer, you'll work on the H Platform, where our users create and run agentic AI workflows powered by our models. Nobody has written the playbook for designing these experiences yet. Our next stage is making the platform truly useful for its users and levelling it up, in design as much as in technology, and you'll build the product experiences that deliver real value in organisations. At H Company, we believe AI should take action in the real world, and our mission is to make agentic AI genuinely useful for large organisations. We're pioneers in computer use: our own vision-language models power agents that see, click and type their way through the software businesses already run, with no integrations or rebuilds, and we own the whole stack, from research and models to the products built on top of them. Turning those insights into research and explorations, looking at problems from different angles before settling on a direction. Picking the right tool for each task: a Figma design, a prototype, or a small PR when a quick change is the fastest way to ship. Testing what you build with users, measuring its impact (A/B testing, user interviews, users daily use data...) and iterating quickly based on what you learn. Shaping the roadmap together with the whole team, engineers and PMs alike. Who you'll work with The role sits in our Product team, which is responsible for product direction, strategy and design. You'll join the product designer who owns design and UX today, and work closely with product, engineering and forward deployed engineers. What we think it takes Above all, we want someone who cares deeply about users, has great product taste and can explain it, moves fast while keeping quality high, leaves their ego at the door and welcomes feedback. Likely a good fit if you Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer at tech companies. Have excellent UX, UI and interaction design skills, and can make complex, technical flows, like building and running AI agent workflows, feel simple and intuitive. Have a portfolio that shows your latest work. Have hands-on experience running user tests and A/B tests. Know when a proven solution is good enough and when a problem deserves something new. Have designed complex data or ML/AI-driven products: you know how to make complex systems understandable and how to design for AI behaviour that isn't always predictable, building trust and keeping users in control. Are comfortable in technical discussions: you can dig into constraints and trade-offs with engineers and ramp up quickly on technical topics to discuss them with our researchers and more technical engineers. Are fluent in Figma. Can work within a design system and contribute to it. Stronger still if you Have designed platforms: complex B2B web or desktop software used by professionals, whether that's tools to build and run workflows, big data and analytics software, operational dashboards or other data-dense interfaces. Are curious about code and AI in your design workflow. Every design team is still figuring out how AI changes the way we work, and we're no different, so we'd love someone who has started experimenting, whether by prototyping in code, building small tools or bringing AI into their process, and who wants to keep exploring with us. If you match most of this but not every point, apply anyway. We care far more about how you think, your curiosity and your care for users than a perfect match. How we hire Four stages: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute portfolio review, a 60-minute design interview in person at our Paris office, and a closing 30-minute conversation. The portfolio review and design interview are built around your own work and how you design. Please apply with your CV and a link to your portfolio showing your latest work. title: Senior Product Marketing Manager - Customer Growth
description: In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone. In eight years time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over two million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year. About the Opportunity We are hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own growth and go to market strategy for our retail product, growing usage through cross-sell, upsell and adoption of new features. This is about the platform's first impression, from the moment someone hears about Bitvavo to the moment they place their first trade. You understand the consumer lifecycle end to end, and excel at acquisition campaigns that grow market share. This role calls for someone who has spent real product marketing time in trading, fintech or crypto. You stay obsessed with the user and what someone actually does in the moment before they hit confirm. What You'll be Doing Define & Lead new market entry strategy and aggressive growth strategies in our existing markets. Prioritising by customer and business impact and setting the scope and channels to most effectively reach your goals Experiment with new creative tactics to drive acquisition, onboarding, activation or top-of-funnel conversion by partnering with CRM, Product, Marketing, Partner Management and Brand on growth and win back campaigns Plan, build and ship multi channel campaigns end to end, staying hands on through every stage of production Track the competitive landscape for new customers: neobanks entering crypto and competitors' onboarding flows, and shape our positioning for people opening their first account Connect Product and Marketing on everything acquisition-related. Brief creatives, and align Legal, CRM, Brand, Performance, Affiliates and Social around one consistent first-touch story What We're Looking For 5+ years of hands-on experience in growth marketing, acquisition-focused product marketing or product management within trading, investing or consumer fintech, with a track record of moving prospects into activated, retained customers in a regulated product. title: Growth Manager / Senior Growth Manager (m/w/d)
description: Portfolio, Wachstums-Roadmap und Go-to-Market für Cloud-, Daten-, KI- und SaaS-Lösungen – du machst Marketing und Vertrieb im deutschsprachigen Mittelstand noch erfolgreicher. Über Coduct Group Die Coduct-Gruppe verbindet Technologieberatung, Umsetzung und eigene Produkte unter einem Dach. Seit 2017 begleiten wir Unternehmen bei der Modernisierung ihrer IT-Systeme, Plattformen und Cloud-Architekturen – von der Analyse über Entwicklung und Migration bis zum Betrieb. Die Marke Coduct (Kamp-Lintfort, Berlin, Ho-Chi-Minh-City): IT-Beratung und Softwareentwicklung für Cloud, Daten, KI und Automatisierung; auch als Build-Operate-Transfer-Modell (BOT) Die Marke ainavio : unsere SaaS-Plattform für Produktinformationsmanagement (PIM) Die Marke Code Leap : unsere Software-Engineering-Marke Als Microsoft CSP-Partner und dreifach zertifizierter Microsoft Solutions Partner (Data & AI, Digital & App Innovation, Infrastructure/Azure) kombinieren wir Lizenzierung, Beratung und Umsetzung aus einer Hand. Zu unseren Kunden gehören Energieversorger, ERP- und Softwareanbieter, Handel und E-Commerce sowie Industrieunternehmen – darunter JTL, Netze BW, Schleupen und Galeria. Warum wir diese Rolle jetzt besetzen Wir stehen an der Schwelle zur nächsten Wachstumsphase. Dafür haben wir die Unternehmensfunktion Growth geschaffen, geführt von unserem VP Growth. Growth plant das Wachstum der Gruppe und sorgt dafür, dass es gelingt: Wir entwickeln Portfolio und Wachstums-Roadmap und befähigen Marketing und Vertrieb, Wachstum zu realisieren. Wichtig: Growth ist kein zweiter Vertrieb – aber Growth jagt. Nach dem Hunting-Prinzip spürst du Wachstumschancen aktiv auf und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss. Kundenbeziehungen liegen beim Vertrieb; du sorgst dafür, dass er die richtigen Angebote, Argumente und Werkzeuge hat – und dass aus ersten Aufträgen langfristige Kundenbeziehungen werden. Deine Aufgaben 1. Wachstumsstrategie & Growth-Roadmap Du entwickelst mit dem VP Growth eine mehrjährige Growth-Roadmap mit klaren Etappen, Prioritäten und Meilensteinen Du jagst aktiv Wachstumschancen – neue Segmente, Partnerschaften (u. a. Microsoft), Großchancen bei Neu- und Bestandskunden – und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss Du bewertest Zielsegmente und validierst neue Geschäftsfelder schnell und pragmatisch Du übersetzt die Roadmap in konkrete Initiativen, Business Cases und gemeinsame Ziele mit Marketing, Vertrieb und Delivery 2. Portfolio-Entwicklung (Kern der Rolle) Du gestaltest unsere Portfolio-Architektur mit einer ausgewogenen Balance aus Volumen- bzw. Standardangeboten (z. B. CSP, Managed Services, SaaS, Festpreis-Pakete) und Premium- bzw. Individualleistungen (z. B. Beratung, Custom Development, BOT, End-to-End-Transformation) Du produktisierst wiederkehrende Projektmuster zu skalierbaren Angeboten – und schärfst gleichzeitig die Differenzierung unserer Premiumleistungen Du verantwortest Positionierung (Problem – Lösung – Nutzen), Pricing-Logik und Lifecycle der Angebote, gemeinsam mit Delivery und Technologie 3. Land-and-Expand-Modell Du entwickelst Einstiegsangebote, mit denen neue Kunden einfach starten können (Land), und klare Ausbaupfade hin zu Folgeprojekten, Managed Services, Lizenzen und SaaS (Expand) Du baust Programme für die Entwicklung unserer Bestandskunden auf – z. B. vom reinen Lizenzbezug zu Cloud-, Daten- und KI-Services – und gibst dem Vertrieb dafür Anlässe, Zielkundenlisten und Werkzeuge an die Hand 4. Enablement von Marketing & Vertrieb Du befähigst den Vertrieb mit Playbooks, Pitch- und Angebotsvorlagen, Argumentationshilfen, Pricing-Rechnern und Schulungen Du entwickelst mit Marketing Zielgruppen, Ideal Customer Profiles, Messaging und Kampagnen und sorgst für eine konsistente Story: Was machen wir, für wen, und warum Coduct? Du unterstützt bei strategisch wichtigen Angeboten mit Angebotsstruktur und Pricing – die Kundenverantwortung bleibt beim Vertrieb 5. Growth-Prozesse & Steuerung Du gestaltest das Growth Operating Model: Prozesse und Übergaben von Marketing über Vertrieb bis Delivery, klare Rollen und CRM-Standards Du baust ein KPI-System auf – von Pipeline und Conversion über Expansion-Umsatz und Net Revenue Retention bis zum Anteil standardisierter und wiederkehrender Umsätze und zum Margen-Mix Du steuerst Initiativen datenbasiert und machst Learnings teamübergreifend nutzbar Woran wir deinen Erfolg messen Umsatzbeitrag neuer und überarbeiteter Angebote Expansion bei Bestandskunden (z. B. Cross-Sell-Quote, Net Revenue Retention) Ausgewogener Portfolio-Mix: Anteil standardisierter/wiederkehrender Umsätze bei gesunder Marge im Premiumgeschäft Wirksamkeit des Enablements: Nutzung durch den Vertrieb, Conversion und Time-to-Sale neuer Angebote Umsetzung der Growth-Roadmap nach Plan Diese Ziele bilden – zusammen mit der Wirkung auf Umsatz und EBIT der Gruppe – die Grundlage deiner variablen Vergütung. Was du mitbringst Erfahrung & Know-how Mindestens 5 Jahre im B2B-Umfeld in Portfolio- oder Produktmanagement, Growth, Strategie, Go-to-Market oder Business Development – idealerweise in IT-Services, Cloud, Software oder Beratung Portfolio-Management: Du hast Angebote entwickelt, produktisiert, bepreist und erfolgreich in den Markt gebracht Land and Expand: Du hast Einstiegsangebote und Ausbaupfade gestaltet und kennst die Hebel für Wachstum im Bestand Balance von Volumen und Premium: Du verstehst, wie sich Standard- und Individualgeschäft in Preis, Marge, Delivery und Vertrieb unterscheiden – und wie beide sich verstärken Strategische Kompetenz: Du entwickelst Roadmaps, setzt Prioritäten und übersetzt Strategie in messbare Ergebnisse Vertriebserfahrung: Du kennst Vertrieb aus eigener Praxis (z. B. Vertrieb, Pre-Sales, Key Account) und weißt, was Vertriebsteams wirklich hilft Mittelstand, DACH, SaaS und CSP: Du kennst Bedürfnisse und Entscheidungswege mittelständischer Unternehmen, den DACH-Markt sowie SaaS- und Microsoft-CSP-Geschäftsmodelle Prozessmanagement & Vertriebscontrolling: Du gestaltest Prozesse über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg, arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Systemen und KPIs Sprachen: Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und fließendes Englisch Persönlichkeit & Arbeitsweise Hunter-Mentalität: Du jagst neue Wachstumschancen – Segmente, Partnerschaften, Großchancen – und bringst sie mit Marketing und Vertrieb zum Abschluss Ergebnisorientierung: Du willst dich an messbaren Zielen und an deiner Wirkung auf Umsatz und EBIT messen lassen – auch in der Vergütung Macher:in: Du handelst proaktiv, mit Bias for Action, und lieferst Ergebnisse statt Konzepte für die Schublade Einfluss ohne Weisungsbefugnis: Du überzeugst Vertrieb, Marketing, Delivery und Geschäftsführung – mit Klarheit, Daten und guten Argumenten Teamplayer in verteilten Teams: Du machst andere erfolgreich, teilst Wissen offen und arbeitest gern remote, asynchron und mit unseren Kolleg:innen in Vietnam Ambition zu wachsen: Du willst in den nächsten Jahren mehr strategische und Führungsverantwortung übernehmen Wünschenswert Erfahrung im Microsoft-Partner-Ökosystem (Co-Selling, Partnerprogramme, Marketplace) Erfahrung mit Sales- oder Revenue-Operations und Enablement-Programmen Sicherer Umgang mit KI-Tools in Analyse, Content und Enablement Was wir dir bieten Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust die Growth-Funktion von Anfang an mit auf und arbeitest direkt mit VP Growth und Geschäftsführung zusammen Leistungsorientierte Vergütung: Fixgehalt plus variable Komponente – dein Erfolg bei Growth-KPIs, Umsatz und EBIT zahlt sich direkt aus Entwicklungspfad: Die Rolle ist bewusst als Sprungbrett angelegt – hin zu einer führenden Growth-Rolle in der Gruppe Zukunftsthemen: Cloud, Daten, KI und eigene SaaS-Produkte – mit eigenem Delivery-Center in Vietnam Kultur: ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, ehrlich kommuniziert, pragmatisch entscheidet und kurze Wege hat Flexibilität: flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten – Office Kamp-Lintfort oder Berlin (ca. 1 Tag/Woche), sonst mobil innerhalb Deutschlands; gelegentliche Reisen in der DACH-Region So läuft der Auswahlprozess Sichtung deiner Unterlagen – Rückmeldung innerhalb von 10 Werktagen Erstgespräch (ca. 75 Minuten, per Video) mit VP Growth, Chief of Staff und einem Teammitglied aus Vertrieb oder Marketing Fallstudie und Zweitgespräch (ca. 90 Min., per Video) mit der Geschäftsführung – du präsentierst deine Lösung einer praxisnahen Aufgabe (ca. 1 Woche Vorbereitung) Angebot Interesse? Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf und beantworte uns kurz eine Frage: Welches Angebot hast du zuletzt so entwickelt oder geschärft, dass es spürbar mehr Umsatz gebracht hat – und wie hast du den Vertrieb dabei mitgenommen? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichen Starttermin nennst du uns gern direkt mit. Bei uns findest du ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam seine Ziele verfolgt. Wir setzen auf ehrliche Kommunikation, pragmatische Lösungen und eine Atmosphäre, in der Arbeiten Freude macht. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft innovativer Projekte!
