title: Principal, Customer Storytelling & Advocacy
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:</strong></p> <ul> <li>San Francisco, CA</li> <li>Austin, TX</li> <li>London, UK</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role summary</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a visionary, hands-on storyteller to reinvent how Cloudflare brings customer impact to life. This person will combine the narrative instincts of an exceptional writer and editor, the technical fluency of a product marketer, the relationship skills of a customer advocate, and the creative eye of a producer. You'll interview customers and their executives, find out what was at stake for them, and explain what they built on Cloudflare in language a CFO and a developer can both follow.</p> <p>We welcome ideas no one has tried yet. You'll own the creative standard for video and content. You will raise the creative and production bar across video, case studies, campaigns, executive content, and onstage moments, helping make Cloudflare more relatable without sacrificing technical credibility. You will also build repeatable, AI-enabled workflows that enable us to discover, produce, and amplify distinctive customer stories at scale.</p> <p><strong>Role responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Interview customers and find the story: </strong>Work directly with customers and their executives to learn what problem they had and what changed after they solved it. </li> <li><strong>Explain the technology in simple terms: </strong>Turn topics like Zero Trust or Workers AI into stories that business and technical readers can both follow, and keep the technical details right.</li> <li><strong>Lead a few big moments each year:</strong> Own a few major storytelling projects a year, such as a film, a campaign, or a customer segment in a Cloudflare Connect keynote.</li> <li><strong>Come up with ideas that get noticed: </strong>Pitch creative concepts that make people stop scrolling, such as a surprising angle or a format no one else has tried.</li> <li><strong>Try new formats:</strong> Pilot formats beyond the case study, such as documentary-style series, live builds, short social video, interactive data stories, customer takeovers, and podcasts.</li> <li><strong>Set the quality standard: </strong>Decide what good looks like for customer stories in every format, and hold agencies, freelancers, and internal teams to it.</li> <li><strong>Supply executives with stories:</strong> Give Cloudflare leaders the customer stories and proof points they use in keynotes, briefings, social posts, and customer meetings.</li> <li><strong>Work across teams to get stories approved: </strong>Source stories with Sales and Product, and work with Marketing, Communications, and Legal to get approvals.</li> <li><strong>Use AI to scale: </strong>Build repeatable AI workflows for spotting story candidates, preparing interviews, drafting, and cutting one story into versions for each channel.</li> <li><strong>Track results: </strong>Decide how we measure story impact (sales usage, pipeline influence, reach, advocate engagement) and use the numbers to choose what to make next.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills, knowledge, and experience </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical fluency</strong>: You can read a product doc or architecture diagram and explain in plain language what a customer built and why it matters.</li> <li><strong>Reporter and editor instincts</strong>: You ask the follow-up question and find the detail other people missed. You can read a draft and say what's missing, and you write copy that works for a CISO and for a developer.</li> <li><strong>Creative judgment and taste</strong>: You can tell quickly whether a story will get attention or build credibility. You know good film, editorial, design, and social work when you see it, and you borrow ideas from outside tech, including media, sports, and entertainment.</li> <li><strong>Production experience</strong>: You've had some experience directing or producing customer video, documentary, podcast, or live content, and you can manage crews and agencies.</li> <li><strong>Executive presence and influence</strong>: You're comfortable interviewing a customer's C-suite and briefing a Cloudflare executive before a keynote. You can get Sales, Product, Marketing, Comms, IT, and Legal moving in the same direction, and you push back when a story isn't ready.</li> <li><strong>AI in your daily work: </strong>You already use AI tools for writing, research, interview prep, or production, and you can show us how.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>10-15 years of experience </strong>in one or more of the following: Developer Relations, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Journalism, or Video Production. B2B technology experience is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.</li> <li><strong>Option to include customer stories</strong>, video, campaigns, or stage content you created or led, with a short note on what made each one work. Original creative concepts or formats that performed well, with results you can point to (for example reach, press coverage, or sales impact).</li> <li><strong>Experience producing stories with enterprise customers </strong>and their executives, including getting them through customer, Legal, and Comms approval.</li> <li><strong>Experience explaining complex technical products </strong>(infrastructure, security, developer platforms, or AI) to business and technical audiences.</li> <li>Experience producing video and live or stage content from start to finish.</li> <li>Experience building a content program or production workflow that other people could run is preferred</li> </ul> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_8ad1215988914a70" class="markdown markdown-main-panel md-content enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color tutor-markdown-rendering"> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <div> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location</p> <div> <ul> <li>For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $221,000 - $304,000.</li> </ul> </div> </div> </li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="2"><strong data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <div>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</div> </li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="4"><strong data-path-to-node="4" data-index-in-node="0">Benefits</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="5"> <li> <div> <p><span class="citation-1006 citation-1007 citation-1008 citation-end-1008">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. title: Head of Zero Day Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>About the role</h3><p>Cloudflare is hiring a Head of Zero Day Engineering to build and lead the team that turns newly discovered vulnerabilities into verified protection—for Cloudflare and its customers.</p><p>High-priority vulnerabilities rarely fit within one team’s boundaries. A fix may require kernel expertise, changes across software dependencies and trust stores, fleet-wide deployment, customer-facing WAF protections, and investigation of prior exploitation. You will bring those efforts together, with clear ownership from initial disclosure through verified remediation.</p><p>This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You will recruit the team, establish its operating model, and build the tooling that makes response faster and more reliable. You will combine experienced human judgment with carefully evaluated AI-assisted workflows—not automate away accountability.</p><h3>What you’ll do</h3><p><strong>Build and lead the team</strong></p><p>- Establish Zero Day Engineering’s charter, priorities, operating model, and partnerships across Cloudflare.</p><p>- Recruit, develop, and lead engineers spanning vulnerability response, exposure analysis, mitigation, patching, artifact provenance, release coordination, and automation.</p><p>- Build a sustainable incident-command rotation, clear escalation paths, and effective handoffs across teams and time zones.</p><p>- Create a culture of technical depth, calm execution, blameless learning, and shared accountability.</p><h3>Own vulnerability response end to end</h3><p>- Establish a consistent intake and triage process for public vulnerabilities, private disclosures, and internal findings.</p><p>- Ensure each significant vulnerability has a clear owner, an evidence-based exposure assessment, and a path to verified remediation.</p><p>- Lead decisions about mitigation versus patching, balancing urgency, exploitability, exposure, and production risk.</p><p>- Enable the team to implement fixes directly where practical and coordinate partner-owned changes through verified production deployment.</p><p>- Partner with SIRT on suspected compromise, exploitation analysis, hunting, and eviction verification. Ensure blocking an exploit is not mistaken for removing an existing compromise.</p><h3>Engineer for speed and safety</h3><p>- Drive artifact and dependency provenance so responders can quickly determine what Cloudflare runs and where it is exposed.</p><p>- Build repeatable capabilities for safe exploit validation, mitigation, patch qualification, and fleet-wide remediation.</p><p>- Coordinate managed WAF response with SRA, Managed Rules, Firewall/ERE, and WAF engineering while preserving specialist ownership.</p><p>- Maintain strong review, staged-release, health-monitoring, and rollback practices—including during urgent response.</p><p>- Turn recurring response problems into durable engineering improvements rather than repeated manual coordination.</p><p>### Develop responsible AI-assisted operations</p><p>- Build AI-assisted workflows for triage, research, exposure analysis, drafting, and release tracking.</p><p>- Establish replay evaluations, measurable quality thresholds, access controls, and human approval gates before production use.</p><p>- Keep release authority, disclosure approval, risk acceptance, and other consequential decisions with accountable people.</p><p>- Measure actual operational benefit and failure rates rather than assuming productivity gains.</p><h3>Set direction and communicate clearly</h3><p>- Define and report response metrics, including time to assess exposure, mitigate, patch, and verify remediation.</p><p>- Translate technical uncertainty into clear decisions, priorities, and executive updates.</p><p>- Partner with Product Security, Legal, Communications, and engineering leaders on coordinated disclosure and customer communication.</p><p>- Use workload and outcome data to guide staffing, investment, and capability development.</p><h3>What you’ll bring</h3><p>- Experience building and leading engineering teams responsible for security-critical systems, vulnerability response, production infrastructure, or closely related work.</p><p>- A record of delivering complex technical changes across organizational boundaries, including when priorities compete and authority is distributed.</p><p>- Strong technical judgment across several of the following: Linux and operating systems, vulnerability analysis, software supply chains, application security, distributed systems, fleet management, or production reliability.</p><p>- Experience leading high-pressure technical response with incomplete information, making defensible decisions, and communicating what is known, unknown, and next.</p><p>- A practical understanding of mitigation, patching, exploitation detection, and remediation verification—and the differences between them.</p><p>- Experience establishing safe deployment, validation, and rollback practices at scale.</p><p>- The ability to recruit and develop strong engineers while remaining credible in technical reviews and operational decisions.</p><p>- Clear written communication and the ability to work effectively with engineers, security specialists, executives, and legal partners.</p><p>- A thoughtful approach to AI-assisted engineering, including evaluation, security boundaries, and human accountability.</p><h3>Experience that would be especially useful</h3><p>- Coordinating responses to embargoed vulnerabilities or working with upstream maintainers and security researchers.</p><p>- Kernel patching, backporting, runtime or trust-store remediation, or large-scale dependency updates.</p><p>- WAF rule development or deployment, exploit reproduction, host forensics, or threat hunting.</p><p>- Building artifact inventories, dependency graphs, or software provenance systems.</p><p>- Developing and operating AI-assisted engineering tools with rigorous evaluation and access controls.</p><p>- Building a new team or function while maintaining effective partnerships with existing owners.</p><h3>What success looks like</h3><p>- Vulnerabilities have a clear path from intake to an accountable owner and verified remediation.</p><p>- Exposure questions are answered quickly with evidence rather than repeated manual investigation.</p><p>- Urgent fixes move faster without bypassing production safety or disclosure controls.</p><p>- Cloudflare can distinguish between an exploit being blocked, a vulnerability being patched, and a compromise being removed.</p><p>- AI-assisted workflows deliver demonstrated value within explicit safeguards.</p><p>- The team’s capabilities and staffing evolve based on measured demand and outcomes.</p><p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: Senior Operations Responder
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3></h3> <h3>ABOUT THE ROLE</h3> <p>The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, Threat Detection & Response</p> <p><strong>Product Security</strong> consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.</p> <p><strong>Threat Detection & Response</strong> (this role!) focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.</p> <p><strong>Identity</strong> is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.</p> <p>While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.</p> <p>As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be on the front line of defending Tide. Your primary focus is actively investigating threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform – but we don’t want anyone working the same alert by hand twice. Your goal is to make investigation effective at scale: cutting manual effort through automation, and working hand-in-hand with our Detection Engineering team to improve the true positive / false positive efficacy of what lands in the queue.</p> <p>When the security queue is empty, you’ll be building – automations, enrichment and your own detections. An open mind and a curious approach are key: every investigation is a chance to make the next one faster and sharper.</p> <p><strong>As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be:</strong></p> <p><em>Investigating and responding to threats (your primary focus)</em></p> <ul> <li>Actively triaging and investigating security alerts and threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform, across AWS, GCP, SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta), internal applications and employee endpoints (Windows, macOS).</li> <li>Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.</li> <li>Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.</li> <li>Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.</li> </ul> <p><em>Scaling investigation through automation & Improving detection efficacy </em></p> <ul> <li>Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the “anything is possible” mantra.</li> <li>Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team’s time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.</li> <li>Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.</li> <li>Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.</li> <li>Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.</li> </ul> <p><em>Building when the queue is clear</em></p> <ul> <li>Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.</li> <li>Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.</li> <li>Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.</li> <li>Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR</h3> <ul> <li>Significant hands-on experience in security operations, incident response or threat investigation, ideally in a cloud-native environment.</li> <li>Strong investigative instincts and log analysis skills at scale, with the ability to query a security data lake or SIEM fluently – strong knowledge of one of the following: Splunk, Scanner, Sentinel, SecOps.</li> <li>Strong understanding of modern attack and defence techniques which apply to Cloud (AWS, GCP), SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta) and desktop (Windows and macOS) environments, and the ability to map activity to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.</li> <li>Strong experience in security automation, from writing scripts (e.g. Python) to creating end-to-end automated workflows. Familiarity with SOAR platforms and automating investigation and response tasks.</li> <li>Experience writing or tuning detections, and a clear view of what separates a high-fidelity alert from a noisy one.</li> <li>Calm, methodical judgement during live incidents, including knowing when and how to escalate.</li> <li>An open mind and a curious approach – you enjoy pulling on threads, and you don’t stop at “false positives” without understanding why.</li> <li>Hands-on attitude and the ability to drive solutions to completion.</li> <li>Passion for passing on knowledge to fellow colleagues.</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written communication skills, including clear investigation write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Bonus points if you have a repository showcasing automations, detections or tooling you’ve built.</li> </ul> <h3></h3> <h3><br>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: </h3> <ul> <li>Competitive salary </li> <li>Group Life Insurance </li> <li>Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing</li> <li>24/7 Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days</li> <li>We invest in your development with a £1,000 professional L&D budget per year</li> <li>Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution</li> <li>Spacious brand-new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar</li> <li>Enhanced family-friendly leave</li> <li>3 days for L&D or volunteering time off per year</li> <li>Flexible working options</li> <li>Sabbatical leave </li> <li>Share options</li> </ul> <h3>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. </p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>#LI-MP1</strong></p> <p><strong>#LI-Remote</strong></p> <h3></h3><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. </p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.</em></p> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Disclaimer</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><em>It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:</em></div> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Efficient LLM Inference & Model Optimization
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>Nebius Token Factory is looking for scientists who can turn frontier LLM and VLM inference bottlenecks into research questions, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused research and optimization projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts that engineers can build on.</p> <p>Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><div> <h3>The Role</h3> Server Infrastructure is a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for the full lifecycle of Nebius Cloud hardware: from newly delivered bare metal through provisioning, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning. Our mission is to make the hardware layer fast, reliable, and invisible.<br><br>We apply software engineering to infrastructure operations. Our work spans CPU and GPU platforms, the base GNU/Linux system, and the infrastructure supporting our hardware fleet.<br><br>As a Senior / Staff Engineer, you’ll take ownership of complex infrastructure challenges and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring, and coordination across teams, turning operational needs into reliable services and automation.<br>You’ll work closely with data center engineers, capacity managers, cloud compute developers, networking teams, and hardware suppliers. Your work will directly affect the reliability and capacity of the entire cloud platform.<br><br><strong>Y</strong><strong>our responsibilities will include:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Design, build, and <li>Improve on-call practices, incident response, and learning through blameless incident reviews.</li> <li>Strengthen fleet observability, alerting, testing, deployment safety, and operational readiness.</li> <li>Drive support for new CPU and GPU platforms and improvements to the base GNU/Linux system.</li> <li>Mentor engineers, provide thoughtful design and code reviews, and help the team develop sound engineering practices.</li> <li>Coordinate delivery across teams, communicate technical tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies.</li> </ul> <div><strong>We expect you to have:</strong></div> systems and failure handling.</li> <li>A track record of owning complex technical initiatives and bringing them into production.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of SRE principles: service level objectives, observability, incident management, capacity planning, and toil reduction.</li> <li>Sound technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and investigate difficult production problems.</li> <li>Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through collaboration and technical example.</li> <li>Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across engineering and operational teams.</li> </ul> <div><br>We welcome candidates at senior and staff levels. The scope of ownership and technical influence will reflect your experience.<br>Experience with hardware provisioning, <strong>bare metal infrastructure</strong>, <strong>GPU platforms</strong>, or large server fleets would be valuable.<br>Familiarity with <strong>Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, SaltStack, and Terraform</strong> is also useful.<br><em>We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.</em></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits & Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI </p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. This is a unique opportunity to make fundamental architectural decisions, establish engineering best practices from the ground up, and profoundly shape the technical direction for serving state-of-the-art AI. TabPFN does its learning in the forward pass, and it now handles datasets in the millions of rows. Making that fast, reliable, and affordable is an exciting engineering challenge. You'll work directly with world-class AI researchers, translating cutting-edge models into scalable production systems. This role offers significant autonomy and impact, with clear paths to specialize in areas you're passionate about (like inference optimization and core backend systems) or grow into a technical leadership position as our team expands. You won't just be implementing features; you'll be building the backbone of our company. What you'll work on: Own Inference: Own the serving path end-to-end: latency, throughput, batching, memory behavior on large inputs, and cost per prediction. Our models serve through our managed API, inside customer VPCs, and as self-hosted open weights, and you’ll have an impact across the board. Architect & Design: Design robust, scalable, and secure backend systems and production-grade APIs for serving our foundation models. Build & Implement: Develop high-quality, maintainable code for core backend services. Own Infrastructure: Design, deploy, and manage core infrastructure on cloud platforms, focusing on reliability, monitoring, observability, and cost-efficiency. Ensure Compliance & Security: Implement secure, GDPR-compliant systems, including data storage, access control, usage tracking, and quota management. Champion Best Practices: Drive high standards for testing, CI/CD, documentation, and security within the engineering team. You may be a good fit if you have: 3+ years of professional experience in machine learning and backend engineering, with a proven track record of managing production infrastructure. Proven experience deploying and operating machine learning models in production , with a strong understanding of how models behave and fail under real traffic. Strong, hands-on experience designing and building production-grade APIs and backend services. Significant experience building and operating services on cloud platforms, with GCP preferred. Strong, hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform . Significant experience with containerization and orchestration technologies ( Docker, Kubernetes ). Proficiency in Python. What sets you apart Experience building or managing infrastructure specifically for machine learning (MLOps, model serving frameworks, feature stores, data pipelines). Deep experience with inference optimization (quantization, compilation, dynamic batching, caching strategies, interplay with distributed computing). Experience with PyTorch and FastAPI specifically. Contributions to relevant open-source projects. Life at Prior Labs You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right. Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together. Agents, tools, and retrieval : how agents plan and call tools, how knowledge bases and document search feed context to a model, and where these chains tend to break. What Graduation Looks Like You start on a 12-month fixed-term contract. title: Ingénieur ou post-doctorant pour l'analyse des données acquises par un radar HF océanographique couvrant le Raz Blanchard
company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’UFR S2I sur le Campus de Brest. Projet FLOWATT Le projet FLOWATT, dans le cadre duquel s’inscrit cette étude, vise à déployer et exploiter six hydroliennes dans les forts courants marins du Raz Blanchard, en Normandie. Au-delà de la production d’énergie, FLOWATT a pour objectif d’évaluer le potentiel du Raz Blanchard pour le déploiement de fermes hydroliennes à plus grande échelle. Cette évaluation repose notamment sur une caractérisation précise de la ressource, une estimation fine du productible et une meilleure compréhension des impacts environnementaux. Pour répondre à ces enjeux, le projet combine mesures in situ, modélisation numérique et essais expérimentaux afin de fournir les connaissances nécessaires à la préparation des futurs déploiements commerciaux, tout en contribuant à la réduction des coûts de production et à la limitation des impacts sur l’environnement marin. Dans ce contexte, la caractérisation de l’état de mer constitue un enjeu important, notamment dans une zone soumise à des courants très intenses. La présente étude s’intéresse ainsi aux données de radar HF acquises depuis fin 2017, ainsi qu’à celles qui seront nouvellement enregistrées dans le cadre du projet TidalRace. Le système, de technologie WERA, est réparti sur deux sites distants d’environ 5 km au Cap de la Hague et fonctionne à deux fréquences, 13,5 MHz et 24,5 MHz. Les acquisitions sont réalisées en continu, à raison de quatre mesures par heure, 24 h/24 et 7 j/7, sur une emprise couvrant l’ensemble du Raz Blanchard. Cette couverture temporelle et spatiale offre ainsi une opportunité unique de suivre l’évolution des états de mer dans des conditions hydrodynamiques particulièrement contraintes. L’exploitation de ces données nécessite toutefois d’adapter les méthodes de traitement aux conditions de forts courants. L’objectif des travaux est donc d’améliorer les algorithmes existants et, si nécessaire, d’en développer de nouveaux afin de restituer de manière fiable les spectres d’énergie des vagues en fréquence et en direction, ainsi que les paramètres moyens associés. Une première étape consistera à comprendre les limites des méthodes actuelles, qui ne permettent plus de restituer un état de mer cohérent avec les références disponibles lorsque la vitesse du courant dépasse 1 m/s, comme montré par Lopez et al. (2018). Les méthodes développées seront ensuite évaluées à partir des mesures in situ et des modélisations numériques. Le radar HF constitue ainsi un élément central de ce travail, dont l’amélioration doit permettre de mieux caractériser les états de mer dans les forts courants du Raz Blanchard . Il.elle participe à la rédaction des livrables nécessaires à la constitution du DMR (Device Master Record) en vue de son transfert de la R&D au Manufacturing en vue de la production en série. Les missions seront les suivantes : Prise en main du dossier R&D / Client Structurer et formaliser les nomenclatures, gammes de fabrication, modes opératoires Tracer les évolutions et mettre à jour les dossiers Gestion des données techniques dans l’ERP Créer, modifier et maintenir les articles, nomenclatures, gammes et données associées dans l’ERP Participer au process de demandes de changement et assurer les mises à jour dans l’ERP Garantir l’application des règles de codification et de gestion documentaire en lien avec le système qualité Identifier les anomalies de données et proposer des actions correctives Assurer la traçabilité des modifications et des validations. (Homologations Internes / fournisseurs) Support à l’industrialisation en collaboration avec les responsables produits Mettre en forme et maintenir à jour les modes opératoires de montage/réglage des instruments Coordonner la mise à jours des plans impactés par les modifications et les transférer dans l’ERP Constituer les dossiers des bancs et outils connexes requis par la production Constituer les dossiers des pièces détachées ♂♀ Et toi dans tout ça ? title: Stage E-commerce & Influencer Marketing (NL/BE), fulltime, start januari/februari 2027
description: Wil je zien wat jouw ideeën doen voor een merk waar jonge ouders dol op zijn? Bij Petite Amélie zie je meteen het resultaat van je werk. Je zet bijvoorbeeld een samenwerking op met een Nederlandse influencer, of je bouwt een landingspagina voor een campagne, en je ziet direct wat het oplevert. Je haalt bij ons niet alleen koffie: vanaf dag één draai je volwaardig mee in ons marketing- & e-commerceteam, met de Nederlandse en Belgische markt als jouw terrein. Over Petite Amélie Wij ontwerpen en produceren meubels, accessoires en speelgoed voor baby- en kinderkamers, en jonge ouders in heel Europa zijn er dol op. We groeien snel, met webshops in Nederland, België, Frankrijk, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk. Vanuit ons kantoor in Weesp (15 minuten met de trein vanaf Amsterdam Centraal) werken we met zo’n 30 collega’s aan het merk. Wat ga je doen? Ons team beheert de webshops en alle online kanalen. Organische groei en sterke content staan centraal. Je kiest samen met je begeleider waar je de nadruk op legt, op basis van je leerdoelen en interesses: Influencers & samenwerkingen: je zoekt passende influencers en contentmakers in Nederland en België en neemt zelf contact met ze op. Je zet samenwerkingen op, zoals productgifting, contentdeals en campagnes, en je onderhoudt de relaties. Content & social: je maakt content voor Instagram, TikTok en Pinterest en doet community management. Campagnes & landingspagina’s: je helpt campagnes uitvoeren en bouwt en werkt aan pagina’s die converteren. Webshop & merchandising: je bepaalt mee hoe producten in de shop worden gepresenteerd. SEO & CRO: je zoekt uit waarom bezoekers wel of niet kopen, en wat we daaraan kunnen verbeteren. Data & onderzoek: je rapporteert over e-commerce-KPI’s en doet marktonderzoek naar nieuwe kansen. Aan het eind van je stage heb je echte resultaten en een eigen netwerk om te laten zien, en daarmee val je bij je volgende werkgever meteen op. Wie zoeken we? Dit heb je echt nodig: Je studeert bedrijfskunde, marketing, communicatie, economie of iets vergelijkbaars, op hbo- of wo-niveau, en je stage is onderdeel van je opleiding (met stageovereenkomst). Je bent fulltime beschikbaar voor minimaal 6 maanden, vanaf januari of februari 2027. Je woont in Nederland. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands, en je Engels is goed. Dit maakt je een goede match: Je pakt dingen zelf op, bent nieuwsgierig en denkt commercieel. Je vindt het leuk om mensen te benaderen en relaties op te bouwen. Je hebt oog voor design, interieur en esthetiek. Je werkt nauwkeurig en graag samen. Herken je jezelf niet in elk punt? Solliciteer toch. Enthousiasme en leergierigheid wegen voor ons zwaar. Stuur je CV en vertel ons kort wie je bent. Je kunt een motivatie schrijven, maar je mag jezelf ook voorstellen met een reel, story of een ander creatief format. Dat vinden we leuk, maar het is niet verplicht. Zo verloopt het: binnen een week hoor je van ons. Daarna volgt een (video)kennismaking met je toekomstige begeleider, en je hoort snel of je in januari of februari kunt starten. Vragen? title: Senior Program Manager
description: About us INCO is a leading social enterprise on a mission to shape a more inclusive and sustainable economy that creates opportunities for all. We have teams and programs in over 50 countries. Our work spans five complementary activities: INCO Academy: skilling programs for people facing barriers to employment, leading to careers in fast-growing industries such as technology, sustainability and healthcare (400,000+ job seekers trained to date). INCO Kids: education and awareness programs giving school-age learners future-proof knowledge in technology, sustainability, citizenship and more (350,000+ learners supported to date). INCO Entrepreneurs: incubation and acceleration for underrepresented founders and social entrepreneurs (2,000+ businesses supported every year). INCO Ventures: impact investing and funding for social and environmental impact startups (€500M+ assets under management). INCO Spaces: co-working and co-living spaces for social and environmental innovators (Paris, Berlin, Warsaw and more). About the program: AI and the Future of Work is a new three-year research and policy-engagement program (2026–2029), funded through a research grant partnership and led end to end by INCO. It tracks AI's real-world impact on jobs, tasks and productivity across all 27 EU member states, and gives policymakers the evidence, trend baselines and scenario-planning tools to capture AI's productivity upside while managing the workforce transition. About the role: We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the AI and the Future of Work program day to day and make sure it delivers on time, on budget and to the grant's commitments. You will closely lead and collaborate with a Research Lead and a Policy Lead. You will turn a three-year grant into a working operation: a deliverables calendar across 27 countries, a consortium of up to 15 partners, a publication schedule and a reporting cycle the funder can trust. You need to be comfortable working alongside researchers and policy specialists, and fluent in the rhythm of grant-funded research programs. Responsibilities: Lead program delivery end to end Planning and implementation Build and own the three-year implementation plan: workstreams, milestones, dependencies and the deliverables calendar agreed with the funder. Run the program's operating rhythm: weekly core-team check-ins, monthly consortium updates and quarterly steering reviews. Coordinate the publication pipeline with the Research and Policy Leads: quarterly data refreshes, five semi-annual reports, policy briefs, the annual flagship and the 2029 EU27 report. Keep thorough program documentation: plans, decision logs, risk register and handover notes. Set up quality-assurance steps for outputs (review cycles, sign-off, editorial and brand checks) together with the Communications team. Run the semi-annual tracking cycle and the reporting calendar for the five P0 markets and five sub-regional clusters, so national and EU27 outputs land together. Monitoring and evaluation Define and track program KPIs and grant deliverables; spot slippage early and agree corrective action with the leads. Collect and compile performance data across workstreams and partners, and report it to your manager and the funder in a structured, actionable way. Coordinate the program's evaluation framework so the team can show what the evidence changed in policy and practice. Budget and resources Own the program budget and cost sheet, including consortium partner budgets and the research consolidation budget held by the Research Lead. Manage timelines and scope so the program delivers within the grant's budget and rules; prepare budget forecasts and reallocation requests. Ensure grant compliance: eligible costs, audit trail, data protection (GDPR) and the funder's reporting requirements, working with Finance and Legal. Manage the consortium and partners Run the operational side of partner onboarding with the Research Lead: due diligence, contracts, scopes of work, payment schedules and data-sharing agreements. Track the delivery of 8 to 15 national partners against their contracts, and manage underperformance or replacement when needed. Organise consortium working groups, review cycles and annual convenings, and keep communication flowing across countries and time zones. Run the secretariat for the sub-recipient advisory committee (INCO staff, funder representatives and independent experts): schedule meetings, prepare selection materials, record recommendations and keep the process transparent, with final selection resting with INCO. Manage subrecipient compliance: flow-down of grant terms, financial and narrative reporting from partners, and checks before each payment. Manage the funder and stakeholders Act as the primary operational liaison with the grant funder, keeping expectations aligned and surfacing risks early. Prepare and present progress, financial and impact reports to the funder and other key stakeholders. Work with the Head of Partnerships on funder conversations, renewals and any extension of the partnership. Support the Policy Lead and with the logistics of policymaker convenings, events and launches. Coordinate, with the Policy Lead, the expanded public-engagement activity in Poland and the CEE region, and the logistics of rapid, fact-based responses when AI labour market stories break. Coordinate the team Set clear responsibilities, timelines and objectives across the core team, and track progress against them. Act as the connecting point between the Research Lead, the Policy Lead, data engineers and INCO's support teams (Communications, Finance, Legal, HR). Identify staffing needs as the program grows (for example research assistants, data roles or a program officer), write job descriptions, interview and onboard new team members, and manage any program staff assigned to you. Support growth Work with leadership to standardise how INCO runs grant-funded research programs, so lessons from this one carry over. Identify follow-on funding and adjacent opportunities, for example linking findings to INCO Academy skilling programs. Build relationships across the European research and policy ecosystem. Essential At least five years managing complex, multi-partner programs, ideally grant-funded research, policy or public-interest programs in Europe. Proven track record managing funders or institutional partners, including donor reporting, budgets and grant compliance. Experience coordinating consortia or networks of external partners, including contracts, scopes of work and partner payments. At least four years leading teams and working cross-functionally, including with senior experts you do not line manage. Strong budget and financial management skills, with ownership of program cost sheets and forecasts. High digital collaboration literacy (Slack, Monday.com, Notion, G-Suite or similar) and comfort running remote work across many countries. Professional English, written and spoken. Strong attention to detail and organisational skills, with excellent communication, versatility and integrity. Desirable Experience with EU-funded or foundation-funded research programs (for example Horizon Europe, Erasmus+ or major philanthropic grants). Familiarity with research operations: publication cycles, data protection (GDPR), research ethics and data-sharing agreements. Interest in AI, the labour market, skills or the future of work; familiarity with EU institutions such as Cedefop, Eurostat, Eurofound or the JRC. A second EU language, especially German, French, Spanish, Italian or Polish. A recognised project management certification (for example PMP or PRINCE2). Experience managing sub-grants or sub-recipients, including selection processes and flow-down compliance. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Stage Assistant·e coordination de projet événementiel séminaire international
description: Nous recherchons un.e stagiaire Assistant·e de coordination de projet événementiel pour le Séminaire international « Aides techniques et inclusion » (Dakar, juin 2027). Contexte : Titre de travail du séminaire : « Une offre de services de qualité en aides techniques : un pilier pour l’inclusion intersectorielle ». Le séminaire vise à construire et partager une approche commune de HI et de ses partenaires sur l’offre de services de qualité en aides techniques (identification, orientation, évaluation, adaptation, information et conseil aux usagers et aux aidants). Il couvre la mobilité, la vision, l’audition et la communication, et s’adresse aux secteurs de la réadaptation, de l’éducation inclusive et des moyens de subsistance. Il s’inscrit dans l’accord-cadre (AC) 2023–2027, qui appuie 16 pays : en Afrique (Sénégal, Burkina Faso, Éthiopie, Mali, Niger, Madagascar, RDC, Rwanda) et hors Afrique (Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Cambodge, Laos, Myanmar, Népal, Palestine, Haïti). L’invitation pourra être ouverte à d’autres pays disposant de leurs propres sources de financement. Il est organisé en articulation avec AT EXPO AFRICA 2027, premier dialogue international dédié à l’innovation, à la production et à l’accès aux aides techniques en Afrique, qui se tiendra sur le même site les 3–5 juin 2027 (Journée mondiale des aides techniques le 4 juin). Dates, agenda et logistique des deux événements sont à coordonner. Cadre du stage : Le stage se déroulera à Lyon, avec un déplacement à Dakar (Sénégal). Vous êtes intégré à l'équipe de la Direction Réadaptation, composée de 12 personnes, incluant des spécialistes thématiques (dont 1 manager), des spécialistes de la réadaptation en urgence (dont 1 manager), une unité de reconditionnement de composants (avec 1 chef d’atelier), un adjoint à la direction et 1 assistante. Vos principaux interlocuteurs seront : • Le point focal en charge du contenu et de l’animation du séminaire (binôme de travail au quotidien) • Les points focaux de HI Luxembourg et de HI Sénégal (logistique, finances, sécurité) • Le point focal de la Division Résilience & Inclusion (éducation inclusive, moyens de subsistance) • Les points focaux des pays de l’accord-cadre et le point focal de AT EXPO AFRICA 2027 • Les services communication, achats et finances de HI Vos missions principales : Une phase d’intégration est prévue en début de stage : procédures HI, règles de sécurité, code de conduite et politiques de protection. Axe 1 – Coordination et pilotage opérationnel • Participer à la réunion de cadrage avec la tutrice, le point focal contenu et animation et les autres points focaux ; clarifier les rôles et les circuits de validation • Reprendre et tenir à jour le rétroplanning et le plan d’action ; identifier les moyens nécessaires (budget, transport, salles, documentation, outils de présentation…) • Assurer le secrétariat du comité d’organisation : préparation des réunions, comptes rendus, suivi des décisions • Tenir un tableau de bord partagé (avancement, risques, points de blocage) et alerter rapidement la tutrice en cas de difficulté Axe 2 – Participants et parties prenantes • Consolider la liste des participants (pays de l’AC, secteurs, partenaires, intervenants externes) à partir des premiers échanges déjà tenus avec les points focaux pays • Préparer et envoyer les invitations et lettres d’invitation pour les visas ; gérer les inscriptions • Mettre en place et tenir l’outil de suivi des participants (vols, visas, hébergement, contacts, besoins spécifiques), dans le respect de la protection des données personnelles • Recenser les besoins d’accessibilité et organiser les aménagements raisonnables (accès des lieux, formats accessibles, accompagnants, interprétation) • Recueillir les attentes des participants en amont ; concevoir, administrer et analyser l’évaluation du séminaire Axe 3 – Logistique et achats En lien étroit avec les points focaux de HI Luxembourg et les équipes logistiques de HI Sénégal : • Finaliser le choix du lieu (déjà en discussion avec AT EXPO AFRICA 2027 et HI Sénégal), réserver les salles et l’hébergement ; négocier les tarifs et préparer avec le lieu tous les arrangements nécessaires • Organiser les déplacements : billets d’avion des participants et intervenants, visas, transferts aéroport, transport local • Organiser l’interprétation et les équipements techniques (sonorisation, connexion pour d’éventuels participants à distance) • Sélectionner et suivre les fournisseurs selon les procédures d’achat HI ; commander le matériel, les impressions et les supports • Préparer la logistique de la visite de terrain et des temps communs avec AT EXPO AFRICA 2027 • Pendant le séminaire : faire un point quotidien avec l’équipe d’organisation et le lieu, gérer les imprévus et remonter les problèmes Axe 4 – Suivi budgétaire et administratif • Contribuer au budget prévisionnel détaillé ; suivre les engagements et les dépenses au regard du budget et des codes d’imputation • Gérer les per diem, avances et remboursements des participants ; collecter les justificatifs • Après le séminaire : clôturer les paiements fournisseurs, préparer les éléments financiers du rapport bailleur et transmettre les dossiers en cours Axe 5 – Contenu, documentation et capitalisation En appui au point focal en charge du contenu et de l’animation du séminaire : • Contribuer à l’élaboration de l’agenda avec les parties prenantes et AT EXPO AFRICA 2027 (consolidation, gestion des versions, traductions) • Appuyer les intervenants et facilitateurs dans la préparation des outils d’animation, des présentations et du matériel • Produire le kit participant : agenda final, note logistique, informations pratiques sur Dakar, santé et sécurité, per diem, contacts • Prendre des notes pendant les sessions et centraliser les ressources (présentations, documents) sur un espace partagé • Rédiger le rapport du séminaire (plus spécifiquement le rapport au bailleur) avec le comité d’organisation ; contribuer à la compilation des outils et approches pour la note d’orientation Axe 6 – Communication • Interne : informer les équipes via les canaux HI (Hinside, Teams, réseaux métiers) • Externe : rédiger et/ou traduire en anglais des articles et publications (LinkedIn Rehabilitation), en lien avec le service communication et AT EXPO AFRICA 2027, en respectant les règles de visibilité du bailleur • Assurer le lien avec les intervenants externes (experts, chercheurs, partenaires) Et mettre en œuvre toute autre action nécessaire à la bonne organisation du séminaire. Calendrier indicatif : La préparation sera déjà engagée à l’arrivée du/de la stagiaire : lieu en discussion avec AT EXPO AFRICA 2027 et HI Sénégal, premiers échanges tenus avec les pays participants. Le/la stagiaire enclenchera directement l’achat des billets d’avion et les démarches de visas. • Janvier : intégration, reprise du rétroplanning et du budget, lancement des billets d’avion et des démarches de visas • Février – mars : invitations et inscriptions, finalisation du lieu et choix des prestataires, suivi des visas, communication de lancement • Avril – mai : contrats prestataires, recueil des attentes, agenda finalisé, kit participant et supports • ~24 mai – 6 juin : à Dakar : installation et briefing, séminaire (31 mai ou 1er juin – 5 juin), AT EXPO AFRICA 2027 (3–5 juin), débriefing 8 – 25 juin : clôture financière, analyse de l’évaluation, rapport, passation Contraintes particulières liées au stage : • Déplacement terrain : Dakar, Sénégal, environ deux semaines (~24 mai – 6 juin 2027). L’établissement d’enseignement doit valider ce déplacement en amont. Passeport valide et vaccinations à jour requis ; respect des règles de sécurité HI. • Pic d’activité dans les semaines précédant le séminaire et pendant celui-ci : horaires pouvant être décalés, dans le respect du cadre légal des stages. • Environnement multi-site et multilingue : Lyon, Bruxelles, Luxembourg, Dakar et 16 pays ; nombreux échanges à distance. Engagement à respecter le code de conduite de HI et ses politiques de protection (exploitation et abus sexuels, protection de l’enfance, anti-fraude et anti-corruption, protection des données). Requirements Vous êtes issu d'une formation Master en gestion de projets de solidarité internationale, action humanitaire et développement, affaires internationales, management d’événements ou logistique, ou équivalent. Une première expérience en organisation d’événements (séminaires, conférences, formations), idéalement à dimension internationale, est un atout (stage, emploi ou engagement associatif) Une expérience dans le secteur des ONG et/ou en Afrique de l’Ouest est appréciée Une connaissance ou une expérience du milieu de la santé et du handicap est appréciée. Planification et suivi de projet : • Organisation logistique et suivi budgétaire de base (rétroplanning, tableaux de suivi) • Très bonnes capacités de communication et de rédaction en français et en anglais (comptes rendus, rapports, articles) • Capacité de synthèse et prise de notes Savoir-être : • Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et des priorités • Autonomie, esprit d’initiative, capacité à résoudre les problèmes • Aisance relationnelle, diplomatie et goût pour le travail en équipe multiculturelle, y compris à distance • Réactivité, sang-froid et adaptabilité face aux imprévus Environnement informatique : • Maîtrise du pack Office, notamment Excel (tableaux de suivi, budget) • Outils collaboratifs Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint) et visioconférence • Formulaires et enquêtes en ligne (MS Forms, KoboToolbox…) • Usage raisonné des outils d’IA générative (traduction, synthèse, rédaction), dans le respect des règles de confidentialité de HI • Outils de création graphique simples (Canva…) : un plus Les participants seront francophones et anglophones, voire hispanophones. Toutes les communications orales et écrites se feront au minimum en français et en anglais. Benefits Durée: 6 mois à temps-plein Date de démarrage : à partir du 04/01/2027 Type de contrat: Stage Salaire: - Gratification mensuelle de 693€ - Tickets restaurant d’une valeur faciale de 8,96 euros (60 % à la charge de l’employeur, 40% à votre charge) - Participation de 50% à votre abonnement au titre des transports Vous devez disposer d’une convention de stage obligatoire délivrée par un établissement d’enseignement ou de formation français. Les stages proposés chez HI donnent l’occasion aux étudiants d’évoluer dans une organisation internationale et de prendre part à l’action d’Humanité & Inclusion. Nous considérons que les stagiaires pour qui l’expérience s’est bien passée sont nos talents de demain ! title: Principal Security Operations Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p> </p> <p><strong>What We Do:</strong></p> <p>Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.</p> <p>Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. functional guidance to AEs</li> <li>Source, interview, and recruit top sales talents in coordination with recruiting and sales leaders</li> <li>Own and drive accurate and up-to-date AE KPI, reporting Sales Go-To-Market coverage (vertical, geo-based etc.) for all market segments</li> <li>Drive channel relationships forward to accelerate channel business</li> <li>Help foster relationships between Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: Software Engineer, Data Primitives
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations</strong>: Lisbon or London or NYC or Austin </p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>The Workers team makes it possible for Cloudflare customers to run JavaScript and WebAssembly on Cloudflare's edge network. We build and maintain the developer platform that executes trillions of requests per month on behalf of developers and grants them nearly limitless control over how their requests are handled and responded to. The Workers team is split into several groups. The Data Primitives group is focused on how we bring state to the edge.</p> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>The Data Primitives Group enables developers to build with data and asynchronous tasks, taking their applications beyond simple request manipulation to complete, globally delivered applications. We build and operate <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/">Cloudflare D1</a>, our managed SQLite database; <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/">Queues</a>, our messaging primitive; and <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/learning/how-kv-works/">Workers KV</a>, a global low-latency key-value data store. We also design and build new services to address critical customer application integration requirements.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <p>In this role, you'll join one of our top-notch engineering teams (D1, Queues or Workers KV) that keep our services and customers’ applications running smoothly at global scale while implementing new features, ensuring reliability, and improving performance.</p> <p>You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write or review a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, modify how your service processes and stores data, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You will use your experience to mentor and guide other engineers as they begin their careers. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Typescript, Go, Rust, and C++.</p> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience with (and love for) distributed systems and data</li> <li>Willing and eager to share knowledge, and mentor</li> <li>Great oral and written communications skills, especially concisely documenting complex conceptsSolid understanding of TypeScript and Go, including asynchronous programming in both</li> <li>Strong systems level programming skillsUnderstanding of security issues and responsibilities</li> <li>Experience with monitoring, alerting and debugging high volume production systems</li> <li>Experience with a continuous integration workflow and using source control (we use git)Solid Linux experience</li> <li>Fluent in analyses of data sets such as logs</li> <li>Designing and building APIs</li> <li>A desire for continuous learning and improvement</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of <span class="rQesXe MPyX">€54,000</span> - <span class="rQesXe MPyX">€68,000</span></span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For NYC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $187,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <h1> </h1> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p>

MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated engineering experience.
