title: AI Solution Engineer (m/w/d) – E-Commerce
description: Vorweg, damit wir uns die Zeit sparen: Diese Rolle ist neu bei uns. Du verbindest Beratung, Technik und Prototyping – und bist dabei schneller als jede Folie. Wenn ein Kunde im Workshop sagt „Unsere Produktdaten sind ein Chaos“, willst du kein Konzept schreiben, das in drei Wochen fertig ist. Du willst ihm am Nachmittag zeigen, wie es aussehen könnte. Wenn du bei „Workshop“ an Moderationskarten und Flipchart denkst, wird das hier nichts. Wenn du dabei an deinen Laptop mit Claude Code denkst: lies weiter. Wer wir sind creativestyle ist eine E-Commerce-Agentur mit deutsch-polnischem Setup: Beratung und Projektmanagement in München, Entwicklung in Krakau und Rybnik. Über 120 umgesetzte Shops, rund 110 Leute, Kunden wie NKD, Mövenpick, CEWE Fotobuch, Einhell und Bergzeit. Dieses Jahr haben wir richtig abgeräumt: Agentur des Jahres , dazu zwei Auszeichnungen gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden – Best Customer Experience mit benuta, Best Mobile Experience mit Bergzeit. Was das im Alltag bedeutet: Jede und jeder bei uns hat einen technischen Background. Die Geschäftsführung eingeschlossen. 50 % Freiheit, 50 % Verantwortung. Beides gilt gleichzeitig. Fehler sind bei uns Lektionen, keine Schuldfrage. Wir steigen nur ungern zweimal in denselben Fluss. Corporate sind wir nicht. Unzuverlässig allerdings auch nicht. Wir nehmen keine Projekte an, auf die wir keine Lust haben. Warum wir diese Stelle gerade jetzt schaffen Zwei Gründe, beide ehrlich: 1. Unsere Kunden wollen keine Shops mehr. Sie wollen Lösungen. Produktdaten, ERP, Schnittstellen, Automatisierung, KI – die spannenden Fragen liegen heute zwischen den Systemen. Dafür brauchen wir Leute, die im Workshop zuhören, verstehen, wo es wirklich weh tut, und einen Vorschlag auf den Tisch legen, den man anfassen kann. 2. KI verändert, wie Beratung funktioniert. Ein Prototyp dauert heute Stunden statt Wochen. Wir wollen Kunden nicht erklären, was möglich wäre – wir wollen es ihnen zeigen. Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und gestaltest sie von Anfang an mit. Deine Mission Verstehen, bevor du löst. Du führst Discovery-Workshops mit unseren Kunden: Prozesse, Datenflüsse, Systemlandschaft. Du fragst so lange nach, bis klar ist, wo das eigentliche Problem liegt – und das steht selten im Briefing. Nie mit leeren Händen kommen. Vor dem Workshop baust du eine erste Version. Im Workshop diskutiert ihr am konkreten Beispiel statt an abstrakten Folien. Manchmal iterierst du live, während alle zuschauen. Vibe-Coding als Werkzeug, nicht als Spielerei. Vor allem mit Claude Code baust du in Stunden einen klickbaren Prototyp: ein PIM-Datenmodell, einen Schnittstellen-Mock, einen KI-Agenten, der Produkttexte schreibt. Produktionscode schreiben unsere Devs in Polen. Dein Job ist zu zeigen, was möglich ist. Lösungen skizzieren, die halten. Shop, PIM, ERP, KI – du zeichnest, wer was macht, wo die Daten leben und wie die Systeme miteinander reden. Und du kannst begründen, warum. Die Brücke ins Team. Nach dem Workshop übergibst du an Projektleitung und Entwicklung so, dass alle wissen, was gebaut wird und warum. Bei Pitches bist du dabei, wenn es technisch konkret wird. Du bist unser Mensch, wenn Du verstehst, wie ein Händler tickt: Produktdaten, Bestellungen, Bestände, Kanäle. Ob du aus Beratung, Pre-Sales, Projektleitung oder Entwicklung kommst, ist uns egal. Du technisch wirklich mitreden kannst: Datenmodelle, APIs, Schnittstellen, Systemarchitektur. Produktionscode musst du nicht schreiben. Aber du kannst erklären, warum eine Variante kein eigenes Produkt ist und wann ein Webhook besser ist als der nächtliche CSV-Export. KI-Tools dein Alltag sind, nicht dein Vorsatz fürs nächste Jahr. Du hast damit schon Dinge gebaut, die funktionieren – und zeigst sie uns gern. Du einen Raum führen kannst: acht Leute aus Einkauf, IT und Marketing, drei Meinungen pro Person, und am Ende trotzdem ein Ergebnis. Du Fragen stellst, bevor du Antworten gibst. Es dich nicht nervös macht, Unfertiges zu zeigen. Ein Prototyp ist zum Kaputtmachen da. Du fließend Deutsch (C2) und sehr gut Englisch sprichst – unsere Kunden sitzen im DACH-Raum, unsere Teams in Polen. Pluspunkte sammelst du mit Shopware, Magento oder Shopify, mit PIM- oder ERP-Erfahrung (Pimcore, Akeneo, Odoo, SAP, Business Central) und mit Erfahrung auf Händlerseite. Wir bauen ein offenes Team. Bewirb dich unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Orientierung, Religion oder Behinderung – uns interessiert, was du kannst und wie du denkst. Was du bei uns bekommst Gehalt: abhängig von deiner Erfahrung. Konkrete Zahlen gibt es beim ersten Gespräch, nicht erst nach der dritten Runde. Innovationsbudget für PoCs und eigene Ideen – bewusst als Investment gedacht, nicht als Restposten. Weiterbildungsbudget inklusive Zertifizierungen. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office. Die Arbeit passt sich deinem Leben an, nicht umgekehrt. Büro mit Dachterrasse im TRI München – plus MVV-Ticket, damit du auch hinkommst. MacBook Pro und iPhone , ordentliche Peripherie inklusive. Teamevents in Deutschland und Polen. Epische Trips nach Polen und die legendäre Revanche der polnischen Crew auf der Wiesn. Kaffee, Getränke und Obst. Muss man ja heute dazuschreiben. Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich über unser Bewerbungsformular oder schick deine Unterlagen an ----- Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Viel lieber: ein Link zu etwas, das du mit KI gebaut hast. Darf ruhig unfertig sein. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Account Executive, FSI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p>Anaplan is seeking an <strong>ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE</strong> to drive its growth and expand its FSI presence in Germany</p> <p>In this role, you will take your proven track record of selling sophisticated technology solutions and account management and sell an incredibly versatile platform. Our sales team is helping industry leaders understand the impact of Anaplan products and how our connected planning solution is ending siloed decision-making. You will help our customers achieve their immediate business goals while setting their business up for the future.</p> <p>This role will be a catalyst to Anaplan’s continued growth while leading digital transformation. Reporting directly to the RVP of Sales. You will have mostly greenfield accounts. This type of territory requires someone to further build our footprint by hunting and locking in new logo accounts as well as rapidly growing opportunities within the current customer base.</p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engaging with targeted prospects to identify broken business processes and position Anaplan’s unique ability to solve the problem,</li> <li>Build Anaplan’s business value throughout the selling engagement. Navigating sophisticated prospect environments to align the prospect around the Anaplan solution,</li> <li>Conduct highly effective presentations from Director through SVP and key C-suite level decision makers including CFOs, CROs, and senior leaders in supply chain, workforce, and other business functions,</li> <li>Develop customers and own opportunity management start-to-finish across multiple customer targets and functions,</li> <li>Apply Anaplan’s value-based selling methodology and tools to run sales processes and accurately forecast business,</li> <li>Employ outstanding account leadership skills to identify account expansion opportunities by cross-selling and up-selling opportunities within targeted accounts,</li> <li>Perform strategic sales planning, leading to accurate forecasting of the business,</li> <li>Work with cross-functional members of Sales Development Reps, Marketing, Solution Consultants, and the Customer Success teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in consultative sales to Fortune 2000 companies, ideally in SaaS solutions (but not required)</li> <li>Experience selling into Financial Services in the Germany: growing existing accounts and landing new logos</li> <li>'Hunter' with a strong growth mindset, motivated by developing new business essential</li> <li>Shown success selling into Vice President / Senior Vice President buyers,</li> <li>Track record of overachieving sales quota & targets, including demonstrated history of multiple high six-figure annual contract value (ACV) deals (services and/or software),</li> <li>Demonstrated network in your industry territory, with a mix of some customers and implementation partners,</li> <li>Demonstrated experience with sophisticated partner & internal team organizations,</li> <li>Domain understanding (Supply Chain, FP&A, Workforce Planning & Sales) and knowledge of how these functions plan, process work and make decisions,</li> <li>Strong, demonstrated opportunity management practices (e.g. sales process, qualification, executive presentation skills, quote presentation and negotiation), and ability to balance multiple (3-5) opportunities at once,</li> <li>Business, Finance, Economics, related BS/BA degree or relevant years of experience.</li> <li>Fluency in English and German</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Outreach, SFDC, LinkedIn Sales Navigator a plus,</li> <li>Account Planning experience Altify, MEDDPICC, Miller Heiman.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! </p> <p>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  </p> <p><strong>Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer</strong>  </p> <p>It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. </p> <p>Anaplan does not:  </p> <ul> <li>Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  </li> <li>Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  </li> </ul> <p>All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. title: Curriculum Manager - AI Engineering
description: <p><strong>About DataCamp</strong></p> <p>Data and AI skills are critical for thriving today, and DataCamp is the platform that empowers everyone to learn them. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll combine AI skills, technical expertise, and passion for great didactic experiences to usher in the <a href="https://www.datacamp.com/blog/datacamp-has-acquired-optima">next generation of education</a>. </p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with subject matter experts and leverage in-house-built cutting-edge AI tooling to scale high-quality course creation across AI engineering: building applications with large language models (LLMs), prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and related topics such as evaluation, fine-tuning, guardrails, and LLMOps. Here's what your day-to-day will look like:</p> <ul> <li>Manage the entire content development lifecycle and deadlines.</li> <li>Source and recruit top-tier subject-matter experts as instructors.</li> <li>Collaborate with instructors to create engaging content.</li> <li>Consistently leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and more to drive high-quality content production at scale.</li> <li>Design, review, and create content on LLM application development, prompt and context engineering, RAG and vector databases, agents and tool use, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of AI systems, and related topics. You will review content from a learner perspective, ensuring it is technically accurate, reflects current AI engineering best practices in a fast-moving field, and is pedagogically effective.</li> <li>Continuously assess course performance using learner feedback and engagement data to drive improvements.</li> <li>Identify and prioritize existing curriculum gaps or new topics in DataCamp's AI engineering curriculum.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’re excited about you because you have the following:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A solid hands-on background building and shipping production AI applications as an AI engineer, machine learning engineer, or software engineer. Experience taking LLM-powered systems from prototype to production (e.g. evaluation, monitoring, cost and latency optimization) is a strong plus.</li> <li>Broad AI engineering fluency spanning LLM fundamentals, prompt and context engineering, RAG, agents, and evaluation, with additional depth in at least one area such as agentic systems, retrieval and search, fine-tuning, or LLMOps.</li> <li>A solid technical background in Python, with comfort working with LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic), open-source models and frameworks (e.g. Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex), agentic systems, vector databases, Git, and the command line.</li> <li>Intuitive understanding of instructional design, with proven ability to structure and teach technical concepts clearly.</li> <li>Graduate degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related STEM field—or equivalent industry experience.</li> <li>Strong experience with agentic coding systems, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or Replit. You consider yourself a sophisticated user of these tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus if you have the following:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A deep understanding of the DataCamp course format—you have an intuitive understanding of what makes a great DataCamp course.</li> <li>An existing network of potential subject matter experts who can become DataCamp instructors.</li> <li>An extensive track record of teaching AI engineering to technical audiences.</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Inside Sales Representative (Paris, France)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!</p></div><p>As a Senior Inside Sales Representative, you’ll help retain and grow Figma’s existing customers. You’ll manage renewals and expansion opportunities across an assigned book of business, including accounts where an Account Executive is on leave, territories where we’re hiring, and customers with multiple Figma organizations. You’ll understand how customers work, connect their needs to Figma’s platform and AI capabilities, and guide commercial conversations that reinforce value and address potential reductions in spend. Working closely with Sales and cross-functional partners, you’ll own customer opportunities from discovery through close.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role based out of our Paris hub.</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do at Figma:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Own a book of existing customer business and deliver against quarterly net revenue retention (NRR) targets by retaining revenue, managing contraction risk, and driving expansion</li> <li>Build trusted customer relationships and uncover business objectives, workflows, adoption challenges, and opportunities to deliver greater value</li> <li>Lead renewal cycles end-to-end, from proactive outreach and discovery through negotiation, close, and billing coordination, including for accounts without a dedicated Account Executive</li> <li>Navigate potential contraction and churn conversations by understanding the underlying drivers, reinforcing customer value, and developing a clear path forward</li> <li>Identify and pursue growth opportunities across teams, use cases, and products, including connecting Figma’s AI capabilities to relevant customer workflows</li> <li>Negotiate commercial terms that balance customer needs with Figma’s business objectives, partnering with Sales Managers & Account Executives on more complex opportunities</li> <li>Use account data and customer insights to identify risk and growth signals, maintain accurate pipeline records, and forecast expected outcomes</li> <li>Partner with Account Executives, Sales Leaders, Deal Desk, Legal, Billing, and Support to align account strategy and resolve blockers, and share customer insights to improve how we manage renewals and growth</li> </ul> <h4><strong>We’d love to hear from you if you have:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>1+ year of customer-facing experience in inside sales, account management, renewals, sales development, or a related role, ideally in B2B SaaS</li> <li>Strong discovery and communication skills, including asking thoughtful questions, understanding customer needs, and explaining product value clearly</li> <li>Technical aptitude and curiosity, with the ability to learn a complex platform, understand customer workflows, and connect new capabilities, including AI, to practical outcomes</li> <li>Evidence of influencing customer decisions, handling objections, and taking ownership of measurable results, paired with sound judgment and a collaborative approach to working with internal partners</li> <li>Strong organizational skills, including prioritizing competing customer needs, managing deadlines, and following through across multiple opportunities</li> </ul> <h4><strong>While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Direct ownership of renewals, negotiations, forecasting, or closing against a commercial target</li> <li>Experience identifying expansion opportunities or helping customers adopt new products, AI capabilities, or workflows</li> <li>Experience working with multiple customer stakeholders, including Procurement, Finance, or Legal</li> <li>Experience using Salesforce, Ironclad, or similar tools to manage customer opportunities and deal workflows</li> <li>Familiarity with SaaS subscription models and retention metrics such as GRR and NRR</li> </ul> <p>At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2022-10/EEOC_KnowYourRights_screen_reader_10_20.pdf">equal opportunity workplace</a> - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status<strong>, </strong>or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.</p> <p>We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to <a ---------- These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities. </p> <p>Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to: </p> <ul> <li>Holding interviews in an accessible location</li> <li>Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing</li> <li>Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers</li> <li>Changing the mode or format of interviews </li> </ul> <p>To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.</p> <p>By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with <a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://www.figma.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.figma.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice/" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p><strong>Application limits:</strong> To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:</p> <ul> <li>Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.</li> <li>Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.</li> </ul> <p>Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.</p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases. You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation. What You'll Work On Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites. Sensor integration driven by navigation requirements, including what ground segmentation and traversability estimation need in day, night, and challenging weather. Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse. Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them. Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors. Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control. Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts. New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design. The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack. Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions. Who We're Looking For We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments. Your Background A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proven track record building and deploying navigation on ground mobile robots in the real world (3+ years or equivalent depth). Hands-on experience with mobile robot navigation and path planning: route or local planning, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, costmaps, or recovery behaviors. Understanding of how mapping and localization affect navigation, and the ability to diagnose when a planning issue is actually caused by the map, the state estimate, or robot behavior. Understanding of how lighting, weather, terrain, and sensor limitations affect perception and navigation, with experience developing or validating systems for demanding real-world conditions. Hands-on experience with robotics sensors and hardware, especially LiDAR, IMUs, and cameras. You can investigate issues across software, networking, and hardware boundaries. Experience testing and debugging navigation on physical robots using logs, visualization, simulation, and repeatable field tests. Strong ROS 2, C++, and Python skills. Clear communication of navigation and path-planning design choices and their trade-offs. Willingness to visit customer sites regularly. Nice to Have Experience with legged robots or with more than one robot embodiment. Experience with Nav2 or a comparable navigation framework. Motion prediction or planning among people and vehicles, such as trajectory forecasting or socially aware navigation. Terrain mapping and traversability methods: elevation mapping, learned traversability, or semantic segmentation for navigation. Experience with night-time or all-weather sensing, such as thermal cameras or LiDAR in rain and fog. Background in security, defence, or other safety-critical robotics deployments. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously. title: Senior Response Engineer - Cloudflare Managed Defense Center (CMDC)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></h2> <h2><strong>About the Department</strong></h2> <p><strong>Cloudforce One</strong> is Cloudflare's threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.</p> <p>Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world's largest global networks can provide. The team analyzes these unique data points at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <h2><strong>About INTERDICT</strong></h2> <p><strong>I.N.T.E.R.D.I.C.T.</strong> (Identify, Neutralize, Triage, Engage, Respond, Disrupt, Integrate, Contain, Threat Hunting) is Cloudforce One's unified operational security organization responsible for identifying, analyzing, and responding to threats targeting Cloudflare and its customers. INTERDICT encompasses three main sub-functions:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Cloudflare Managed Defense (CMD):</strong> Network and application security monitoring for 'Under Attack' mitigation support.</li> <li><strong>PhishGuard:</strong> Managed email threat detection and response service.</li> <li><strong>Detection Engineering:</strong> ML model development and detection optimization.</li> </ul> <p>Together, INTERDICT provides comprehensive <strong>24×7×365 protection</strong> across email, application, and network threat surfaces.</p> <h3><strong>Role Summary</strong></h3> <p>As a <strong>Senior Response Engineer</strong> within the Cloudflare Managed Defense Center (CMDC), you will serve as a subject-matter expert and technical escalation point for threat mitigation across Cloudflare’s strategic enterprise customer base. We are looking for an experienced, high-ownership technical leader who excels during high-stakes incidents and is passionate about mentoring others while advancing threat mitigation at scale.</p> <p>CMDC operates 24×7×365. <strong>This role participates in a regional shift rotation and on-call escalation rota including periodic weekend and public-holiday coverage as part of a follow-the-sun model across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.</strong></p> <h3><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the technical lead and incident commander during high-impact, multi-vector security events, designing and deploying bespoke mitigation strategies when standard runbooks do not suffice.</li> <li>Perform deep-dive forensic analysis into complex Layer 3/4 and Layer 7 traffic anomalies, identifying zero-day attack patterns, sophisticated bot networks, and novel evasion techniques.</li> <li>Apply advanced mitigation strategies and filter malicious traffic using Cloudflare’s core security suite, including Magic Transit, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Advanced Rate Limiting.</li> <li>Lead technical communications and incident bridge calls with enterprise C-level executives, principal network engineers, and security teams during critical events, clearly articulating root causes, impact assessments, and remediation paths.</li> <li>Monitor and investigate proactive security alerts across internal telemetry systems to rapidly triage incoming events, assess blast radius, and validate threat severity.</li> <li>Adhere to and champion strict customer SLAs for alert response times, event analysis, and clear executive reporting.</li> <li>Mentor and elevate Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers through structured shadowing, technical post-mortems, and internal training.</li> <li>Partner with internal Engineering and Product teams to translate operational attack trends into prioritized platform enhancements, tool feedback, and automated detection logic.</li> Response (MDR), network engineering, or incident response environment dealing directly with live threat mitigation.</li> <li>Comprehensive knowledge of networking principles and internet infrastructure, including TCP/IP, UDP, ICMP, DNS, BGP routing mechanics, and edge network design.</li> <li>Deep expertise in Layer 7 protocols and web architectures (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, TLS handshakes/ciphers, reverse proxy models, and API security).</li> <li>Experience analyzing network traffic data for anomaly detection and designing, tuning, and executing advanced mitigation strategies against L3/L4 and L7 attacks, including bespoke countermeasures when standard playbooks are insufficient.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in packet capture and network traffic analysis using tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, or tshark to isolate anomalies and dissect malformed or novel payloads.</li> <li>Practical experience analyzing and mitigating security incidents using AI and machine learning tools, paired with the hands-on capability to build and integrate custom tooling that improves operational workflows, accelerates log telemetry analysis, and defends against AI-driven botnets title: Steuerfachkraft für Digitalisierung & KI (m/w/d)
description: Du kennst DATEV aus dem Kanzleialltag und weißt genau, wo Zeit verloren geht: doppelte Eingaben, Nacharbeit, Medienbrüche, unnötige Klickstrecken. Und du hast Lust, das nicht länger hinzunehmen, sondern zu ändern? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir suchen eine Steuerfachkraft für Digitalisierung & KI (m/w/d) für die Nexus Gruppe in Hamburg. Was macht die Nexus Gruppe? Die Nexus Gruppe ist ein Kooperationsverbund eigenständiger Steuerberatungskanzleien in ganz Deutschland. Wir zentralisieren Aufgabenbereiche, die kleinere Kanzleien oftmals nicht vollumfänglich abbilden können: Personalgewinnung, Marketing sowie den Einsatz von KI-Anwendungen. Deine Rolle Du verbindest Kanzleipraxis, DATEV-Erfahrung und Prozessverständnis mit Interesse an KI und Automatisierung. Du stehst im ständigen Austausch mit unseren Partnerkanzleien, nimmst deren Abläufe auf und entwickelst daraus Standardprozesse für den Verbund. Du musst selbst keine Software entwickeln. Die technische Umsetzung übernimmt unser Entwickler. Entscheidend ist, dass du Kanzleiprozesse fachlich verstehst und Anforderungen so beschreiben kannst, dass daraus funktionierende Lösungen entstehen. Wenn du Lust hast, selbst Automatisierungen zu bauen, zeigen wir dir die Werkzeuge dafür. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Praxisbezug: Was ihr entwickelt, wird in den Partnerkanzleien eingesetzt, getestet und weiterentwickelt. Aufgaben Was dich bei der Nexus Gruppe erwartet: Du nimmst bestehende Prozesse in den Kanzleien auf und erkennst, welche Schritte sich durch KI oder Automatisierung sinnvoll unterstützen lassen. Du entwickelst daraus Standardprozesse, die alle Kanzleien im Verbund nutzen können. Du beschreibst fachliche Anforderungen so genau, dass unser Entwickler daraus Automatisierungen, KI-Assistenten und Workflows bauen kann. Du sorgst mit deinem DATEV-Wissen dafür, dass die Lösungen im Kanzleialltag wirklich funktionieren. Du testest neue Lösungen gemeinsam mit den Anwendern in den Kanzleien und bewertest Qualität, Verständlichkeit und Praxistauglichkeit. Du holst Rückmeldungen aus den Kanzleien ein und leitest daraus die nächsten Entwicklungsschritte ab. Du legst fest, wo beim Einsatz von KI fachliche Prüfung nötig bleibt und wo die Grenzen liegen. Du begleitest Einführung, Dokumentation und Schulung in den Partnerkanzleien. Qualifikation Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte/r, Steuerfachwirt/in, Bilanzbuchhalter/in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation. Auch ein anderer Hintergrund ist willkommen, wenn du die Abläufe in Steuerkanzleien aus mehrjähriger Praxis kennst. Du kennst DATEV aus der täglichen Arbeit und verstehst, wie eine Kanzlei organisiert ist. Du hast ein Gespür dafür, wo Nacharbeit, Medienbrüche oder Qualitätsrisiken entstehen. Du interessierst dich für Digitalisierung, KI und Automatisierung und probierst neue Programme gern aus. Du kannst Abläufe klar erklären und strukturiert beschreiben. Benefits Raus aus dem Fristendruck: Du arbeitest nicht mehr Mandate ab, sondern verbesserst die Abläufe, mit denen Kanzleien täglich arbeiten. Intensive und persönliche Einarbeitung: Deine ersten Wochen sind darauf ausgelegt, dir sämtliche Werkzeuge und Kenntnisse an die Hand zu geben, die du für einen erfolgreichen Start benötigst. Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust den Bereich KI & Automatisierung von Beginn an mit auf, mit kurzen Wegen zur Geschäftsführung. Zentrales Office: Unser Büro liegt in Barmbek-Süd, perfekt angebunden an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr, mit eigenem Parkplatz. Erstklassige Ausstattung: Höhenverstellbare Tische, MacBook Pro oder Air sowie hochwertiges Zubehör. Team-Events: Top-Golf, After-Work-Partys oder Segeln auf der Alster: Es steht immer etwas an. Vollstes Vertrauen: Du hast eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe und bekommst von Beginn an vollstes Vertrauen in deine Kompetenz und deine Meinung. Erstklassige Büroausstattung: Neben höhenverstellbaren Tischen startest du bei uns mit einem MacBook Pro oder Air sowie hochwertigem Zubehör. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Qui sommes-nous ? Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Et toutes autres activités liées au développement des projets de la société. HSE : Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via : Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques Qualité : Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs Requirements Votre profil : De formation d’Ingénieur ou Bac + 5, aménagement du territoire, géographie ou immobilier vous avez une expérience professionnelle justifiée de résultats concrets dans la gestion de projets. La connaissance du domaine de l’éolien et/ou de l’énergie est nécessaire (expérience souhaitée de 5 ans). Vous avez pu intervenir sur toutes les phases clefs du développement de projets. Une expérience managériale réussie est indispensable. Bon communiquant.e, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et les relations avec des acteurs externes. Pugnace et autonome, vous avez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles. Vous disposez d’une intelligence situationnelle et vous adhérez aux valeurs de l’entreprise. Rigoureux.se, vous savez gérer vos priorités grâce à de réelles capacités d’analyses. Le poste requiert un excellent rédactionnel en français. Un anglais professionnel est souhaité. Ce poste est basé à Bordeaux et nécessite de nombreux déplacements (permis B obligatoire). Benefits Comment faisons-nous la différence ? Des valeurs fortes et incarnées Un management de proximité Une dynamique d’organisation apprenante Valorisation et développement des compétences Nos avantages sociaux : Flexibilité et bien-être : jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail et flexibilité des horaires 4 jours de congés par an offerts pour des actions de bénévolat L’abondement de vos dons aux associations à hauteur de 500€ par an Forfait mobilité durable pour les déplacements en mobilité douce (vélo...) ou en covoiturage et aides à l’écomobilité Titres restaurants (10€ pris en charge à hauteur de 5,5€ par la société) Activités et évènements régulièrement proposés par le CSE Très bonne couverture mutuelle (famille incluse) et Prévoyance Nous concourrons à créer un environnement professionnel fondé sur le respect, l'inclusion et la bienveillance, en réunissant des personnes d'horizons différents pour qu'elles nous apportent des idées novatrices et de nouvelles perspectives. Convaincu.e.s que la diversité est une richesse, nous veillons à offrir un processus de recrutement accessible et équitable. A compétences égales, toutes les candidatures sont étudiées avec la même attention. Si vous avez besoin d'un aménagement lors du recrutement, n'hésitez pas à nous en faire part, notre référente handicap pourra vous accompagner en toute confidentialité. title: Principal, Life Sciences Strategy Consulting
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About Us</span></strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At </span><strong><span data-contrast="auto">BGBx</span></strong><span data-contrast="auto">, we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a  meaningful impact at BGBx. </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p></div><p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>As a Principal, you’ll lead engagements that help the world’s top biopharma companies make critical commercial decisions. You’ll guide teams, shape strategy, and deliver work that drives real impact-from market opportunity assessments to competitive positioning and product commercialization.</p> <p>You’ll be a trusted partner to clients and a key contributor to our practice’s growth-scoping new opportunities, building relationships, and helping shape the future of our consulting offering.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be responsible for balancing project management, project delivery, and business development responsibilities</li> <li>Serve as a strategy and thought partner to clients and senior officers of the firm</li> <li>Utilize IxI technology products and client provided information to develop conclusions and recommendations (written and verbal)</li> <li>Work with senior members of the team to scope and develop proposals for new projects</li> <li>Engage in practice planning discussions, including practice strategy and marketing</li> <li>Analyze research and data to uncover insights and build smart, usable recommendations</li> <li>Craft compelling, client-ready presentations that tell clear, powerful stories</li> <li>Collaborate across disciplines - working with creatives, behavioral scientists, and technologists</li> <li>Contribute to business development by building proposals and nurturing client relationships</li> <li>Help shape our practice by engaging in strategic planning and marketing initiatives</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>7-8 years of life sciences consulting experience, ideally at a top consulting firm or life sciences data organization</li> <li>BA/BS required; MBA or Master’s in a related field preferred</li> <li>Strong data analyst and synthesis skills-you connect dots others miss</li> <li>Proven leadership across multiple workstreams and teams</li> <li>Excellent communication and people management skills</li> <li>Foreign language skills a plus, but not required</li> <li>A self-starting, collaborative mindset-you lead with curiosity and clarity</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Join Us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Small team energy, big company support-backed by BGB and Kx</li> <li>High-impact work, early responsibility-you’ll contribute from day one</li> <li>A learning-first culture-mentorship, peer support, and space to grow</li> <li>A genuinely fun, curious environment-we take the work seriously, not ourselves</li> <li>Strategy meets creativity-where insight, brand, and behavior collide</li> <li>A future-facing mission-everything we do aims to improve lives</li> </ul> <p>If you're ready to bring curiosity, strategy, and creativity together to reimagine healthcare-and make a real difference to people’s lives, let’s talk. </p> <p><strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}">Salary: £125,000-£140,000 base, plus bonus eligibility</span></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>At BGBx, we invest in our people because exceptional talent drives exceptional work. We provide a competitive rewards package designed to support your health, well-being, professional growth, and life outside of work.</p> <p>Our benefits package for full-time employees typically includes health care insurance, retirement plans, generous paid time off and holidays, wellness benefits, life insurance, learning and development opportunities, and other resources that support our employees throughout their careers.  Additional benefits may be available based on your location.  Beyond benefits, you'll find a culture built on collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on healthcare and the people it serves.</p> <p><em><span data-contrast="none">BGBx is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status or any category or class of person protected by law.</span></em><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Programme Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>As Senior Programme Manager at Mews, you’ll run several high-visibility programmes that cut across departments, working alongside senior leaders on their hardest problems and taking responsibility for turning their decisions into changes people use in their day-to-day work. This is a new role, so you’ll help set how projects are run here instead of stepping into an existing way of working. Mews is a global hospitality technology company, so the scope is wide and the pace is fast.</p> <p>You’ll partner with department leads and senior stakeholders across the business. Most of the people you deliver through won’t report to you, so the work depends on clear plans, clear decisions and the trust of the teams involved.</p> <p>Programmes that cross departments tend to fail in familiar places: dependencies nobody owns, a status that reads green until it suddenly doesn’t, and changes that are delivered but never adopted. This role exists so initiatives land on time, in scope and in a way that shows up in how people work.</p> <h4>What you would do</h4> <ul> <li>Run strategic, cross-departmental initiatives end to end, from roadmap and scope through to delivery and adoption</li> <li>Build project plans covering scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies and decisions, and deliver on time and in scope</li> <li>Manage several complex projects at once and keep priorities clear across them</li> <li>Present project data to senior stakeholders, flag risks early, and run the communication that gets a change adopted, then measure whether it was</li> <li>Use AI to draft plans, status updates and risk logs, set the checks they pass before reaching stakeholders, and share templates other project managers can reuse</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 3:</strong> In this role that means you have changed how project work gets done with AI, such as how plans, status and risks are captured and reported across several projects, beyond saving yourself time. You have built templates or workflows that other project managers or teams now use. And you check what the AI gives you against the underlying dates, owners and data, question summaries that look too clean, and apply stricter checks when the audience is senior leadership.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to <a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/external/YWI5ZGUyMGQ3MjU2NGRmNjlkZGEyYTg2NTVmZGE0OTU">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></p> <h4>What you would bring</h4> <ul> <li>Extensive experience managing complex, cross-functional projects, ideally in SaaS or another fast-growth environment</li> <li>A track record of building and running project plans, managing stakeholder expectations and delivering business results</li> <li>Experience working with executive leadership across departments, and excellent written and spoken English</li> <li>Good judgement with project data, the ability to visualise and explain it, and working knowledge of project management tools and frameworks</li> <li>AI Fluency Level 3 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you have redesigned how projects are run with AI, built approaches others follow, and verify what it gives you</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to have</h4> <ul> <li>Experience in hospitality technology</li> <li>Change management experience, including communication and stakeholder engagement plans</li> <li>Experience contributing to project management standards, templates or a PMO</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">UK</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£64,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£77,000 GBP</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">United States </div><div class="pay-range"><span>$101,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$129,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>Pay Transparency at Mews</strong></h4> <p>Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.</p> <p>This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.</p> <h4><strong>Life at Mews</strong></h4> <p>We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.</p> <p>We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Insurance Broker Partner Manager - Nederland (m/f/x)
description: Jouw rol bij Eye Security Je werft nieuwe verzekeringsbrokerpartners, begeleidt hen tijdens de onboarding en beheert relaties met zowel bestaande als nieuwe brokerpartners. Samen met hen verkoop je onze cyberverzekeringen. Je bent het vaste aanspreekpunt voor onze broker partners. Je zorgt dat zij tevreden zijn en dat de samenwerking aansluit bij de doelstellingen van Eye Security. Je legt de basis voor een succesvolle samenwerking en de verdere ontwikkeling van onze zakelijk relaties met partners. Je ondersteunt onze partners gedurende het hele traject, van contractopstelling tot het sluiten van deals. Je ontwikkelt en houdt presentaties, webinars en stelt hulpmiddelen beschikbaar om de brokers efficiënt hun werk te kunnen laten doen. Je presenteert onze verzekeringen op beurzen en evenementen. Je bouwt nauwe en constructieve samenwerkingen met je collega’s van Sales en Marketing Wat je meebrengt voor deze rol Je bent ervaren in distributie, marketplaces, verzekeringsbemiddeling of resellerkanalen. Je hebt analytische skills en brengt ruime ervaring in strategische planning. Je hebt een ondernemende, hands-on mentaliteit en bent een team player die streeft naar het vinden van oplossingen. Je bent vloeiend in Nederlands en Engels (in spraak en schrift). Je bent sterk in het bouwen van relaties, het geven van presentaties, communicatie en onderhandelen. Je bent gewend aan het werken met ambitieuze targets. Je beschikt al over een begrip van het cybersecurityveld en bent instaat om deze te integreren bij partners/ klanten/ service models. Je bent bereid om 60% van de tijd te reizen. Wat wij bieden Je wordt onderdeel van de snelst groeiende cybersecurity scale-ups in Europa. De kans om mee te bouwen aan een unieke productlijn waarin cybersecurity en cyberverzekering wereldwijd samenkomen. Een aantrekkelijk salaris met bonusregeling. Een autovergoeding MacBook of Windows laptop, plus een iPhone of Samsung van de zaak. Bij Eye Security staan jouw persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling centraal. We ondersteunen je actief in je verdere groei. Je werkt samen met internationaal toonaangevende cybersecurityspecialisten in ons CERT. Regelmatige bijeenkomsten met het hele bedrijf, waar je elkaar persoonlijk kunt ontmoeten, kunt samenwerken en sterke teamrelaties opbouwt. title: Merchant Risk Analyst
description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. title: Research Lead, Evaluations
description: About Black Forest Labs We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world. Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use. Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next. Why This Role BFL’s research organization is split into different focus areas, such as pre-training, post-training, reinforcement learning, data, representation learning, evaluations and more. During the day to day work, researchers from these different focus areas work together to solve exciting and hard problems towards solving visual intelligence. Having the right means to measure what matters is the central starting point for every research project. Researchers make decisions based on the outcomes of evaluations. The right decision can only be made if an evaluation is precise and accurate. As the Evaluations Lead you’re the core driver to ensure that. Central responsibilities include building our eval roadmap in collaboration with the research and product teams, managing and extending our evaluation team, and cross-functional work with project leads to make sure each research project has the best evaluation toolbox to help the people working on it to make the right decisions. Finally, you’re responsible for growing the people in your team and maintain an eye on their long term development during the daily project work. What You’ll Work On Defining what we evaluate: You are the core driver to create, maintain and extend our evaluations roadmap by collaborating with the product and other research leads who provide the required input. Defining how we evaluate: You’ll work with the team to implement our evals roadmap. This includes building new evals. Both benchmarks and the necessary objective functions, involving both automated, AI-based, and human evaluations. Minimizing noise in our eval pipeline: Developing frontier AI system requires the most accurate means to measure what matters! You will ensure that results are reproducible and trustworthy, that we understand the error bars behind them and that we measure what we want to measure. Understanding what we cannot measure: You’re responsible for highlighting and clearly communicate limitations of each individual evaluation and you will support our project teams to ensure that their chosen set of evaluations has no blind spots in when combined. **** Observing training runs and visualizing important findings: You will help with monitoring our most critical training runs from an independent standpoint to ensure that regressions and emerging capabilities are caught early and are clearly communicated. Managing our evals team: Your role is a hands-on management role - you’re responsible for growing the team and the people in it. You will define our hiring roadmap and make sure that each team member can grow within BFL, both in terms of their technical skillset and their career. What We’re Looking For Proven eval experience: You’ve previously designed, run and maintained large and complex evaluation suites for frontier AI systems, involving various kinds of evaluation methods involving both human and automated (both with or without AI) approaches. Strong research background: You should have proven experience of designing and implementing evaluations for AI research. Strong understanding of Python is required. A strong understanding of agentic coding is a must. Experience as a people manager: One of your core responsibilities will be to grow the team and its members. Understanding what it means to lead a team and how it’s different from an IC role is a must. You should have actively managed a team for at least one year. Strong understanding in statistics and good judgement about numbers: You should be familiar with variance, confidence intervals and significance testing. You should be able to identify and resolve situations when blindly trusting numbers leads to wrong conclusions. title: AI Scientist - Domain Expert Crashworthiness
description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. About the job Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in crashworthiness simulations to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering. You will work at the intersection of industrial simulation, physics modeling, machine learning, and engineering workflows. Your role is to bring deep solid-mechanics expertise into the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of AI Physics Models for real engineering use cases. This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who understands industrial structural simulation not only conceptually, but through direct experience with simulation models, solver workflows, data generation, validation, and engineering decision-making. You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics. Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems. What you will do Work with our research team to define, generate, and iteratively improve simulation datasets for training and evaluating crashworthiness foundation models, balancing coverage of relevant physical scenarios, simulation fidelity, and computational cost. Design and run high-fidelity simulation campaigns using structural mechanics solvers such as Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Ansys Mechanical, Radioss or equivalent tools. Define the relevant variation space for training data: geometry, mesh resolution, material behavior, boundary conditions, loading, contact, joints, failure modes, and engineering KPIs. Build or guide automated pipelines for simulation setup, execution, post-processing, dataset creation, and model evaluation. Work with research teams to train and evaluate AI models on simulation data, and diagnose failure modes caused by data gaps, poor coverage, numerical artifacts, or model limitations. Evaluate model outputs against industrial engineering needs, including field-level accuracy, scalar KPIs, deformation modes, load paths, energy absorption, stress/strain fields, failure indicators, uncertainty, and out-of-domain behavior. Work with industrial customers to understand their simulation workflows and engineering priorities, define use cases and success criteria, and incorporate their feedback into model development and validation. About you You have deep expertise in crashworthiness, solid mechanics, and structural mechanics, with substantial experience in industrial simulation workflows. You have a Master’s degree or equivalent technical depth in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, civil/structural engineering, computational mechanics, applied physics, or a related field. You have 4+ years of relevant industrial experience (or PhD +1 years) in domains such as automotive, aerospace, and consumer electronics. You have hands-on experience with explicit dynamics for crash or impact simulation and understand nonlinear FEM and related topics such as contact, plasticity, structural dynamics, buckling, material modeling, fracture/damage, fatigue, crashworthiness, or durability. You have direct experience with simulation validation, correlation, model quality, numerical sensitivity, and engineering KPI definition. You are a strong Python developer who can build and maintain reliable tools for simulation automation, data processing, and model evaluation. You apply sound software engineering practices, including version control with Git, automated testing, code review, and clear documentation. You have hands-on experience working in Linux and HPC environments, including submitting and monitoring batch jobs, selecting appropriate compute resources, and troubleshooting simulation workflows. You can run simulation campaigns efficiently across a compute cluster. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous technical environments and turning poorly defined industrial problems into scoped datasets, experiments, metrics, and execution plans. You communicate clearly with both deep technical experts and non-specialist stakeholders. Have contributed to reusable internal tools, open-source code, simulation automation frameworks, or production-quality engineering workflows. Have experience working directly with industrial customers, product teams, or engineering decision-makers. Have publications, patents, internal technical leadership, or recognized contributions in engineering, simulation, computational mechanics, or ML-for-physics communities. TEAMSPIRIT & TEAMEVENTS: Freu dich auf eine kollegiale Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien, jede Menge Spaß und großartigem Teamspirit sowie regelmäßige Teamevents wie gemeinsame Sportsessions, Grillabende oder einfach nur ein Feierabenddrink an deiner Station. AUSTAUSCHPROGRAMM: Tausche deinen Arbeitsplatz mit einem deiner europaweiten Kolleg:innen und arbeite bis zu vier Wochen im Jahr an den schönsten Orten Europas. CAMPER BUDGET: Du bekommst eine jährliche Freimiete für unsere Camper, damit du den #happyroadsurfing Lifestyle selbst erleben kannst. JOBRAD: Bleibe fit mit unserem Angebot eines Jobrads. DISCOUNTS : Nutze unsere Corporate Benefits Plattform, die Travel Industry Card und Family & Friends Rabatte Die Rolle – deine Leidenschaft Deine Aufgaben als Standortleitung bei roadsurfer Standortentwicklung : Gemeinsam mit den zentralen Fachabteilungen und deinem Team baust du eigenverantwortlich unseren Standort auf und sicherst den reibungslosen Ablauf des Tagesgeschäfts. Prozessoptimierung : Du unterstützt die Umsetzung und Anpassung bestehender Standards und bringst aktiv eigene Ideen zur Verbesserung ein, z. B. bei der Koordination von Fahrzeugübergaben und -rücknahmen. Internationale Zusammenarbeit : Du stehst in regelmäßigem Austausch mit roadsurfer-Teams in anderen Ländern und trägst zur stetigen Verbesserung unserer Prozesse bei. Teamführung : Als Teamleiter/in förderst du dein Team durch strukturiertes Onboarding, gezielte Aufgabenplanung und regelmäßige Feedbacks. Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für eine hohe Qualität unserer Services. Eigenverantwortliches Recruiting : Du übernimmst den Aufbau deines Teams und findest die richtigen Talente, die deine Begeisterung für roadsurfer teilen. Flottenmanagement : Du behältst den Überblick über unsere Fahrzeugflotte am Standort, sorgst für deren einwandfreien Zustand und stimmst dich eng mit lokalen Servicepartnern ab. Kundenberatung : Als Experte für unsere Produkte – myroadsurfer, abo, spots und rent – stehst du Kunden beratend zur Seite und schickst sie als happy roadsurfer auf die Straßen Europas. Was du brauchst, um mit uns auf einer Welle zu surfen Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium in einem relevanten Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Mindestens 2-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in den Bereichen Autovermietung, Tourismus oder verwandten Feldern; wir freuen uns auch über Quereinsteiger. Erste Erfahrung in der Teamführung ist von Vorteil – wichtig sind uns vor allem Empathie und eine unterstützende Führungshaltung. Eine ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung sowie Freude an einer offenen und freundlichen Kommunikation Hands-on-Mentalität und Lust auf eine abwechslungsreiche Rolle, in der du auch pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert agierst Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Führerschein Klasse B Dein Gehalt Wir ❤️ Transparenz. Das Gehaltsband für diese Position liegt zwischen 37.000 EUR und 45.000 EUR brutto jährlich. Wir führen aktuell Gehaltsbänder in unseren Stellenbeschreibungen ein, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Sobald wir uns im Bewerbungsprozess besser kennenlernen und deine Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen noch genauer einschätzen können, finden wir gemeinsam heraus, welche Stufe innerhalb des Gehaltsbands am besten zu dir passt. In einem jährlichen Feedbackgespräch wird dein Gehalt mindestens einmal im Jahr überprüft. Bereit zu surfen? Du bist für die Aufgabe wie gemacht? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Für Rückfragen kannst du dich auch gerne jederzeit an ----- wenden, und wir melden uns schnellstmöglich bei dir zurück. ABOUT #ROADSURFER We are more than Europe's largest campervan rental company. In 2021 we launched our platform roadsurfer spots in addition to our other products rent, abo and sales – a platform where you can discover and book unique camping spots. But that’s only the beginning. We are growing fast, so hop on board and join us on our journey. The roadsurfer philosophy is simple: rent an RV, start your adventure, be happy. title: Multibody Dynamics Analyst
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. We want you as a talented and experienced Mechanism Engineer to help us in our mission by designing, manufacturing, testing and delivering, fully inhouse mechanisms for Nyx. The candidate will be responsible for performing multibody dynamic simulation analysis and structural analysis for components and systems. They’ll need a strong understanding of kinematics, statics, material mechanics, stress, and mass properties. Key Responsibilities Own the multibody dynamic analysis across the Nyx program to drive design aspects of the program and systems/subsystems teams. Model, simulate, and verify the Nyx vehicle level separation kinematics/dynamics from the launch vehicle, as well as the capsule to service module separation. Perform kinematic analysis of deployment, release, and articulated systems, including motion envelopes, clearances, and interference checks. Support testing and use test data to correlate simulation models. Perform Finite Element Model (FEM) analysis on various subsystems and their components to assess strength, stiffness, and margins of safety. Perform acceleration, shock, and random and sine vibration, and derive environmental requirements for components. Document analysis results in clear reports and present them at design reviews and to stakeholders. Develop reusable analysis methods, tools, and automation for current and future programs. What we would love to see from you In the role as Mechanical Analysis Engineer ideally, you will have the following: MSc or PhD in Mechanical, Aerospace, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience. At least 5 years of professional experience in mechanical analysis, preferably in aerospace, space, or automotive. Demonstrated expertise in multibody dynamics and kinematics using tools such as MSC Adams, Matlab Simscape, or Modelica Proficiency in FEA for linear and nonlinear structural analysis, using tools such as Hypermesh, MSC Nastran, Abaqus, or Ansys. Solid understanding of statics, dynamics, material mechanics, stress analysis, and mass properties. Experience with shock, vibration, and acoustic analysis, including random vibration and shock response spectrum (SRS) methods. Experience correlating simulation models with test data. Skills and Behaviors Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong analysis and problem-solving skills. Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks. Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done. Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.
