Kampagnen & Aktionen: Kreative Mitgestaltung und Umsetzung von Produktlaunches, Gewinnspielen und saisonalen Kampagnen. Das bringst du mit Studium: Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in im Bereich Marketing, Medien, Kommunikation, Social Media, BWL oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang und suchst ein sechsmonatiges Pflichtpraktikum in Vollzeit. Content Creation: Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Reels, Videos und Social-Media-Inhalten und weißt, wie du Content ansprechend inszenierst. Kameraaffinität: Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl, trittst selbstbewusst auf und hast Spaß daran, Menschen mit deiner Persönlichkeit zu begeistern. Ästhetisches Gespür: Du begeisterst dich für Interior, Design und Lifestyle und hast ein gutes Auge für Bildkompositionen, Farben und visuelle Trends. Design- & Editing-Tools: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Tools wie CapCut, Canva oder Adobe Photoshop und bringst idealerweise auch Kenntnisse in Figma mit. KI-Affinität: Du bist offen für den Einsatz von KI-Tools und hast Interesse daran, KI-gestützte Prozesse und kreative Anwendungen, beispielsweise in der Content-Erstellung, aktiv zu nutzen und weiterzuentwickeln. Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist offen, kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne proaktiv auf Menschen zu. Eigeninitiative & Ergebnisorientierung: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, setzt sie selbstständig um und hast den Ehrgeiz, damit messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Organisation: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick. Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und fühlst dich in einem internationalen Team wohl. Das erwartet dich bei uns Hohe Eigenverantwortung & kreative Freiheit: Du gestaltest unseren Social-Media-Auftritt aktiv mit, setzt eigene Ideen um und erhältst regelmäßiges Feedback und fachliche Unterstützung durch deinen Teamlead. Kurze Entscheidungswege: Wir sind ein entscheidungsfreudiges Team, das gerne Neues ausprobiert und Ideen schnell in die Tat umsetzt. Ambitioniertes & ergebnisorientiertes Team: Wir setzen uns klare Ziele, übernehmen Verantwortung und arbeiten gemeinsam daran, messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Steile Lernkurve: Du sammelst wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in Social Media, Content Creation, Influencer Marketing und E-Commerce. Modernes, digitales Arbeitsumfeld: Wir arbeiten mit aktuellen Technologien, modernen Tools und KI-gestützten Prozessen. Zentrale Lage in Stuttgart: Unser Büro liegt mitten in der Stadt und bietet moderne Arbeitsplätze, höhenverstellbare Tische, Tischkicker, Spielekonsole, Küche und kostenlose Getränke. Regelmäßige Team-Events: Gemeinsame Aktivitäten und ein offenes, freundschaftliches Miteinander gehören bei uns dazu. Faire Vergütung: Dein Einsatz wird bei uns wertgeschätzt und fair vergütet. Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams! B. Reels, Videos, Fotos oder Social-Media-Projekte) Optional: Links zu eigenen Social-Media-Profilen oder bereits betreuten Accounts Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! title: Forward Deployed Engineering Manager
description: <p>As the Forward Deployed Engineering Manager, you will lead the team that puts Auterion's robotic systems to work with customers in the field. We build complete systems: vehicles, sensors, onboard compute, radio links, autonomy software, and ground control. Your job is to understand how all of it fits together and to make it work in real missions.</p> <p>You will lead your team through the entire customer engagement, from discovery and integration to field trials and handover. You are not a hardware specialist. You are a systems engineer who can trace a problem across every layer of the system, lead people well, and earn the trust of demanding customers.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Team Leadership & Mentorship:</strong> Lead and grow a cross-functional team of Forward Deployed Engineers covering systems integration and software. Hire, coach, and develop your engineers. Build a culture of ownership and proactive problem-solving.</li> <li><strong>Accountability:</strong> Keep the bar high for yourself and your team. Work directly with stakeholders across the company. You will have a close relationship with the CTO, CEO, VP of Engineering, and the engineering directors.</li> <li><strong>Field Deployment Oversight:</strong> Own technical delivery of customer deployments in demanding, non-standard environments. This covers system configuration, connectivity, mission readiness, and operation under environmental constraints.</li> <li><strong>System Integration:</strong> Act as the technical lead for high-stakes customer integrations. Ensure the full system works end to end: vehicle, payloads, onboard compute, communication links, autonomy software, and ground control.</li> <li><strong>Field Troubleshooting:</strong> Diagnose failures across hardware, firmware, software, and communications. Use logs, telemetry, and structured debugging to find root causes fast.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:</strong> Serve as the primary technical contact for defense and enterprise customers. Translate operational requirements into deployment plans that account for system performance, link quality, power, and mission constraints. Run technical meetings, demos, and field days.</li> <li><strong>Feedback Loop & Release Coordination:</strong> Work closely with Product and R&D to feed field results and real-world edge cases back into the product. Coordinate with R&D on platform releases so customer deployments stay current and stable.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications and Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Systems Engineering:</strong> 7+ years in technical roles in robotics, drones, autonomous vehicles, or comparable complex embedded systems. You understand the full system end to end and how a change in one subsystem affects the others.</li> <li><strong>Leadership Experience:</strong> 3+ years managing a technical, customer-facing team (Field Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects, or similar). You have dealt with underperformance and built team culture deliberately.</li> <li><strong>Software Skills:</strong> Comfortable working in Linux. You write Python, read C++, and use Git. You debug from logs and telemetry, not only at the bench.</li> <li><strong>Hardware Fluency:</strong> You understand hardware at integration level: power, sensors, interfaces, and RF basics. You do not need to be a hardware designer.</li> <li><strong>Field Deployment Expertise:</strong> Hands-on experience with field-deployed systems where "turning it off and on again" isn't always an option. Understanding of networking and radio communication is a major plus.</li> <li><strong>Crisis Management:</strong> Proven ability to troubleshoot critical failures in the field under high pressure and with limited physical access to the hardware.</li> <li><strong>Customer Presence:</strong> Composure and credibility in front of demanding customers. You communicate clearly with engineers and decision-makers alike.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluent English. German is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Work Authorization:</strong> Must hold EU citizenship and be eligible to work in the European Union without restriction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, or ROS2</li> <li>Background in defense or government programs</li> <li>Eligibility for German security clearance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Flexible working hours</li> <li>Stock Options</li> <li>Generous holiday allowance</li> <li>Pension plan </li> <li>Extended social security package </li> <li>Enhanced maternity & paternity leave</li> <li>Wellpass membership </li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Auterion</strong></h3> <p>We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.</p> <p>At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Customer Analyst
description: <p>At Dexory, we're developing advanced software powered by cutting-edge robots that are transforming the very face of global logistics. With infectious enthusiasm, our unique blend of disciplines work in harmony to produce results at pace. From hardware and manufacturing to software, AI and commercial, we're one team – one heart – that beats, learns and grows together.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Take your customer analysis out of the dashboard and onto the warehouse floor.</strong></p> <p>As an experienced <strong>Senior Customer Analyst </strong>you already know how to find the story in customer data: segments, drivers of churn, usage patterns, voice-of-customer signals. Here, you'll pair that with what you see first-hand in live warehouses, then use both to decide which product bets Dexory makes.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Get to the "why" behind the numbers.</strong> Run contextual inquiry, operator and manager interviews, surveys, card sorts, and prototype and usability tests across every stage of deployment and every persona.</li> <li><strong>Check site behaviour against behaviour at scale.</strong> Combine what you observe on site with Pendo and DexoryView usage data, so no insight rests on one warehouse or one dashboard.</li> <li><strong>Validate or kill ideas quickly.</strong> Pressure-test concepts with A/B tests, prototype tests and interviews, and tell the team whether a bet solves a real problem.</li> <li><strong>Close the loop after go-live.</strong> Log structured operator and site-manager feedback, pass it to the PM, and keep it in the research repository.</li> <li><strong>Size the opportunity.</strong> Support market sizing and competitive mapping for specific themes.</li> <li><strong>Turn findings into decisions.</strong> Write clear, presentation-ready syntheses and share them through Notion and Slack, internally and externally.</li> <li><strong>Run the insight machinery.</strong> Maintain SurveyMonkey dashboards, co-maintain the research insights pipeline, and feed capacity and progress data into the shared operating dashboard.</li> <li><strong>Shape how we work with AI.</strong> Co-design the AI enablement playbook for research, covering workflows, prompts, guardrails, and what stays human-only versus human-in-the-loop.</li> <li><strong>Give the user a voice.</strong> Co-develop UX content with the Lead and Commercial team.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>2-4 years in research, qual/quant insight, or product/bet design</li> <li>Solid grounding in qualitative and quantitative methods, and the judgement to know which one a question needs</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, from open question through to early product bet</li> <li>Fluency with tools like Notion, SurveyMonkey, Slack, Pendo and Basecamp</li> <li>Strong written and verbal synthesis</li> <li>Field experience in warehouses, logistics, manufacturing, healthcare operations or similar, and comfort on a warehouse floor</li> <li>UX content skills, including capturing the voice of the user</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><em>*We value the right attitude, humility and we're as interested in your character as we are in your talent. Please apply, even if you feel you only meet part of our listed criteria. Diversity drives innovation and we offer an international and friendly work environment with an energetic company culture.</em></p> <p> </p> <h4><strong>Benefits</strong></h4> <p>Starting from the interview process and continuing into your career with us, you will be working by our four Operating Principles:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Performance:</strong> High standards, outstanding results,</li> <li><strong>Impact:</strong> Big challenges, bigger results</li> <li><strong>Commitment:</strong> All in, every time</li> <li><strong>One team:</strong> One mission, shared success</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Joining Dexory isn’t just about having expertise… it’s about embracing uncertainty with purpose. You’ll</p> <p>help define not only our products, but the future of autonomous logistics itself. From day one, you’ll be</p> <p>trusted to push boundaries, take ownership, and deliver breakthrough results.</p> <p>You’ll also receive:</p> <p> </p> <p>You will also receive:</p> <ul> <li>Share options</li> <li>Private healthcare via Bupa with 24/7 medical helpline </li> <li>Life insurance</li> <li>Income protection </li> <li>Pension: 4+% employee with option to opt into salary exchange, 5% employer</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme - mental wellbeing, financial and legal advice/support </li> <li>25 holidays per year </li> <li>Full meals onsite in Wallingford</li> <li>Fun team events on and offsite, snacks of all kinds in the office </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>AAP/EEO Statement  </strong></p> <p>Dexory provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. title: Systems Engineer, MAPS
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <p>New York, NY<br>Washington, DC<br>Toronto</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare’s architecture is built on a homogeneous edge: every server in over 330 cities runs every service—from L4/L7 proxies (FL2, Pingora) and DNS to the Workers runtime, cache, and storage. While this design maximizes hardware utilization, it creates a difficult distributed attribution problem. Machine-level telemetry tells us how loaded a server is, but not which product, customer, or upstream service is responsible for that load.</p> <p><br>MAPS (Metrics and Analytics for Product Segmentation) is a newly formed team building the core instrumentation, collection, and data platform to solve this from the ground up. We are architecting a system to continuously measure CPU, network bandwidth, memory, and storage utilization across the entire global fleet without sampling—attributing resource consumption both to the underlying system service and to the specific product, account, and zone being served.</p> <p><br>The data MAPS produces serves two critical functions at Cloudflare:</p> <ol> <li>Real-Time Control Plane: MAPS is the primary telemetry input for Cloudflare’s next-generation global load balancer, shifting traffic management from open-loop heuristics to closed-loop routing driven by real-time, per-service resource capacity and consumption (within seconds).</li> <li>Fleet Economics & Capacity Planning: MAPS provides the long-term analytical dataset in ClickHouse used to map product demand forecasts to physical hardware requirements, calculate true cost-to-serve per product, and drive multi-year infrastructure investments.</li> </ol> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <p>You will work across the full lifecycle of a greenfield, high-throughput telemetry system running on every machine at the Cloudflare edge:</p> <ul> <li>Host-Level Instrumentation ("Outside View"): Build and maintain low-overhead Linux daemons (netacctd, maps_collector) in Rust and C that use eBPF (cgroup_skb) and cgroup v2 accounting to measure per-service resource consumption directly from the kernel.</li> <li>High-Performance Client Libraries ("Inside View"): Architect non-blocking, zero-allocation reporting SDKs in Rust and Go used by Cloudflare’s highest-throughput data-plane services to report per-request resource usage and product attribution over local Unix domain sockets.</li> <li>Edge Aggregation & Streaming: Build the per-machine collector daemon that ingests millions of events per second, performs bounded in-memory time-window aggregation, serves low-latency gRPC streams to the global load balancer, and flushes batch rollups to ClickHouse.</li> <li>Reconciliation & Correctness: Solve complex attribution problems—such as reconciling kernel-level cgroup measurements against application-reported metrics, and attributing resource usage when one multi-tenant service executes work on behalf of another.</li> <li>Cross-Team Architecture: Partner directly with the engineering teams behind Cloudflare’s core proxies, runtimes, and storage engines to instrument their critical paths without degrading tail latency.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>Strong systems programming experience in Rust, Go, or C, with a solid grasp of memory layout, concurrency, and performance-critical code paths.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating latency- and resource-sensitive server infrastructure or high-throughput data pipelines at scale.</li> <li>Strong fundamentals in Linux systems internals—processes, cgroups, sockets, and how the kernel accounts for compute, memory, and I/O.</li> <li>Proven ability to work across organizational boundaries: reading unfamiliar codebases, aligning with other infrastructure teams, and driving complex integrations to completion.</li> <li>A pragmatic approach to owning outcomes—from kernel-level data collection and wire protocols (protobuf/Cap'n Proto) all the way to the analytical tables consumers query.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience writing and verifying eBPF programs, or deep familiarity with the Linux networking stack and scheduler.</li> <li>Experience designing schemas and query patterns for distributed columnar databases (particularly ClickHouse) at high ingestion rates.</li> <li>Background in profiling, benchmarking, and debugging performance bottlenecks in production Linux environments (perf, PMU counters, flamegraphs).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

<p>Engineers in this role typically develop depth in one of two areas:</p> <ol> <li>Analytical database systems: Building and operating our ClickHouse-based analytical platform, improving database systems owned by your team.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>At least three years of professional software engineering experience building backend, infrastructure, database, or distributed-data systems.</li> <li>Strong Go programming skills, or substantial systems programming experience (Rust, C++) with the ability to become productive in Go quickly.</li> <li>Experience problems.</li> <li>Clear communication and an ability to collaborate across engineering and product teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Demonstrated depth in at least one of the following areas:</strong></p> systems, event-driven architectures, data pipelines, API development, or customer-facing data integrations.</li> </ul> <h2>Helpful Experience</h2> <ul> <li>ClickHouse or another large-scale analytical <li>Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux container technologies.</li> <li>Contributions to open-source database or distributed-systems projects.</li> </ul> <p>If you enjoy building efficient systems, understanding how they behave in production, and solving data problems at global scale, we would like to hear from you.</p> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - €91,000.</li> <li>For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000.</li> <li>For title: Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, France
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact Lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base. You’ll own the team’s post-sale operating model across onboarding, adoption, value realisation and expansion, while staying directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and growth opportunities. Build practical playbooks, portfolio coverage models and operating cadences that improve customer outcomes, retention, adoption and expansion across payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products. Improve visibility and predictability across onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, customer health, expansion pipeline, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and retention. Drive a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value. Orchestrate complex level 2 customer issues with Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations, turning recurring friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations. Partner with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France. Within the first 90 days, you’ll have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities, established the team cadence and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues. Within six to twelve months, priority accounts should have clear plans and stakeholder coverage, the core playbooks should be consistently used, leading indicators should improve against an agreed baseline, and the four Account Managers should show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency. You'll work from our Paris office three days a week. What we're looking for Essentials 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role. 2+ years of direct people management experience, ideally leading a team of 3–8. Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes. Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics. Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment. Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives. Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines. Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority. Fluent French and professional English. Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity. Preferred Experience in payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure. Experience with KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations. Experience managing strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets. Experience in pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development. Experience in Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services. You'll thrive here if You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway. You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work. You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect. You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. Learn more about your team SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales. It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward. If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it. Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

errors decrease through automation and standardization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>ETA teams adopt reusable GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD patterns for Salesforce, Zuora, title: Senior Data Engineer, Cloudforce One
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>London, UK</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudforce One is Cloudflare’s threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world’s largest global networks can provide. The team is able to analyze these unique data points, at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <p>You will join the data science team within Cloudforce One. We power much of the insight and intelligence delivered in Cloudflare’s <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/security-center/cloudforce-one/#analyze-threat-events">Threat Events</a> product, which customers can use to better protect themselves — for example, by <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/realtime-threat-intel-waf-rules/">turning our threat indicators into real-time WAF rules</a>. We own data pipelines that power analysis of Cloudflare’s DDoS and WAF data, including Cloudflare’s quarterly <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/ddos-threat-report-2026-q3/">DDoS Threat Report</a>. We also support internal Trust & Safety initiatives such as identifying and addressing network abuse, and collaborate directly with the Threat Intelligence team.</p> <p>As a Data Engineer, you will build the data foundation that makes this possible: designing and operating the scalable pipelines, analytical data stores, and data marts that turn raw Cloudflare telemetry into trusted, well-modeled datasets for threat researchers, data scientists, analysts, and customers.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operate scalable batch data pipelines on Kubernetes-hosted Airflow and Spark clusters that extract, enrich, and publish threat and abuse signals from Cloudflare’s network and platform telemetry.</li> <li>Build and evolve our data stores in Apache Iceberg (R2) and the curated data marts that serve Threat Events, Trust & Safety initiatives, and Threat Intelligence investigations.</li> <li>Model datasets deliberately — choosing grain, partitioning, and schema evolution strategies that keep data correct, queryable, and cost-efficient.</li> <li>Write and optimize SQL against large-scale analytical data in ClickHouse, balancing completeness, performance, and cost.</li> <li>Make pipelines safe to retry, resume, and backfill, so downstream consumers receive exactly the data we intend to publish.</li> <li>Build data quality checks, reconciliation, and monitoring that catch problems before they reach analysts, detections, or customers.</li> <li>Treat privacy and data minimization as design requirements from the start.</li> <li>Enable Threat Intelligence and Trust & Safety partners with the data they need for tooling and investigations, translating ad hoc requests into reusable datasets.</li> <li>Partner with data scientists to turn exploratory analysis into repeatable, production-quality data products title: Systems Engineer, Data Loss Prevention
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h4><strong>About the department</strong></h4> <p>Cloudflare’s Engineering Team builds and runs the software that handles trillions of requests per month. Product development covers both new features and functionality and scaling our existing software to meet the challenges of a massively growing customer base.</p> <p>The Cloudflare Zero Trust group within the Engineering organization is taking on the mission of ensuring the people and teams within an organization can access the tools they need to do their job safe from malware and other online threats with the speed and reliability that Cloudflare is known for.</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h4> <p><br>In this role, you’ll help us build Cloudflare’s <a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/en-gb/zero-trust/products/dlp/">Data Loss Prevention</a> (DLP)  product that helps customers of any size protect the data that powers their business. Whether credit card numbers, health records, trade secrets or other types of data, Cloudflare’s solution allows organizations to focus on their business and stop worrying about applying bandaids to protect their data. The solution runs in-line with Secure Web Gateway, Cloud Access Security Broker and Remote Browser Isolation - layering Zero Trust access control and web filtering as part of a defense-in-depth approach to data security.</p> <p>We are looking for a talented, experienced software engineer to join our team and help take our Data Loss Prevention product to the next level. You’ll help us make our DLP product more efficient and more accurate, while also helping us build out more features. You’ll contribute to the design and implementation of a Rust codebase that is deployed across Cloudflare’s entire edge fleet, and in Kubernetes clusters in our core datacenters. You’ll use AI models to improve how DLP detects, classifies, and protects sensitive data at Cloudflare scale.</p> <p><strong>Technologies we use</strong></p> <ul> <li>Core edge services are written in Rust and deployed globally to 300+ data centers.</li> <li>Our REST API is also written in Rust, runs on Kubernetes, and uses Postgres as a data store.</li> <li>For service monitoring we use Prometheus and Grafana</li> <li>For service logging we use Elasticsearch and Kibana</li> <li>For product analytics we use Clickhouse and BigQuery</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Knowledge we’d love for you to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solid Rust coding experience (the entire product is written in Rust)</li> <li>Experience with a variety of AI models.</li> <li>Container orchestration (e.g. k8s) </li> <li>Distributed systems (performance, consistency, observability, resilience) </li> <li>Advanced data/document classification (e.g. statistical, ML)</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. description: Über Probatix Probatix bietet Labordiagnostik als Service an: Unsere Partner – digitale Gesundheitsprogramme, Telemedizin-Anbieter, Health Apps, Krankenversicherungen und Arztpraxen – bieten ihren Kunden Heimtests unter eigener Marke an. forensically sound images to analyze malware, trojans, and source code.</li> <li>Threat Intelligence Integration: Monitors external vendor data and threat intelligence to analyze trends and connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. title: (Senior) Finance Controller (all genders)
description: JustPlay is looking for a (Senior) Finance Controller (all genders) to join our growing Finance team. Over the past years, we've grown significantly, and we're now backed by NCSoft as our strategic shareholder, with ambitious plans to keep growing. As we scale, our finance function needs to scale with us, and we're looking for a (Senior) Controller who owns the numbers that steer our business: shareholder reporting, budget and forecast, and the KPIs leadership relies on every week. You will directly report to the Associate Director of Finance and you'll be the finance partner for our core revenue and cost drivers and help build a controlling function that scales with the company. This is a growth role: you'll start by mentoring our FP&A team member, and in the mid-term take over leadership of the controlling function. Job responsibilities Shareholder reporting (NCSoft): Deliver the monthly management P&L and the quarterly consolidated balance sheet and P&L on time and in the shareholder's templates. Provide preliminary figures within a few days of month-end. Keep a clean bridge between management P&L and statutory figures. Budget and forecast: Own the annual budget and a rolling forecast. Turn the overhead budget into a working budget-control process, with cost-center owners, monthly actual-vs-budget reviews and follow-up actions. Business partnering: Be the finance counterpart for Revenue Generation / Ad Monetisation, User Acquisition, User Payments (payouts and rewards) and the G&A cost centers, with profitability as the focus. Cost control: Build levers and tracking for the largest cost blocks: personnel, SaaS, cloud, consulting, and payment fees (PayPal, FX). Analysis: Run variance analysis against budget, forecast and weekly flash, build scenario models, and prepare quarterly business reviews. Data integrity: Establish Metabase/Looker as a reliable source of finance KPIs. Reconcile BI data against invoices and the ledger, own the KPI definitions and remove double counts and manual add-ons. Liquidity: Work with Treasury on the liquidity forecast (network payout timing, UA spend, user cash-outs). Interface with accounting: Work with the Accounting Lead on the in-house month-end close, including accruals input, cut-off, and cost center and chart of accounts design in DATEV. Team: Mentor and review the work of our junior FP&A team member, and grow into the leadership of the controlling function in the mid-term. Job requirements 6+ years in controlling or FP&A, with at least 2 years in a scale-up or digital B2C business; mobile apps, gaming or ad-tech is strongly preferred. Proven experience reporting to a corporate or strategic shareholder or a PE owner, including multi-entity consolidation and delivering to external templates under deadline. End-to-end ownership of a full budget and forecast cycle, including building driver-based models. Self-sufficient with data: hands-on with a BI tool (Metabase/Looker) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets Solid accounting foundation (accruals, FX, revenue recognition), with enough IFRS/HGB knowledge to reconcile management and statutory figures. Fluent English (written and verbal). German is a strong plus, given our work with PwC, DATEV and the local entities. Nice-to-have Understanding of Ad monetisation and User Acquisition economics: network revenue and payout terms, eCPM, ROAS/LTV, and marketing spend cycles. Experience with an Asian corporate parent or group reporting calendar Hands-on experience with DATEV, Moss or Embat Experience building a controlling function or KPI governance from scratch Familiarity with multi-currency (USD/EUR) payment flows and FX effects First experience mentoring or leading finance team members Job benefits Work-Life Balance and Flexibility : Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers Mental Health Support : Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work Training & Development : A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply Germany-Based Benefits : 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution State-of-the-Art Equipment : Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed A Relocation Package : Includes visa support for those who need it Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations Berlin Office Perks : Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment. About us Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell. Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse. With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype. Everyone's welcome here At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
description: Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. Wie ben jij Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen. Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten. Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn. Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers. Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat. Wat ga je doen Wat breng je mee? Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen. • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst; Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen; • Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn; • Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee; • Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren; • Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn; • Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving; • Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is; • Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré. Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening. Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is? We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen. • ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support; • prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen; • vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten; • richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening; • sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid; • onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen; • afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams; • samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren; • signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren; • richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur; • kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen; • organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives. Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan. Wat bieden wij Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie. Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf. Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis. Wie wij zijn Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy. Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner. Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken. Vous gérez les dépendances entre équipes, assurez une documentation fonctionnelle de qualité et facilitez l'adoption de ces briques par les autres verticales. Le profil que nous recherchons : Vous êtes un Product Owner expérimenté, reconnu pour la rigueur de votre delivery et pour votre capacité à transformer des besoins complexes en fonctionnalités simples et utiles. Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact. Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business. Votre mission : Le Responsable Revenue Operations est essentiel à l’optimisation et l’accélération de nos activités Revenue. Ce poste reporte directement au Chief Sales Officer. Il gère de manière stratégique et opérationnelle, le design et la mise en place de la transformation de l’organisation (design d’organisation, systèmes et processus) tout en devenant le point de contact principal du pilotage des activités. Il porte la roadmap Revenue et en assure la mise en œuvre sur l'ensemble de la chaîne commerciale, de la génération de leads à la fidélisation client. Il arbitre les priorités entre activité courante et projets structurants, pilote les chantiers de bout en bout et rend compte de leur impact sur la performance. Le poste combine trois dimensions : le pilotage de projets, le management d'une équipe de trois personnes réparties sur les équipes métier, et une composante technique forte sur le CRM, l'automatisation et l'analyse stratégique de la donnée. Supporter les activités liées au planning commercial (Bottom up forecast, analyses, design des modèles de compensation, objectifs annuels, headcount…) Supporter les activités de formation et de développement professionnel des équipes Revenue CRM, données et pilotage Assurer la gouvernance du CRM : modèle de données, droits et profils, cohérence des référentiels, budget Garantir la qualité de la donnée commerciale et mettre en place les contrôles associés Produire et industrialiser les tableaux de bord de pilotage pour la direction et les responsables d'équipe Déployer un dispositif d'autonomie des utilisateurs : modèles de rapports réutilisables, formation, référents identifiés par équipe Automatisation et intelligence artificielle Identifier les tâches manuelles à fort volume et concevoir les automatisations correspondantes Intégrer les outils d'intelligence artificielle dans les processus opérationnels des équipes revenus (Sales CSM et Marketing) Évaluer, sélectionner et rationaliser les outils du périmètre Management Encadrer une équipe de trois personnes, chacune rattachée à une branche revenue Organiser la répartition de la charge et le suivi des priorités Faire monter l'équipe en compétence et assurer la cohérence des pratiques La rémunération sur ce poste est de 80K€ fixe annuelle + une partie variable allant jusqu’à 10K€ annuel en fonction des objectifs. Le profil que nous recherchons : Profil hybride, à la fois technique, stratégique et opérationnel. Compétences indispensables Salesforce : maîtrise du modèle de données, du Flow Builder et de l'administration courante. Pilotage de projet : capacité à cadrer, orchestrer et démontrer l'impact des chantiers livrés. Intelligence artificielle : capacité à intégrer les outils dans des processus opérationnels, au-delà d'un usage ponctuel. Stratégie commerciale : capacite à analyser les données commerciales en profondeur afin de déterminer les contraintes et les opportunités de croissance ainsi que les leviers Revenue a exploiter. Compétences techniques Administration de CRM : Salesforce, HubSpot Automatisation : n8n, Make ou équivalents Intelligence artificielle : Claude, Codex ou équivalents Restitution de la donnée : Salesforce, Power BI (Fabric ou Databricks appréciés) Expérience 8 ans d'expérience minimum, sur un périmètre Revenue Operations ou Sales Operations Une expérience opérationnelle dans la vente et/ou la relation client, qui donne la connaissance du terrain et la crédibilité nécessaire face aux équipes Une première expérience d'encadrement constitue un atout Formation en business management (Master, MBA) est un atout Qualités attendues Capacité d'arbitrage et de priorisation dans un environnement à fortes sollicitations Aisance dans le dialogue avec des interlocuteurs commerciaux comme techniques Orientation résultats : mesurer l'impact de ce qui est livré Ce que nous vous offrons : Poste basé à Issy-les-moulineaux Type de contrat : CDI Rémunération fixe entre 80K€ et 90K€ en fonction du profil et un variable allant jusqu’à 10K€ sur objectifs RTT Carte tickets restaurants : 8.50€ par jour Option de télétravail ou flexibilité pour une meilleure organisation de votre quotidien Un cadre de travail responsabilisant, formateur et propice à l’épanouissement Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Offre de stage :  Imprimer l'énergie de demain : développement de générateurs thermoélectriques innovants
description: Unité : CERI MP Responsables : Dr. CHARLON Sébastien, Pr. SAMUEL Cédric, Dr. Amulya RAJ Nature de l’emploi : Stage de master 2 ou équivalent d’une durée de 6 mois Lieu de travail : Douai (59) Description de l’IMT Nord Europe : École sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille. IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital. Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ». Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr Contexte scientifique et missions : Le développement de capteurs autonomes en énergie pour l'Internet des objets (IoT) représente un défi scientifique et technologique majeur. Dans ce contexte, les technologies de récupération d'énergie constituent des solutions prometteuses pour convertir différentes sources d'énergie présentes dans notre environnement (mécanique, thermique, solaire, électromagnétique, etc.) en énergie électrique. Le projet européen THERMOHARV , réunissant l'Université de Mons, l'Université de Lille, le C2DE et l’IMT Nord Europe, ambitionne de développer une nouvelle génération de microgénérateurs thermoélectriques organiques (OTEG), flexibles et performants , capables de convertir directement la chaleur fatale en énergie électrique. Ces dispositifs pourraient notamment contribuer à l'alimentation de capteurs autonomes dans les bâtiments, les centres de données ou les environnements industriels. Dans ce cadre, le Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Matériaux & Procédés (CERI MP) d'IMT Nord Europe développe des encres fonctionnelles à base de nanotubes de carbone , présentant des propriétés thermoélectriques. Ces encres sont déposées sur des substrats polymères flexibles grâce à un procédé innovant de fabrication additive par écriture directe ( Direct Ink Writing , DIW). L'enjeu scientifique consiste à maîtriser les interactions entre la formulation des encres, leur imprimabilité et les performances thermoélectriques des dispositifs obtenus afin de concevoir des générateurs optimisés. Dans ce contexte, les missions scientifiques et technologiques confiées à la personne recrutée seront les suivantes : Formulation des encres : développer et optimiser des encres thermoélectriques à base de nanotubes de carbone, notamment en étudiant l'influence des conditions de dispersion sur leurs propriétés. Caractérisation physicochimique : étudier les relations entre la formulation, l'état de dispersion des nanotubes de carbone et les propriétés rhéologiques des encres. Optimisation du procédé d'impression : identifier les paramètres d'écriture directe permettant d'obtenir des dépôts homogènes, reproductibles et présentant une géométrie maîtrisée. Conception et optimisation des dispositifs : modéliser l'influence de la géométrie des générateurs sur leurs performances thermoélectriques. Fabrication et caractérisation d'un prototype fonctionnel : concevoir, fabriquer et évaluer les performances d'un prototype de générateur thermoélectrique flexible. Ce stage permettra ainsi de participer à l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement d'un dispositif fonctionnel, de la formulation des matériaux jusqu'à la validation expérimentale d'un prototype , au sein d'un environnement de recherche collaboratif. Profil de la personne recrutée : La personne recrutée devra être étudiante en Master 2, en dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs ou suivre une formation équivalente dans le domaine de la science et du génie des matériaux, de la physicochimie ou du génie des procédés. Des connaissances en formulation et dispersion d’encres, notamment par ultrasons, en fabrication additive (impression 3D, écriture directe) ainsi qu’en caractérisation des matériaux (rhéologie, goniométrie, profilométrie) seront particulièrement appréciées. Une expérience ou des connaissances dans le domaine de la thermoélectricité constitueront un atout supplémentaire. Au-delà des compétences techniques, la personne recrutée devra faire preuve de rigueur scientifique, d’autonomie, de curiosité et d’un intérêt marqué pour la recherche expérimentale. De bonnes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et de communication scientifique, tant à l’écrit qu’à l’oral, sont également attendues. Conditions : Le poste est à pourvoir à compter du 01/02/2027 pour une durée de 6 mois Renseignements et modalités de dépôt de candidature : Pour tout renseignement sur le poste, merci de vous adresser à Dr. CHARLON Sébastien, Pour tout renseignement administratif, merci de vous adresser à la Direction des Ressources Humaines : Date limite de candidature : 31/12/2026 Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker / Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) - Vollzeit
description: Wirtschaftsinformatiker / Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) für agentische Softwareentwicklung Die Kanzlei Prinz ist auf Online-Reputationsrecht spezialisiert: Für über 2.300 Mandanten, überwiegend mittelständische Unternehmen, sorgen wir dafür, dass rechtswidrige Bewertungen auf Plattformen wie kununu, Google und Trustpilot verschwinden. Dabei läuft bei uns alles über unser selbst entwickeltes Case-Management-System. Software als Grundlage unserer Dienstleistung So wie Software zum Service geworden ist (SaaS), entwickelt sich heute auch das Dienstleistungsgeschäft hin zu Software. Unsere Dienstleistung eignet sich dafür besonders gut: Wir bearbeiten sehr viele gleichartige Fälle nach klar definierten Abläufen, und Software sorgt dafür, dass dabei nichts liegen bleibt und nichts übersehen wird. Bei uns ist das nicht neu: Wir haben schon softwaregetrieben gearbeitet, bevor KI zum Thema wurde – und genau das ermöglicht unser solides Wachstum. Unser Ansatz: Wir entwickeln mit KI-Agenten – was dabei entsteht, ist aber deterministische, nachvollziehbare Software. In unseren Arbeitsabläufen setzen wir KI nur ein, wenn es nötig ist; die rechtliche Einschätzung bleibt in juristischer Hand. Wer jetzt dazukommt, lernt das System von Grund auf kennen und baut es Schritt für Schritt mit aus. Warum wir dich suchen Unser Kanzleiinhaber Matthias Prinz hat selbst Wirtschaftsinformatik (B. Sc.) an der TU München studiert. Wir wissen also ziemlich genau, was zu tun ist – Ideen, Konzepte und ein gut gefülltes Backlog haben wir. Derzeit setzen wir drei bis fünf Verbesserungen pro Tag um. Mit einer Entwicklerin oder einem Entwickler in Vollzeit wollen wir die Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit erhöhen – durchdacht, getestet und passend zur bestehenden Architektur. Die fachliche Richtung ist klar – die technisch saubere Umsetzung liegt bei dir. Kein Beratungsgeschäft, keine wechselnden Kundenprojekte: Du entwickelst für dein eigenes Team und siehst jeden Tag, wie deine Software die Arbeit erleichtert. Deine Aufgaben Agentische Softwareentwicklung (dein Schwerpunkt): Du entwickelst unser Case-Management-System weiter (Python/FastAPI, React/TypeScript, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure) – mit KI-Agenten wie Claude Code: Du schreibst Spezifikationen, lässt die Agenten umsetzen, prüfst jedes Ergebnis kritisch und bringst es sicher in den Live-Betrieb. Deterministisch statt KI im Ablauf: Was sich mit klassischer Software lösen lässt, setzt du ohne KI um – mit festen Regeln und prüfbarer Logik. Schnittstellen & Automatisierung: Du bindest Systeme per API und Webhook an, etwa Microsoft 365, lexoffice und das besondere elektronische Anwaltspostfach (beA), und überführst bestehende Power-Automate-Flows in Azure Functions. Anforderungen aufnehmen: Du hörst unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen genau zu, verstehst ihre Abläufe und übersetzt ihre Anliegen in klare Lösungen. Die Prioritäten stimmst du mit Matthias Prinz ab. Betrieb & Qualität: Du sicherst deine Arbeit mit automatisierten Tests ab, behältst Logs und Schnittstellen im Blick und findest bei Störungen systematisch die Ursache. Pflege und Fehlerbehebung gehören genauso dazu wie neue Funktionen. Schulung: Du stellst neue Funktionen im Team vor und schulst deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Umgang damit. Wir bieten: Klare Rolle: Eine Fachposition ohne Personalverantwortung – du arbeitest direkt mit dem Kanzleiinhaber zusammen, der deine Sprache spricht. Kurze Wege, klare Absprachen. Gepflegte Codebasis: Automatisierte Tests, Typprüfung und dokumentierte Architektur – kein Altsystem aus den 90ern. Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Die Kanzleiprozesse lernst du über unsere Schulungsplattform mit Checklisten und Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen kennen. Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Unbefristete Anstellung von Anfang an. title: Marketing Manager Digital & Lead Generation (m/w/d) / B2B / Energiewirtschaft / 50-60
description: Du baust lieber Kampagnen, die Kunden bringen, als Präsentationen darüber, wie man Kunden gewinnen könnte? Dann haben wir einen Job, der dir gefallen dürfte. Stell dir vor, du startest eine Google-Ads-Kampagne, optimierst die Landingpage und siehst anschließend, welche Anfragen tatsächlich zu Kunden werden. Kein Marketing, das nur Klicks und Impressionen feiert. Sondern Marketing, dessen Beitrag zum Umsatz sichtbar wird. Unser Kunde ist ein wirtschaftlich starkes B2B-Unternehmen aus der Energiewirtschaft. Seit über 15 Jahren erfolgreich am Markt, mit einem eingespielten Vertrieb aus Callcenter und bundesweit tätigen Key Account Managern. Die telefonische Neukundengewinnung funktioniert bereits. Jetzt soll ein zweiter Kanal wachsen: digitale Leadgenerierung, die messbar neue Kunden bringt. Die ersten Google-Ads-Aktivitäten und Landingpages gibt es bereits. Was fehlt, ist jemand, der das Thema intern übernimmt, weiterentwickelt und selbst mit anpackt. Und genau dafür suchen wir dich. Deine Aufgaben – von der ersten Kampagne bis zum neuen Kunden Du entwickelst digitale Kampagnen: Du baust Google Ads, Landingpages und Formulare auf, testest neue Ansätze und optimierst die Conversion. Du machst Marketing messbar: Du richtest das Tracking ein und sorgst dafür, dass Anfragen sauber im CRM ankommen. Gemeinsam mit Sales Operations wertest du aus, welche Leads zu Abschlüssen führen. Du steuerst externe Partner: Du briefst Dienstleister, prüfst Ergebnisse und entscheidest mit, welche Aufgaben intern oder extern umgesetzt werden. Du entwickelst weitere Wege zur Kundengewinnung: Du kümmerst dich um Messen, Mailings sowie Kooperationen mit Verbänden und Partnern. Du erstellst Inhalte, die Interesse wecken: Du entwickelst Newsletter, Website-Texte und Fallbeispiele, die potenzielle Kunden überzeugen. Das solltest du mitbringen Das ist uns wichtig: Du hast Erfahrung in der B2B-Leadgenerierung oder im Performance Marketing und weißt, woran sich erfolgreiche Kampagnen messen lassen. Du hast Google Ads, Landingpages und Conversion-Tracking bereits selbst umgesetzt und optimiert. Du kannst eigenständig arbeiten, Prioritäten setzen und Projekte von der Idee bis zum Ergebnis voranbringen. Du verstehst, dass ein guter Lead nicht bei einem ausgefüllten Formular endet, sondern erst für den Vertrieb wertvoll werden muss. Das wäre ein Plus: Du kommst aus einer Agentur oder hast bereits externe Dienstleister gesteuert. Du hast Erfahrung mit Newslettern, Marketing Automation oder SEO. Du kennst die Energiewirtschaft oder hast schon Messen und Partnermarketing betreut. Und auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Was du dafür bekommst Ca. 60.000 € Jahreszielgehalt: Eine attraktive Vergütung für eine Rolle, in der du eigene Ideen umsetzen kannst. Marketing mit direktem Einfluss auf den Umsatz: Deine Leads landen bei einem eingespielten Vertrieb, der sie weiterbearbeitet. Du bekommst Rückmeldung zu den Ergebnissen. Gestaltungsspielraum statt endloser Abstimmungen: Du entwickelst den digitalen Neukundenkanal weiter und arbeitest mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Hybrides Arbeiten: Du kombinierst konzentrierte Arbeit außerhalb des Büros mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit in Bochum. Benefits, die im Alltag zählen: 30 Tage Urlaub, Jobbike, Gesundheitsbudget, Fahrtkostenzuschuss und Parkplatz. Dazu kommen Teamtage sowie Sommer- und Winterfeste. Du startest nicht auf der grünen Wiese, aber es gibt noch viel aufzubauen. Du bekommst die Chance, einen digitalen Vertriebskanal mitzugestalten, dessen Ergebnisse nicht in einem Reporting verschwinden, sondern im Geschäft ankommen. Bereit, deine eigenen Kampagnen zum Erfolg zu führen? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.
