title: Response Engineer (Application & Network Security)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="font-size: 14pt;">Available Location - Bengaluru</span></h2> <h2><span style="font-size: 14pt;">About the Department</span></h2> <p>Cloudforce One is Cloudflare's threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation. Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world's largest global networks can provide. The team analyzes these unique data points at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 14pt;">About INTERDICT</span></h2> <p>I.N.T.E.R.D.I.C.T. (Identify, Neutralize, Triage, Engage, Respond, Disrupt, Integrate, Contain, Threat Hunting) is Cloudforce One's unified operational security organization responsible for identifying, analyzing, and responding to threats targeting Cloudflare and its customers. INTERDICT encompasses three main sub-functions:</p> <ul> <li>PhishGuard: Managed email threat detection and response service</li> <li>Cloudflare Managed Defense (CMD): Network and application security monitoring for 'Under Attack' mitigation support.</li> <li>Detection Engineering: ML model development and detection optimization</li> </ul> <p>Together, INTERDICT provides comprehensive 24×7×365 protection across email, application, and network threat surfaces.</p> <p><strong><span style="font-size: 14pt;">Role Summary</span></strong></p> <p>Response Engineer within the Cloudflare Managed Defense Center (CMDC) provides front-line technical monitoring and threat mitigation for Cloudflare’s premium enterprise customers. In this role, you will proactively monitor internal alerting systems to identify, analyze, and mitigate real-time security events across OSI Layers 3, 4, and 7. Working alongside senior engineers and operational teams, you will execute established runbooks to protect complex customer infrastructure from sophisticated DDoS and application-layer attacks. We are looking for a collaborative, analytical professional who remains calm under pressure and is eager to develop their security expertise within a fast-paced environment.</p> <h3>Role Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Monitor and investigate proactive security alerts via internal telemetry systems to rapidly identify ongoing infrastructure and application-layer attacks.</li> <li>Apply appropriate mitigation steps and filter malicious traffic using Cloudflare’s core security tools, including Magic Transit, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Rate Limiting.</li> <li>Review incoming alerts to determine urgency, scope, and validity, while accurately maintaining incident tracking tickets for necessary escalations.</li> <li>Communicate technical updates clearly and professionally with enterprise customers via chat, email, and phone during active security incidents.</li> <li>Adhere to strict customer SLAs for alert response times, event analysis, and ongoing operational communications.</li> <li>Maintain and update customer-specific runbooks, threshold rules, and escalation matrices to ensure seamless incident execution.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal Engineering and Product teams to provide feedback on tools and suggest improvements for alert rules.</li> </ul> <h3>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</h3> <ul> <li>A minimum of 2–5 years of relevant hands-on experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), technical support engineering, or network operations environment.</li> <li>Strong foundational understanding of networking principles and internet protocols, including TCP/IP, UDP, ICMP, DNS, and BGP.</li> <li>Experience analyzing network traffic data for anomaly detection and executing basic mitigation protocols against L3/L4 or L7 attacks.</li> <li>Professional proficiency using the command line (Bash shell) alongside general system administration literacy across Linux, Mac, or Windows environments.</li> <li>Proven customer-facing technical support experience, with the communication skills required to assist stakeholders during high-pressure incidents.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points:-</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with packet capture and network analysis tools such as tcpdump or Wireshark.</li> <li>Foundational scripting skills (Python preferred) to assist in automating basic operational workflows.</li> <li>Familiarity with querying datasets via APIs/GraphQL or monitoring performance metrics inside Prometheus and Grafana dashboards.</li> <li>Relevant industry certifications, such as CompTIA Security+, CCNA, or foundational GIAC credentials (e.g., GCIA).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) Kreditrevision
description: Ihre Aufgaben in der Kreditrevision Bei der Ostfriesische Volksbank eG prüfen und bewerten Sie Kreditengagements und tragen so zur Risikosteuerung unserer genossenschaftlichen Bank bei. Sie analysieren Kreditentscheidungen auf Einhaltung gesetzlicher und intern Vorgaben, bewerten Sicherheiten und erstellen aussagekräftige Revisionsberichte. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit den zuständigen Markt- und Marktfolgeeinheiten zusammen und besprechen Ihre Prüfungsergebnisse konstruktiv. Sie identifizieren Optimierungspotenziale in den Kreditprozessen und bringen Ihr Fachwissen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Revisionsmethoden ein. Das bringen Sie mit Sie haben eine bankkaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein entsprechendes wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium erfolgreich abgeschlossen und bringen fundierte Berufserfahrung im Kreditgeschäft oder in der Bankrevision mit. Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse des Kredit- und Sicherheitenrechts sowie der relevanten regulatorischen Anforderungen. Eine analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise zeichnet Sie aus, gepaart mit Urteilsvermögen und Durchsetzungskraft. Sie kommunizieren klar, schriftlich wie mündlich, und agieren in Prüfungsgesprächen souverän und lösungsorientiert. Ihr Start bei der Ostfriesische Volksbank eG In den ersten Monaten machen Sie sich mit unseren internen Revisionsprozessen, den relevanten Systemen und unserem Kreditportfolio vertraut. title: Product Lead
description: Product Lead About Us Logistics is a $12 trillion industry powered by hard-working people, yet much of its operational work is still manual and running on tribal knowledge. We believe another software tool won’t solve this, but we need to change how work gets done in logistics. That’s why we're building the autonomous supply chain: AI workers that support their human co-workers and coordinate the work across company boundaries. We automate workflows first, then connect trading partners, and finally orchestrate entire supply chain networks. As former logistics operators, we understand this industry inside out: its complexity, exceptions and the realities of running a low-margin business. We are backed by leading European investors and are building a new category for the global logistics industry. The Role As our Product Lead , you will shape our platform strategy and own the product roadmap from first insight to shipped feature. We are building a scalable platform, not a services business. Every customer project teaches us something, and your job is to turn those lessons into platform capabilities that make the next customer faster and cheaper to onboard. You will decide what becomes a configurable platform feature and what we deliberately don't build into the platform. Tasks Our product: Logistica is offering a flexible platform that lets logistics teams automate document-based workflows. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Customer Engineering Specialist - Network Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Locations:  Lisbon</strong></p> <h4>Customer Engineering Specialist - Network Services</h4> <h4>About Us</h4> <h4>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</h4> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>As a CE Specialist you will be the trusted technical advisor for customers adopting Cloudflare's network services. These include Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall and Cloudflare Network Interconnect (CNI), alongside Cloudflare One. You will lead Magic Transit and Cloudflare WAN POCs from design through to production cutover. You will also help customers modernize how they protect, connect and secure their networks and sites.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted advisor, helping customers choose the right Cloudflare network and security solution for their business needs.</li> <li>Lead qualified prospects through Solution Design and POC.</li> <ul> <li><strong>Magic Transit:</strong> plan and run POCs covering BGP onboarding, prefix advertisement, GRE/IPsec tunnels or CNI, and DDoS validation.</li> <li><strong>Cloudflare WAN:</strong> plan and run POCs covering site and branch connectivity (IPsec/GRE tunnels, CNI, Cloudflare One Appliance), data center and cloud-to-site connectivity, routing design, and coexistence with or migration from existing SD-WAN or MPLS.</li> </ul> <li>Understand the customer's network topology, IP addressing, routing policy and security requirements. Then design an architecture that fits, including hybrid environments with Azure, AWS and GCP.</li> <li>Run technical discovery, demos and workshops as part of the pre-sales cycle. Support RFP/RFI responses and technical validation.</li> <li>Explain the benefits of Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN and Cloudflare One compared with alternative approaches. These include traditional DDoS scrubbing services, appliance-based protection, SD-WAN solutions, next-generation firewalls and MPLS or traditional WAN.</li> <li>Work with GTM partners to consistently achieve pipeline and revenue goals.</li> <li>Present network and security transformation messages to senior technical leaders and executives.</li> <li>Capture product and feature gaps and feed them back to Product and Engineering.</li> </ul> <h2>Core requirements</h2> <ul> <li><strong>GTM experience:</strong> 5+ years in Customer Engineering, Pre-sales, Solutions or Systems Engineering, or Technical Sales. You should have experience guiding customers through discovery, solution design, POC and handover to delivery or support.</li> <li><strong>BGP and routing:</strong> Strong working knowledge of BGP (eBGP, route advertisement and filtering, AS paths, communities, anycast, RPKI and route hygiene). You should also be comfortable with static and dynamic routing, subnetting, route-based policy and split tunnels.</li> <li><strong>TCP/IP:</strong> Deep understanding of the TCP/IP protocol stack and packet-level troubleshooting (for example with tcpdump and Wireshark). This includes MTU/MSS, tunneling (GRE, IPsec), NAT and asymmetric routing.</li> <li><strong>DDoS protection:</strong> Understanding of L3/L4/L7 DDoS attack types and mitigation approaches (for example volumetric floods, SYN floods, amplification and reflection attacks). You should also understand how on-demand and always-on protection differ.</li> <li><strong>SD-WAN and WAN architecture:</strong> Familiarity with SD-WAN architectures and routing protocols (BGP and OSPF overlays), underlay and overlay design, local internet breakout, branch connectivity, and migration from MPLS or legacy WAN.</li> <li>Fluent in English, written and spoken. Additional languages are a plus.</li> <li>Ability to manage a project, work to deadlines and prioritize between competing goals.</li> <li>Curiosity and learning agility. Cloudflare sits at the cutting edge of internet technology, so you are expected to keep up with industry trends as well as our own products.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable skills</h2> <p><strong>Network and security fundamentals</strong></p> <ul> <li>DNS: Good knowledge of DNS, including authoritative and recursive resolution, DNSSEC, DNS over HTTPS/TLS, DNS-based attacks (such as tunneling and cache poisoning) and DNS filtering.</li> <li>Detailed understanding of the path from user to application, including hybrid and multi-cloud architectures (Azure, AWS, GCP).</li> <li>Knowledge of end-user and application security risks. These include DDoS, malware, phishing, viruses, ransomware.</li> <li>VPN and remote access challenges, and moving to Zero Trust access.</li> <li>SIEM and log analytics platforms. You should also be comfortable with network telemetry such as NetFlow and sFlow.</li> <li>Experience and knowledge with network and security vendors, including Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and Check Point (covering architecture, capabilities, configuration, and troubleshooting).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Market and competitive knowledge</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of the market for CDN providers, Web Application Firewalls, remote access solutions, next-generation firewalls, CASB, DDoS mitigation, SD-WAN and secure gateway solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cloudflare One and Zero Trust</strong></p> <ul> <li>SASE concepts and Zero Trust networking architectures.</li> <li>Knowledge of Cloudflare Zero Trust solutions: Access, Gateway, Browser Isolation, and WARP client deployment.</li> <li>Secure Web Gateway, CASB and DLP.</li> <li>IdP and authentication (SAML, OTP), plus SaaS application integration and tenant controls.</li> <li>Client OS fundamentals and software distribution.</li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €59,000 - €92,000.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="2"><strong data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"> </h3> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0"> </p> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0"> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Lifecycle Manager
description: Job Overview We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Lifecycle Manager with strong hands-on expertise in traditional IT infrastructure, legacy platforms, and Nutanix environments. The role involves managing the complete infrastructure lifecycle across industrial and manufacturing environments, including infrastructure assessments, technology refreshes, hardware deployments, virtualization, migrations, upgrades, and infrastructure modernization. The successful candidate will work closely with IT infrastructure, Operational Technology (OT), Plant Engineering, application teams, vendors, and operational stakeholders to ensure secure, reliable, and production-ready infrastructure while minimizing disruption to critical plant operations. Key Responsibilities •Manage the complete lifecycle of traditional/legacy IT infrastructure and Nutanix platforms. •Assess infrastructure health, platform performance, technical debt, hardware obsolescence, and lifecycle risks. •Plan and execute infrastructure refreshes, upgrades, migrations, and technology replacements. •Perform hands-on rack-and-stack activities, including hardware installation, cabling, labelling, power validation, configuration, and connectivity testing. •Deploy, configure, administer, and maintain Nutanix infrastructure. •Manage Nutanix AHV clusters and Prism Central/Prism Element environments. •Perform Nutanix node expansion, health checks, capacity monitoring, upgrades, and workload migrations. •Support Windows and Linux operating systems, virtualization, compute, storage, and networking infrastructure. •Coordinate infrastructure activities across Plant IT, Operational Technology (OT), Process Control Systems (PCS), and Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM/MES) environments. •Coordinate operating system deployments, infrastructure patching, vulnerability remediation, and security compliance activities. •Manage infrastructure asset provisioning, capacity planning, and lifecycle documentation. •Develop and maintain infrastructure lifecycle roadmaps, asset inventories, technical documentation, and risk registers. •Prepare implementation plans, migration procedures, cutover plans, and operational handover documentation. •Coordinate with vendors, site engineers, infrastructure teams, and operational support functions. •Support service introduction and operational readiness for newly deployed or upgraded infrastructure. •Contribute to infrastructure modernization and plant technology strategy. •Travel to nearby plant and industrial locations to perform infrastructure lifecycle activities. Essential Technical Skills & Experience •Strong hands-on experience in IT infrastructure lifecycle management. •Practical experience with traditional/legacy infrastructure and Nutanix platforms. •Hands-on knowledge of Nutanix AHV, Prism Central, and Prism Element. •Experience with Nutanix cluster administration, node expansion, upgrades, migrations, and capacity management. •Strong understanding of virtualization technologies, compute, storage, and server infrastructure. •Good knowledge of Windows Server and Linux operating systems. •Understanding of enterprise networking, physical connectivity, cabling, and infrastructure hardware. •Experience with infrastructure assessments, hardware refreshes, obsolescence management, and lifecycle planning. •Knowledge of Plant IT, OT infrastructure, PCS, and MOM/MES environments. •Experience working in manufacturing, industrial, or production environments. •Understanding of infrastructure availability, resilience, capacity planning, and risk management. •Experience with infrastructure deployments, patching, vulnerability remediation, and migrations. •Ability to prepare technical documentation, implementation plans, and operational handover materials. •Experience in vendor management, stakeholder coordination, and change management. •Nutanix certification is preferred. •Automation and scripting knowledge is an advantage. Nice-to-Have Skills •Experience contributing to plant technology strategies and infrastructure modernization roadmaps. •Knowledge of disaster recovery (DR), business continuity planning (BCP), and operational readiness. •ITIL knowledge and experience working with IT service management processes. •Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management. Additional Requirements •Willingness and ability to travel to nearby industrial and plant locations. •Ability to drive and travel between sites by car. •Ability to work independently at different locations. •Flexibility to coordinate with plant operations and technical teams. •Relevant technical education or equivalent professional infrastructure experience. title: Business Development Representative
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: London</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">In this role, you will contribute to Cloudflare's revenue generation engine by delivering pipeline at scale to the Sales counterparts. title: Intervenant(e) en prévention des risques professionnels (IPRP)
description: 🐼 Pourquoi Prévenir Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France. Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé , en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan. Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début ! 👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici 💉 Le poste, concrètement Nous recrutons un(e) IPRP (Intervenant(e) en Prévention des Risques Professionnels) pour renforcer l’équipe pluridisciplinaire de Prévenir , un SPSTI innovant qui accompagne environ 14 000 travailleurs en Île-de-France . Le poste est rattaché à notre centre (117 quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris) avec une activité mixte terrain (Actions en Milieu de Travail) et à distance (visio, webinaires). Votre mission : contribuer à un objectif exclusif de prévention et de préservation de la santé et de la sécurité au travail , en accompagnant nos entreprises adhérentes sur l’évaluation, la hiérarchisation et la réduction des risques professionnels. 🧭 Parmi vos responsabilités Réaliser des Actions en Milieu de Travail (AMT) : visites/observations en entreprise, études de postes, recueil d’informations (activité, effectifs, organisation, postes, procédés, produits, équipements, expositions, AT/MP, etc.). Produire et mettre à jour des fiches d’entreprise et contribuer aux démarches d’évaluation des risques (DUERP, plans de prévention, registres SST, etc.). Repérer, analyser et hiérarchiser les risques : physiques, chimiques, biologiques, ergonomiques, psychosociaux, organisationnels (TMS, chutes, bruit, vibrations, manutention, incendie/explosion, coactivité, risque routier…). Formuler des recommandations de prévention en privilégiant la logique : supprimer → substituer → protections collectives → organisation . Aider à construire et prioriser un plan d’actions réaliste (court/moyen terme) adapté aux moyens de l’entreprise, puis en suivre la mise en œuvre (indicateurs, amélioration continue). Conduire des sensibilisations et formations (sécurité, thématiques prévention). Participer aux CSE et contribuer à des enquêtes suite à accidents (selon besoins). Contribuer aux actions collectives du SPSTI : campagnes de prévention, ateliers, webinaires, retours d’expérience. Orienter vers des ressources externes si nécessaire (CARSAT/CRAMIF, INRS, ANACT/ARACT, inspection du travail, organismes de contrôle, consultants spécialisés), en lien avec le SPSTI. Vous interviendrez dans une approche proactive : identification des entreprises à risque, propositions d’actions ciblées, et recherche d’impact mesurable. 👤 Le profil recherché Enregistrement IPRP (DREETS) / certification par organisme agréé (uniquement si vous êtes à votre compte). 3 à 7 ans d’expérience en prévention des risques professionnels (ou expérience équivalente fortement appréciée). Domaines de compétence appréciés : ergonomie , psychologie du travail , hygiène industrielle , conseil en prévention/HSE . Capacité à réaliser des fiches d’entreprise, évaluations des risques, études de postes (et éventuellement analyses/mesures selon votre périmètre). Aisance dans le conseil et la restitution auprès d’employeurs et, selon les cas, des représentants du personnel. À l’aise avec un fonctionnement hybride (terrain + distanciel) et les outils numériques. Esprit d’équipe et capacité à travailler en coordination avec médecins du travail, IDEST, psychologues du travail, assistantes sociales, ergonomes, ASST. Basé(e) en Île-de-France . Vous vous retrouvez dans ces lignes ? title: Staff Product Designer
description: Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture. About Superhuman Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on it daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com . The Opportunity At Superhuman, we're on a mission to redefine how people communicate and get work done with AI. We're hiring an experienced Staff Product Designer to join the Agents team in Berlin. We're designing entirely new interaction patterns around how AI and humans work together through agents, through writing, from fixing your grammar to helping you schedule meetings. We're looking for someone to help us on that journey, help us build out new agents across Grammarly and Superhuman Go, and really define what these modern interaction patterns will be. You'd be involved end to end, partnering closely with our engineering and product teams, from Kyiv to Silicon Valley. In This Role You Will: Design zero to one agents. New writing and communication agents, built as AI-first products. A lot of the job is inventing interaction patterns that don't exist yet rather than applying ones that do. Work with designers you'll learn from. The team spans San Francisco and Europe, with people who've come from some of the best product companies around. If you're looking for a design-focused environment with a lot of people to learn from, you'll get that here. Pioneer new AI design workflows. The way we design is changing underneath us. We often start in code, refine in Figma, and ship frontend changes back into the codebase. We're defining that way of working as we go, and we want people who are excited to help build something that lets designers make whatever they can imagine. Shape design strategy. Bring user insights, prototype ideas, and help build a longer-term view of where the Agents roadmap goes. Lead and mentor. Raise the standard through critique, feedback, and working closely with less experienced designers. Qualifications Proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Figma and Claude Design is expected. The following outlines the skills and experience that will set exceptional candidates apart for this role. Extensive experience designing complex, scalable software. The kind of tool people sit inside all day, so productivity tools, creative or CAD software, developer tools. Most of that depth lives on desktop, so mobile isn't a primary focus for this role. A genuine interest in AI technology, both conceptually and in practical workflows like reading, writing and translating, and you're already experimenting with AI-driven prototyping. You care about language and writing. Words are the product here, so we want someone who also thinks about how a sentence works, what makes writing sound like a person, and how tone shifts depending on who you're talking to, not just the interface around the words. Comfortable working with metrics and data-driven design decision-making. Bonus is having worked directly in code and shipped PRs to production. Compensation and Benefits Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback. A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs. Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more. Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing. We encourage you to apply At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Superhuman is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age. For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here . Compensation: €110K – €160K • €110K – €160K Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Vorsorge für deine Zukunft – Wir denken nicht nur nachhaltig, wenn es um Energie geht, sondern auch, wenn es um dich geht. Nutze unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge und baue dir Schritt für Schritt ein solides Fundament für deine Zukunft auf. Mache dein Zuhause smart – Nachhaltigkeit fängt in den eigenen vier Wänden an. Als Teil des Teams profitierst du von dauerhaften 25% Rabatt auf das gesamte Bosch Smart Home Sortiment – für ein noch effizienteres und vernetzteres Zuhause. Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Nous recherchons un profil hybride, capable de concilier la rigueur du traitement opérationnel et la puissance de la data. Au-delà des acquis académiques, c’est la posture qui fera la différence : autonomie, initiative sincère et envie d’avancer dans un environnement qui bouge vite. Tu es méthodique sur le fond et réactif dans l’exécution. Les deux à la fois. Une mission au service de notre raison d’être La transition écologique est notre mission principale : permettre à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance, et orienter nos placements vers les entreprises qui font avancer la transition. La Compliance rend cette mission crédible et durable. Tes missions Au sein d’une équipe Compliance à taille humaine (nous sommes 5 aujourd’hui), tu es en interface directe avec les équipes Customer Care, Produit, Tech, Data, nos partenaires et nos membres. Nos missions vont évoluer avec notre offre et avec une année 2027 qui s’annonce très dynamique. Le descriptif de ce poste bougera donc certainement, mais l’objectif restera le même : rester conforme à nos obligations tout en faisant avancer l’entreprise. Production et gestion des dossiers Compliance (80 %) Traitement des dossiers KYC et de l’entrée en relation : tu analyses les dossiers, vérifies la cohérence des informations et prépares les décisions de validation ou de refus. Vigilance sur les flux et les alertes : tu qualifies les alertes, identifies les situations à risque et proposes les mesures à prendre. Déclarations de soupçon (TRACFIN) : tu participes à la préparation et à la transmission des déclarations, sous la supervision de l’équipe. Relation avec les membres et les partenaires : tu réponds aux questions de conformité avec un discours clair, pédagogique et ferme. Traçabilité : chaque action est documentée. Dans un environnement réglementé, ce qui n’est pas tracé n’a pas été fait. Outils et amélioration continue (20 %) Maîtrise de nos outils internes : tu utilises Notion au quotidien pour documenter, suivre et partager le travail de l’équipe. C’est un outil central de notre fonctionnement que tu dois maîtriser rapidement. Automatisation : tu repères les tâches répétitives et proposes des solutions pour les réduire, en lien avec l’équipe Data & IA. Veille et documentation : tu suis les évolutions réglementaires et contribues à maintenir nos procédures à jour. Ta montée en compétences Les premiers mois sont consacrés à une immersion forte dans la production. Nous te donnons un cadre clair pour gagner en autonomie : Mois 1 : comprendre Green-Got, notre application et les fondamentaux de la Compliance. Mois 2 : maîtriser les outils et les sujets opérationnels. Mois 3 : être autonome sur les cas simples, continuer d’apprendre sur les cas complexes. Mois 4 : être pleinement autonome sur l’opérationnel et contribuer aux projets de l’équipe. Ton profil Nous recherchons un esprit agile et curieux, prêt à grandir avec nous : quelqu’un de passionné par les enjeux réglementaires et par les sujets data et IA, qui veut voir l’impact concret de son travail sur une infrastructure financière que nous construisons avec conviction. Tu as une vraie envie de travailler, d’avancer et d’évoluer. Tu es prêt à un rythme soutenu, car la charge de travail peut être importante. Maturité et autonomie : tu avances sans attendre qu’on te guide pas à pas. Tu identifies les problèmes, tu proposes des solutions et tu prends en charge tes sujets jusqu’au bout. Sens de l’initiative : ton rôle dépasse l’exécution. Tu questionnes, tu améliores, tu contribues. Curiosité et débrouillardise : tu apprends vite, seul comme en équipe, et tu es à l’aise dans un environnement qui change souvent. Niveau d’exigence : tu ne te contentes pas de l’à-peu-près. La précision est un réflexe. Appétence pour l’IA et la data : tu utilises déjà ces outils pour travailler plus vite et mieux, et tu as envie d’aller plus loin. Ce n’est pas la mission principale du poste, mais c’est une compétence que nous attendons. Intérêt pour la conformité : tu veux comprendre les mécanismes KYC, LCB-FT et RGPD, et t’y investir sur la durée. Aisance rédactionnelle et relationnelle : tu sais expliquer une situation complexe simplement, à un membre comme à un collègue. Esprit d’équipe : la Compliance se construit collectivement, le partage d’information fait partie de notre culture. Formation : tu démarres un Master 1 (ou une année équivalente en école de commerce, d’ingénierie ou de droit), idéalement avec un ancrage en finance, risques, audit ou droit. Anglais opérationnel , indispensable pour échanger avec l’équipe technique et nos partenaires. Bonus : une première expérience ou un projet personnel qui te fait fier. Un lien à partager est le bienvenu. Chez Green-Got, nous sommes rusés, responsables, nous recherchons constamment le progrès, nous allons vite et le collectif passe avant l’individu. Ce que nous t'offrons Avec notre agrément ACPR, nous construisons nos propres standards de Compliance, avec les personnes qui nous rejoignent maintenant. Un rôle avec de vraies responsabilités : dès les premiers mois, tu portes tes sujets, et ton travail a un impact direct sur notre dispositif. Un apprentissage de terrain : aux côtés d’une équipe qui transmet ses savoir-faire opérationnels, au contact de l’ensemble des équipes (Customer Care, Produit, Tech, Data). Une équipe exigeante et soudée , qui sait aussi passer de bons moments ensemble. Un environnement en forte croissance , où les profils les plus engagés progressent vite. Le package Cadre : alternance basée à Paris, minimum 4 jours au bureau par semaine. Rémunération : selon la grille légale en vigueur (variable selon l’âge, le niveau de formation et le type de contrat). Santé : mutuelle Alan. Cohésion : une journée d’équipe chaque semestre. Déroulement des entretiens Envoie-nous ton CV, une courte présentation de toi, ton calendrier d’alternance et, si possible, le montant de tes frais d’inscription. Nous t’appellerons rapidement pour faire connaissance, dès que ton profil aura retenu notre attention. Si ça matche, nous t'enverrons un Business Case à préparer. Entretien en visio avec Justé (Compliance Manager) et un futur collègue pour analyser le Business Case, évaluer tes compétences et faire connaissance.. Échange de 15 min avec un autre membre de l’équipe pour le fit culturel. Entretien avec Adèle (Head of Operations). Entretien final avec Andréa (CEO). Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer ! Le descriptif de ce poste bougera donc certainement, mais l’objectif restera le même : rester conforme à nos obligations tout en faisant avancer l’entreprise. Opérations et gestion des dossiers Compliance (60 %) Garant de l’entrée en relation : tu analyses la cohérence des dossiers KYC et prépares les décisions de validation ou de refus des membres. Contrôle et vigilance des flux : tu suis les transactions, qualifies les alertes et proposes les mesures conservatoires à prendre. Déclarations de soupçon (TRACFIN) : tu participes à la préparation et à la transmission des déclarations, sous la supervision de l’équipe. Relation avec les membres et les partenaires : tu réponds aux questions de conformité avec un discours clair, pédagogique et ferme. IA appliquée, réglementation et formation (40 %) Réglementation IA (AI Act) : tu maîtrises les obligations du règlement européen sur l’intelligence artificielle et tu es responsable de leur mise en place au sein de la Compliance (et tout Green-Got). Cela inclut l’inventaire de nos usages IA, leur classification par niveau de risque, la documentation et les contrôles associés. Contribution au cerveau de Green-Got : tu participes à la construction et à l’alimentation de la base de connaissance partagée de l’entreprise, pour que les équipes et les outils IA s’appuient sur les mêmes informations, procédures et règles. Applications internes : tu repères les process de la Compliance qui gagneraient à être outillés, puis tu participes à la conception de ces applications avec l’équipe Data & IA. Skills Library : tu formalises les méthodes de travail de l’équipe (analyse de dossiers, rédaction de rapports, contrôles) sous forme de compétences réutilisables par les équipes et les agents IA, et tu les tiens à jour à chaque évolution de notre offre. Assistants et agents IA : tu participes à leur paramétrage et à leur amélioration, et tu mesures leur fiabilité avant toute mise en production. Formation de l’équipe : tu es le relais IA de la Compliance. Tu accompagnes tes collègues sur les outils et les bons usages, tu partages tes méthodes et tu aides chacun à monter en compétences, à son rythme. Veille et expérimentation : tu explores les nouveaux usages de l’IA dans un cadre maîtrisé et tu partages tes conclusions avec l’équipe. Maîtrise de nos outils internes : Notion est au cœur de notre fonctionnement. Tu le maîtrises et tu contribues à le faire évoluer pour l’équipe. Ta montée en compétences Les premiers mois sont consacrés à une immersion forte dans la production, pour bien comprendre nos process avant de les automatiser. Nous te donnons un cadre clair pour gagner en autonomie : Mois 1 : comprendre Green-Got, notre application et les fondamentaux de la Compliance. Mois 2 : maîtriser les outils et les sujets opérationnels. Mois 3 : être autonome sur les cas simples, continuer d’apprendre sur les cas complexes. Mois 4 : être pleinement autonome sur l’opérationnel et monter en puissance sur les projets Data & IA et sur la réglementation IA. Vos compétences Ton profil Nous recherchons un esprit agile et curieux, prêt à grandir avec nous. Quelqu’un qui a une véritable passion pour la data, la tech et les enjeux réglementaires, et qui veut voir l’impact concret de son travail sur une infrastructure financière que nous construisons avec conviction. Tu as une vraie envie de travailler, d’avancer et d’évoluer. Tu es prêt à un rythme soutenu, car la charge de travail peut être importante. Chez Green-Got, nous sommes rusés, responsables, nous recherchons constamment le progrès, nous allons vite et le collectif passe avant l’individu. Esprit analytique et algorithmique : tu allies une solide culture data (SQL, manipulation de bases de données, intérêt pour les LLM et le prompt engineering) à un esprit d’analyse affûté pour décortiquer les dossiers complexes, qualifier les alertes et détecter les comportements à risque. Curiosité sincère pour la conformité et la réglementation IA: tu n’es peut-être pas juriste, mais comprendre les mécanismes KYC, LCB-FT, IA Act et RGPD t’intéresse vraiment. Intérêt pour la réglementation IA : tu as envie de lire les textes et de les traduire en actions concrètes, qu’il s’agisse de l’AI Act ou des autres obligations qui encadrent nos activités. Autonomie et responsabilité réelle : tu avances avec assurance et respect de tes engagements. Tu identifies les problèmes, tu trouves des solutions et tu prends les rênes de tes sujets sans attendre qu’on te les confie. Force de proposition et d’initiative : ton rôle dépasse l’exécution. Tu questionnes, tu améliores, tu contribues. Rigueur et précision : dans un environnement réglementé, chaque action doit être tracée. Tu ne te contentes jamais de l’à-peu-près. Aisance rédactionnelle, éducative et relationnelle : tu as une plume soignée et tu sais traduire une situation complexe en explications simples. Goût pour la transmission : tu aimes partager tes méthodes et voir tes collègues progresser. Esprit d’équipe : la Compliance se construit collectivement, et le partage d’information brise les silos. Formation : tu démarres un Master 1 (ou une année équivalente en école d’ingénieurs, de commerce ou d’informatique), idéalement avec un ancrage en Data Science, IA, Statistiques, Économétrie ou Droit du numérique. Anglais opérationnel : indispensable pour documenter ton travail et échanger avec l’équipe technique et nos partenaires. Bonus : tu connais Notion, un outil de BI, ou tu as déjà mis les mains dans un projet IA appliqué. Un lien vers un projet qui te fait fier ? Nous adorons cela. Avantages Ce que nous t'offrons Green-Got entre dans une nouvelle phase. Avec l'agrément ACPR, nous construisons nos propres standards de compliance - avec les personnes qui nous rejoignent maintenant. La finance durable se construit avec les bons outils, les bonnes personnes, et une équipe qui sait ce qu'elle défend. Un rôle hybride unique : Le meilleur des deux mondes entre la gestion opérationnelle de dossiers qui ont du sens et la construction d'outils data/IA qui font vraiment gagner du temps et révolutionnent les manières de faire. De vraies responsabilités : Dès les premiers mois, tu portes tes sujets. Tes scripts et tes analyses ont un impact direct sur notre dispositif de conformité. Apprentissage : Aux côtés d'une équipe qui transmet ses savoirs opérationnels et en lien direct avec notre équipe Data & IA. Une équipe exigeante et soudée , qui sait aussi passer de bons moments ensemble. Un environnement en forte croissance , où les profils les plus engagés progressent vite. Le package Cadre : Alternance basée à Paris - minimum 4 jours au bureau / semaine. Rémunération : Selon la grille légale en vigueur (variable selon le niveau de formation et le type de contrat). Santé : Mutuelle Alan. Cohésion : Une journée d'équipe tous les semestres. Déroulement des entretiens Envoie-nous ton CV, une courte présentation de toi, ton calendrier d’alternance et, si possible, le montant de tes frais d’inscription. Nous t’appellerons rapidement pour faire connaissance, dès que ton profil aura retenu notre attention. Si ça matche, nous t'enverrons un Business Case à préparer. Entretien en visio avec Justé (Compliance Manager) et un futur collègue pour analyser le Business Case et faire connaissance. Échange de 15 minutes avec un autre membre de l’équipe pour le fit culturel. Entretien avec Adèle (Head of Operations). Entretien final avec Andréa (CEO). Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer ! title: Office & HR Administration Manager/in  (m/w/d)
description: Wir suchen eine herzliche, strukturierte und proaktive Persönlichkeit , die unser Office zu einem Ort macht, an dem sich alle wohlfühlen und gerne arbeiten – und die gleichzeitig administrative HR-Prozesse zuverlässig und mit einem guten Gespür für Menschen unterstützt. Wenn du Spaß daran hast, Ordnung, Energie und gute Stimmung ins Team zu bringen , dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Mit unseren Events XLETIX Challenge , Muddy Angel Run und XLETIX Kids begeistern wir jährlich über 250.000 Teilnehmende in Deutschland, Österreich und in der Schweiz. Du kümmerst dich darum, dass unser Arbeitsplatz immer optimal ausgestattet ist – funktional, einladend, gut organisiert und den Anforderungen des Arbeitsschutzes entsprechend. Du bist erste Ansprechperson für organisatorische Fragen rund um unser Office und sorgst dafür, dass sich Mitarbeitende und Besucher/innen bei uns gut aufgehoben fühlen. Du koordinierst das organisatorische Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender und sorgst dafür, dass alle wichtigen Informationen, Unterlagen, Zugänge und Materialien rechtzeitig vorbereitet sind. Du unterstützt bei Vertragsangelegenheiten, beispielsweise bei der Vorbereitung von Vertragsunterlagen, Vertragsänderungen und weiteren administrativen Dokumenten. Du pflegst und aktualisierst Mitarbeitendendaten in unserer HR-Software und unterstützt bei der Verwaltung digitaler Personalunterlagen. Du behältst wichtige Fristen, Termine und wiederkehrende HR-Prozesse im Blick und unterstützt bei deren zuverlässiger Umsetzung. Du arbeitest sorgfältig und vertraulich mit personenbezogenen Daten und bist bei administrativen Fragen eine verlässliche Schnittstelle für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte. Arbeitsschutz & Gesundheitsorganisation Du unterstützt das People & Culture Team bei der Organisation und Dokumentation von Arbeitsschutzthemen. Dazu gehören beispielsweise die Koordination von Erstunterweisungen, Schulungen, Vorsorgeangeboten und wiederkehrenden Terminen. Du behältst die Ausstattung und Rahmenbedingungen im Office im Blick und bringst Hinweise oder Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten aktiv ein. Du unterstützt bei der Pflege relevanter Übersichten, Dokumentationen und Informationen rund um Arbeitsschutz und Gesundheit im Arbeitsalltag. Teaminterne Events & interne Kulturmomente Du planst, koordinierst und begleitest teaminterne Events wie Teamfrühstücke, Offsite-Days, interne Workshops oder saisonale Highlights. Als Teil des People & Culture Teams arbeitest du eng mit deinen Kolleg/innen und den Führungskräften zusammen, um unseren teaminternen Events ein echtes „Wir“-Gefühl zu geben und für gute Erlebnisse im Alltag zu sorgen. Ansprechpartner/in für Employee Wellbeing Du hast ein offenes Ohr für die Anliegen unserer Mitarbeitenden und trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass sich alle im Team gesehen und gut unterstützt fühlen. Du identifizierst frühzeitig Bedürfnisse im Team und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg/innen des People & Culture Teams passende Impulse, Formate und Maßnahmen. Du unterstützt dabei, Informationen, Angebote und Ansprechpersonen rund um den Arbeitsalltag für alle zugänglich und verständlich zu machen. Gestaltung der Arbeitsumgebung & Teamkultur Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie unser Office und unsere Arbeitsumgebung noch angenehmer, effizienter und inspirierender werden können. Du treibst kleine und große Verbesserungen an – von der Atmosphäre im Büro bis hin zu Abläufen, Ritualen und Teamkulturmomenten. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung im Office Management, in der HR Administration, im People & Culture-Bereich oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit HR-Software, digitalen Personalakten oder administrativen Personalprozessen. Organisationstalent, Freude am Strukturieren und ein Auge für Details. Eine offene, freundliche und serviceorientierte Art, die Menschen gerne unterstützt. Einen verantwortungsvollen und vertraulichen Umgang mit personenbezogenen Daten. Fähigkeit, in einem lebendigen Arbeitsumfeld Prioritäten zu setzen und mehrere Themen parallel zu managen. Proaktivität und Lust, Dinge zu verbessern, Prozesse zu vereinfachen und Kultur aktiv mitzugestalten. Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an Teamarbeit. Zudem hast du richtig Lust darauf, überwiegend vor Ort zu arbeiten und das Office zu deinem täglichen Aktionsfeld zu machen. Für dich ist es kein Muss, sondern ein Vorteil, im Büro präsent zu sein, das Team zu sehen und direkt mit Menschen in Kontakt zu stehen. Was dich bei uns erwartet Ein Team, das deinen Spirit teilt: sportverrückt, kreativ und voller Energie. Vielfalt und Abwechslung: tiefe Einblicke in unsere Eventserien und vielseitige Aufgabenbereiche. Eine abwechslungsreiche Schnittstellenrolle zwischen Office Management, HR Administration und Teamkultur. Exklusive Vergünstigungen: Corporate Benefits bei zahlreichen Anbietern und Einzelhändlern. Persönliches Highlight: Family-&-Friends-Tickets für unsere Veranstaltungen. Regelmäßige Team-Events: Feiere mit uns den Erfolg unserer Projekte – vom After-Work-Drink bis zum Sommerfest. title: Senior Named Account Executive, Nordics
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Sweden</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>You aren't just selling a product; you’re selling the security, performance, and reliability that major enterprises require to stay competitive. You will be a foundational part of our growth story in the region, bridging the gap between complex technical challenges and the business value that keeps our customers ahead of the curve.</p> <h3>Why You’ll Love This Role</h3> <p>This is a <strong>builder’s role.</strong> We’re looking for a hunter who thrives on identifying opportunities, crafting a narrative, and navigating the nuances of enterprise sales.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>You’ll be an architect of growth:</strong> You will own your territory, build a strategy from the ground up, and nurture long-term, high-impact relationships.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>You’ll be a technical bridge:</strong> You will work alongside our solution engineers to demystify complex network architecture for stakeholders ranging from junior developers to the C-suite.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>You’ll work at scale:</strong> You’ll be supported by a world-class team, all while maintaining the agility of a lean, remote-first operation in Sweden.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Strategy & Execution:</strong> Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan. You aren't just hitting a quota; you’re building a lasting market presence.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>The "Hunt":</strong> Identify, qualify, and capture new Enterprise business across the Nordics.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>The Narrative:</strong> Translate Cloudflare’s powerful technical capabilities into compelling value propositions that solve real-world problems for your clients.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>The Negotiation:</strong> Lead contract negotiations and manage the full cycle of the sales process.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Partnership:</strong> Develop long-term, strategic relationships. Our customers stay because we solve their hardest problems—and you’ll be at the center of that.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Seasoned Experience:</strong> 6+ years of direct B2B experience selling into Enterprise/Large-scale organizations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Regional Expertise:</strong> A strong, established network within the Swedish market.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Fluency:</strong> Professional-level proficiency in both <strong>Swedish and English (Norwegian is a plus)</strong></p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Technical Literacy:</strong> A deep understanding of Cloud, Security, and how the internet actually functions. You don't need to write code, but you need to speak the language of engineering and infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>The "Builder" Mindset:</strong> You are self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Communication:</strong> You know how to tailor your message, whether you're talking to a CTO or a procurement lead.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Does this sound like your next challenge?</h3> <ul> <li>We’re looking for someone who wants to leave a mark on the Nordic market while helping to build a safer, faster internet for everyone.</li> <li><strong>Help us build a better Internet.</strong></li> <li>Cloudflare isn’t just another tech company; we are the infrastructure that keeps the Internet fast, safe, and reliable for millions of users worldwide. We provide the "plumbing" for the modern digital economy, and we’re looking for an <strong>entrepreneurial Account Executive</strong> to help us own the Nordic market.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>For Sweden based hires: Estimated annual salary is between SEK 1,586,000 - SEK 2,180,000.</p> <p>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description: At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath. Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day . We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams. We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin. We're hiring our first Data Engineer to own Superchat's data platform end to end, from raw product and business data to the gold tables the whole company reports on. Our engineers have already built the foundations, including a warehouse, pipelines, dbt and reverse ETL. Now we need someone to make the platform trustworthy at scale, with testing, monitoring, clear modelling layers and customer history over time. You'll set the standards for how data is modelled and documented, and work with a Business Analyst to build the gold tables that Finance, Sales, Marketing and Product rely on. Who We Want An experienced Data Engineer. You bring 3+ years of building and running data pipelines in production, ideally at a SaaS company. You've owned a data platform, or a large part of one, and you're comfortable making the architecture calls yourself. Strong in SQL and dbt. You write and review complex SQL with ease. You've built dbt projects with layered models, tests, documentation. At home in the Cloud. You have worked with Data Warehouses in the Cloud, ideally AWS Redshift. BigQuery or Snowflake is also fine. Reliability-minded. You think in tests, freshness checks, idempotent loads and backfills. You want to know the data is wrong before a stakeholder tells you. Curious about the business. You want to know what MRR, churn or an "active workspace" really mean, and you model data so those definitions hold everywhere they're used. Experience with subscription billing or product usage data is a plus. Who We Don’t Want Pure dashboard builder. You'd rather spend your days building dashboards and answering ad-hoc questions. That's our Business Analyst's job; yours is to build what they work from. Pure pipeline plumber. You move data from A to B but don't care what it means. Gold tables are only as good as the business understanding behind them. Over-engineer. You want Kafka, Spark and a lakehouse for data that fits comfortably in Redshift. We need pragmatic solutions that fit a 100-person company and can grow with it. Remote-only operator. You prefer fully remote work and don't want to build relationships in person. The data platform sits between many teams, and that works best with regular time together in our Berlin office. Our Data Stack Warehouse: AWS Redshift Ingestion: Airbyte, custom Python Transformation: dbt Orchestration: Dagster Reverse ETL: Hightouch BI: Metabase Infrastructure & CI: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions Your Day To Day Own ingestion from our product database, Chargebee, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Intercom, Amplitude and other tools, using Airbyte where it works and your own Python where it doesn't. Design and build the dbt models that take raw data to gold tables, with clear layers, naming and documentation that the Business Analyst and the rest of the company can rely on. Run orchestration in Dagster: schedules, dependencies, freshness checks and alerting, so a stalled sync gets noticed within hours. Build data quality in: dbt tests, source checks and CI on every pull request. Capture history where our source systems only keep the current state, so a question like "which plan was this customer on last March?" has an answer. Run the warehouse: Redshift performance and cost, access management, and AWS infrastructure in Terraform. Maintain the reverse ETL syncs (Hightouch) that send data back into HubSpot, Intercom and the other tools our teams work in. Why People Choose Us Mission that matters. Real impact on small businesses, not abstract metrics Funded with conviction. $18M raised and profitable Real ownership. You own the data platform end to end, not one step of someone else's pipeline Hybrid by design.
