title: Senior Software Engineer, Distributed Databases
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | London, UK (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Cloudflare's Developer Platform powers stateful, data-intensive applications across our network. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work across the database stack, from query planning and execution to transaction processing and durable storage.</p> <p>You'll make decisions that shape the consistency, durability, and latency guarantees that customer applications rely on.</p> <p>Correctness under concurrency and failure is central to the role. You'll define and implement how queries read and modify data, how concurrent transactions become visible, and how durable state is recovered. You'll validate these systems using deterministic simulation, workload testing, and evidence from production.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Improve query planning and execution, including index selection, row reads and writes, and performance as data volumes and access patterns change.</li> <li>Build transaction and storage paths that make writes durable and reads consistent. Define when changes become visible, how commits survive failure, and how recovery restores a correct view of the data.</li> <li>Design deterministic simulations that make rare event orderings and failures reproducible.</li> <li>Plan stateful upgrades that cannot be reversed by rolling back software. Carry them through staged rollout, failover, and recovery without putting existing data at risk.</li> <li>Participate in the service's on-call rotation and incident response.</li> <li>Own major changes from design through production. Coordinate implementation across teams when a change spans multiple parts of the service, and help trace failures across those parts.</li> <li>Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You have owned a database, storage engine, transaction system, or similarly correctness-sensitive stateful system from architecture through production. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete.</li> <li>You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe.</li> <li>You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery. You can apply those concepts when operations arrive out of order, components fail independently, or the network partitions.</li> <li>You write and debug concurrent production software in Rust, Go, C++, or another systems language. You can trace failures across process, network, and durable-state boundaries.</li> <li>You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. You know the difference between transient unavailability and incomplete or incorrect recovery, and when a system is safe to return to service.</li> <li>You have led investigations where failures crossed systems owned by several teams.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>You've worked on the internals of PostgreSQL, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, or another relational database and can trace a SQL operation from planning through commit.</li> <li>Your work on transaction processing or concurrency control has included defining snapshot visibility and recovery behavior.</li> <li>You've profiled database workloads and traced performance bottlenecks from query execution through durable storage.</li> <li>You've used deterministic simulation or another systematic method to uncover distributed-systems bugs that conventional tests missed.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Germany based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €102,000 - title: Customer Experience Manager - German Speaking

Unternehmen wie EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media und Nordsee sowie Prüf-, Inspektions- und Zertifizierungsgesellschaften setzen auf Lumiform (4,6 von 5 auf G2). Jährlich laufen über unsere Plattform Millionen von Prüfungen. Jede einzelne macht einen Arbeitsplatz sicherer, einen Prozess effizienter oder ein Produkt oder einen Service besser. Wenn du mit deiner Arbeit einen Unterschied in der Gesellschaft machen möchtest, dann arbeitest du hier an einem Produkt, das genau das jeden Tag tut. Über die Rolle Das ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der den nächsten Schritt gehen will. Du bringst bereits 1 bis 2 Jahre Customer Success mit und willst jetzt echte Verantwortung: dein eigenes Portfolio aus namhaften Enterprise-Kunden, das dir gehört und das du weiterentwickelst. Deine zentrale Kennzahl ist die Net Revenue Retention deines Portfolios. Das heißt, du denkst kommerziell und erkennst Wachstumspotenziale, kannst aber genauso souverän deeskalieren, kritische Situationen drehen und Churn verhindern, bevor er entsteht. Du bekommst kein „Startpaket" aus kalten Leads, sondern ein starkes Bestandsportfolio mit starken Marken, das nur darauf wartet, ausgebaut zu werden. Aufgaben Ownership deines Portfolios: Du verantwortest ein eigenes Book of Business aus namhaften Enterprise-Kunden, treibst es proaktiv statt auf Anfragen oder schlechte Health-Scores zu warten, und entwickelst es strategisch weiter. Net Revenue Retention steigern: Du treibst Renewals, erkennst Expansion-Potenziale (zusätzliche Use Cases, Standorte, neue Buying Center) und machst aus zufriedenen Kunden wachsende Accounts. Strategischer Sparringspartner auf Entscheider-Ebene: Du erarbeitest dir Zugang zu den relevanten Stakeholdern, führst strategische Account-Reviews und wirst zum Trusted Advisor deiner Kunden. Deeskalation und Churn-Prävention: Du erkennst Risiken früh, führst kritische Gespräche souverän und drehst gefährdete Accounts, bevor sie kippen. Onboarding, Aktivierung und Schulungen: Du führst neue Teams erfolgreich ein, leitest Workshops und sorgst dafür, dass deine Kunden das volle Potenzial der Software ausschöpfen. Produkt und Zusammenarbeit: Du bündelst Kundenfeedback strukturiert fürs Produktteam und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing und Produkt zusammen. Qualifikation Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Du bringst 1 bis 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Customer-Success, Account Management oder Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld, und willst jetzt den nächsten Schritt mit mehr Verantwortung gehen. Du hast ein kommerzielles Gespür: Du erkennst Expansions- und Wachstumschancen in deinem Portfolio und gehst aktiv auf sie zu. Du kannst deeskalieren: Auch in kritischen Situationen bleibst du souverän, findest Lösungen und hältst Kunden.Kommunikation ist eine deiner Stärken. Du gehst selbstständig in Gespräche, auch auf Entscheider-Ebene, und bleibst dran, bis der Termin steht. Du verstehst technische Konzepte und kannst sie verständlich erklären. Du denkst strategisch, planst vorausschauend und arbeitest gerne im Team. Benefits Ein eigenes Bestandsportfolio aus etablierten Kunden, das du eigenverantwortlich weiterentwickelst, mit klarem Weg zu größeren und strategischeren Accounts. Neben deinem Fixgehalt eine variable Komponente mit Umsatzbeteiligung, wenn du dein Portfolio in neue Buying Center hinein ausbaust (horizontale Expansion). Eine internationale Kundenbasis und die Chance, mit starken Brands auf Enterprise-Niveau zu arbeiten. Ein Produkt mit echtem Purpose: Millionen von Prüfungen pro Jahr, die Arbeitsplätze sicherer und effizienter und Produkte und Services besser machen. Modernes Büro im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte (Chausseestraße). Investition in deine Zukunft mit einem jährlichen Lernbudget von 500€. Zusätzliche finanzielle Anreize: monatlicher Sachbezug von 50€ oder Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft. Kostenlose Verpflegung: jederzeit guter Kaffee, Tee, Schorlen, frisches Obst sowie Bier oder Wein. Flexibilität und Balance mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Möglichkeiten. Ein internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien und offenem Feedback, in dem du viel Verantwortung übernehmen kannst. Wenn das nach dir klingt, dann lass uns sprechen. Wenn du bereit bist, mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen, dein eigenes Portfolio starker Kunden aufzubauen und an einem Produkt zu arbeiten, das täglich einen echten Unterschied macht, freuen wir uns auf dich. Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil genügt, ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. title: Engineering Manager - Developer Tools (Starcraft)
description: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are hiring a <strong>software engineering manager</strong> with a passion for developer experience and build tooling to have a positive impact on the day-to-day workflow of thousands of snap and charm publishers. To be successful on this team you'll need to be interested in packaging formats, build systems and automation that can simplify the lives of developers and engineers trying to ship software to the widest possible audience.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds <a href="https://snapcraft.io" target="_blank">snaps</a>, <a href="https://juju.is/docs/sdk/charmed-operators">charms</a> and more recently, rocks (<a href="https://opencontainers.org/about/overview/">OCI images</a>).</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://github.com/snapcore/snapcraft" target="_blank">Snapcraft</a> allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognized names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Likewise, <a href="https://github.com/canonical/charmcraft" target="_blank">Charmcraft</a> enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on<a href="https://charmhub.io/"> Charmhub</a>, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This Engineering Management role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for developer experience to build a career with Canonical and drive the success of the business. If you have an affinity for open source development, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.</span></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is a remote role, we are considering candidates in AMER time zones.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Leading your team to elevate the Linux developer experience.</li> <li>Demonstrating sound engineering principles through architecture, development and code reviews.</li> <li>Being responsible for planning, estimation and execution.</li> <li>Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Building and leading a distributed regional team of engineers.</li> <li>Offering coaching, mentoring, technical feedback and hands-on career development.</li> <li>Designing, embracing, and evangelizing great engineering and organizational practices.</li> <li>Being an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organization.</li> <li>Engaging with the wider open source community for feedback and collaboration.</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.</li> <li>Knowledge of modern high-level languages (Python, Go) as well as containerization technologies and primitives (Snaps, Docker, etc.).</li> <li>Experience in the design and architecture of command-line and server-side applications</li> <li>Software project management skills, encompassing risk assessment and resource allocation.</li> <li>Ability to balance technical leadership with effective team management.</li> <li>A passion for technology and a drive to work with intelligent, motivated colleagues.</li> <li>A track record of open source leadership and collaboration.</li> <li>Curiosity, flexibility, and a strong sense of accountability.</li> <li>A focus on soft skills, including passion, enterprise, and self-motivation.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p>

title: Senior Project Manager
description: About Taurus Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you. Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth. Tasks The Role We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Main Responsibilities Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments. Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations. Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company. Requirements Your Profile Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment. Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.). Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail. Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner. Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus. Willingness to travel to client locations as required Benefits What We Offer An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions. A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain. A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit. A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer. Note We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Consultant (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.</p> <p>With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.</p> <h2>Main Responsibilities</h2> <p>As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy Development:</strong> Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?</li> <li><strong>Structured Problem-Solving:</strong> Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.</li> <li><strong>Solution Design:</strong> Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.</li> <li><strong>Project Delivery:</strong> Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement:</strong> Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge & Practice Building:</strong> Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.</li> </ul> <h2>Candidate Profile</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.</li> <li><strong>Work Experience:</strong> Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility. </li> <li><strong>Business Acumen & AI Fluency:</strong> A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.</li> <li><strong>Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:</strong> Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Interpersonal Skills:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred.. </li> <li><strong>Work Eligibility:</strong> You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and the Build:</strong> Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.</li> <li><strong>Engineers, not hand-offs:</strong> Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.</li> <li><strong>Zurich Office Impact:</strong> As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.</li> <li><strong>Learning & Growth:</strong> Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.</li> <li><strong>Culture of Doers:</strong> Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.</li> </ul> <p>This position is based in <strong>Zürich or Lausanne</strong>.</p> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Able to translate complex technical workflows and data into clear, intuitive interfaces, with strong attention to visual detail, consistency and quality. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; able to present research and designs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. title: Fullstack DevOps Engineer (Trust and Identity)
description: Fullstack DevOps Engineer In a technically exciting and fast-evolving environment, you will help us build digital trust products for organizations. Our team enables the use of verifiable information in business processes: eID, verifiable credentials, organization identity, KYB, digital signatures, PDF validation, trust chains, and secure onboarding flows. Many trust, verification, and compliance processes are still manual, fragmented, and costly. We want to change that by building simple, secure, and easy-to-integrate products that allow organizations to verify information, trace it back to an authentic source, and create better user experiences for their customers and partners. As a Fullstack DevOps Engineer, you will design, build, and operate backend services, APIs, cloud infrastructure, databases, and selected frontend capabilities for these products. You will work closely with frontend engineers, product owners, business stakeholders, UX specialists, and ecosystem partners to turn complex trust and compliance topics into reliable production services. What impact will you have? Build and operate backend services and APIs using Java, Kotlin, and Spring Boot. Design secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions for eID, verification, onboarding, KYB, and compliance-related products. Work with AWS services, databases, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and infrastructure automation. Model and manage data across relational and/or NoSQL databases with a focus on reliability, traceability, and performance. Integrate frontend applications with robust APIs, authentication, authorization, and secure data flows. Contribute to frontend features where needed using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks. Take end-to-end DevOps ownership: from implementation and automated testing to deployment, monitoring, incident handling, and continuous improvement. Help the team build market-driven products that create real value, not just technical functionality. Must-haves: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent working experience. 5 years of professional experience in backend or fullstack software engineering. Practical experience with AWS cloud services. Good knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modelling, and query performance. Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, Git-based workflows, and production operations. Basic frontend experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern framework such as Vue.js , React, or Angular. Ability to work in an agile, international, and cross-functional DevOps team. Excellent written and spoken English. Nice-to-haves: Experience with identity, authentication, authorization, OAuth2, OIDC, eID, digital signatures, onboarding, compliance, or regulated B2B products. Knowledge of verifiable credentials, wallets, trust chains, PKI, certificates, or related digital trust concepts. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling. Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging, queues, or asynchronous processing. Experience with observability tooling, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting. Experience with frontend architecture, design systems, accessibility, or component libraries. Strong communication skills, pragmatic thinking, and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Want to know more about the team? Our work focuses on reducing manual verification, improving compliance workflows, and creating secure infrastructure that can be integrated into real business use cases. title: Stage - Service client : Onboarding

title: CDI - Head of Finance (Paris)
description: We are hiring a Head of Finance and to own the finance function end to end, reporting to the CFO: monthly close and reporting, budget and rolling business plan, board materials, cash, audits and the regulatory obligations of a syndic, across our French and German entities. It is a hands-on role for someone who can do every job in the team and wants to shape the function as the company scales. With our CFO focused on fundraising and strategic topics, you will be the day-to-day finance decision-maker, working directly with the CEO, the VPs and the German country manager. As Matera grows, including through acquisitions in France and Germany, there is scope to rapidly grow into a VP Finance role. What you will do 1. Operational finance and business plan (70%) : Own the monthly close of all entities (in France and Germany) and deliver the management reporting pack: P&L, cash, KPIs, reconciliation with the statutory accounts, reporting to investors and banks. Own the annual budget , built with every team lead, and the business plan , updated every month after the close, for France and Germany. Own cash : the cash forecast, collection from customers, bank loans and their covenants, financing files and data rooms. Deliver the statutory audits in France and Germany and the annual accounts and filings of every entity, as well as the obligations specific to a property manager: the financial guarantee ( garantie financière ) that protects our clients' money, and the certifications of the funds we hold on their behalf ( fonds mandants ). You also cover the research tax credit (CIR) and tax. 2. Strategic topics (20%) : Lead the finance team (4 people) and steer our external accountants and auditors on scope, calendar and fees. Prepare the board deck and investor materials with the CFO , including for our 2027 fundraise, and bring a clear finance view to strategic decisions: acquisitions, growth versus capacity, cash allocation, pricing. Drive our finance tools roadmap : selecting and rolling out an ERP (planned for late 2027), billing and payment tools, and automating data and reporting. Pick up whatever else lands on finance : supplier negotiations, legal structure of our entities, equity events. 3. M&A (10%) : work with the other teams on financial analyses, billing, and the integration of the companies we acquire. What success looks like after 12 months The monthly close and reporting pack land on a fixed calendar in both countries, without escalation Audits in France and Germany are signed on time and on fee; every entity's accounts are filed on time Garantie financière and fonds mandants obligations are met with no gaps The rolling business plan is the single reference for decisions, refreshed every month after close The weekly cash forecast is trusted by the CEO and the board; collection has improved measurably Every finance deliverable has a clear owner, and the German close runs locally The ERP is selected and its implementation is on plan What we offer Benefits Parental support : a gradual return at 80% for 4 weeks (paid at 100%), plus 5 extra days off per year when your child is sick. Responsible commute leave : 1 extra paid day off per year (can be split into two half-days) to encourage low-carbon commuting. Menstrual leave : 1 extra paid day off per month to manage painful periods. Sport : access to Wellpass for affordable gym and sports. Works council perks (Leeto) : discounts on culture and leisure (cinema, museums, theme parks…). Remote work : 2 days a week at the office. Career support : weekly one-to-ones with your manager, 2 performance reviews a year, and an internal mobility policy. A laptop and a work phone. Practical information Location : Paris 10th Contract : permanent contract (CDI), full-time, cadre status on a forfait jours basis Salary : €90k to €100k base, depending on experience Start date : before July 2027 What we are looking for You must have: 7+ years in finance, including at least 2 years owning the close and audits of a multi-entity company, for example as Head of Finance, Finance Manager or Senior Financial Controller. Hands-on experience of closing the books and running statutory audits in France : you know the French system (social charges, tax, statutory auditors). Experience in a group with entities in other countries (not necessarily Germany). You build and defend financial models (P&L, cash, headcount, churn) and can run a monthly business plan yourself. You have managed a small team, and you still like doing some of the work yourself. Fluent French and English , written and spoken. You are: Direct : you say when a number does not hold, including to the CEO. Hands-on and structured : you turn open questions into plans with owners and deadlines. Firm with suppliers : you manage auditors, accountants and vendors on scope, calendar and fees. Autonomous and comfortable with change : you have worked in a growing company that needed structure. Nice to have: Experience with a German subsidiary or parent company, or speaking German. Experience of acquisitions and their integration. Experience in a regulated environment or with client funds (real estate, property management, fintech). Experience of selecting or rolling out an ERP. Our hiring process 1️⃣ A 30-minute phone call with Camille, our recruiter 2️⃣ A technical discussion with Krystal, our CFO , and Valent, our current Head of Finance (45 min, video call) 3️⃣ A case study to prepare and present to the CFO and Head Of Finance (45 min, video call) 4️⃣ A meeting with Raphaël, our CEO , and the team, at our office (1h) 5️⃣ Reference checks, then an offer Good to know: 🕑 We do our best to get back to you quickly (within a week). Whether the answer is yes or no, you will receive an email from us, so remember to check your spam folder. ☝️ If you need any adjustments to take part in the interviews in the best conditions, let us know in your application or tell the recruitment team. description: About the role As Sales Manager for the French Market at Amenitiz, your primary objective is to ensure the day-to-day execution, coaching, and operational stability of a small, focused French sales team based in our new Lyon hub . You will be a hands-on manager - present in the detail, close to the numbers, and invested in each person's development. You are expected to make the team work: holding the cadence, removing blockers, running the pipeline, and making sure activity translates into results. We serve independent hoteliers across Europe: family hotels, boutique properties, and small chains that have long been underserved by technology designed for large chains. You will be leading people who sell something that genuinely makes a difference for hotel owners. This is a newly created role opening our first commercial hub in France. You won't start from a blank page: you'll inherit an existing customer base, pipeline, tools, sales methodology, and the full support of the wider commercial team in Barcelona. description: On recrute des Product Managers pour construire des produits data et IA chez nos clients grands comptes, du dataset jusqu’à l’agent en production. 👋 Tu travailles sur des données propres et utiles, et sur des produits IA que les équipes utilisent vraiment au quotidien. 🎯 Tes missions Ton métier de PM, avant tout Tu mènes la discovery : entretiens utilisateurs, cadrage des besoins avec les métiers, tests d’hypothèses avant de lancer quoi que ce soit en dev Tu construis la roadmap, tu priorises et tu tiens un backlog à la fois fonctionnel et technique Tu rédiges les epics et les user stories, et tu fais avancer le delivery en agile avec ton équipe Tu suis l’impact de ce qui sort avec des OKR et des KPI, et tu ajustes en fonction Le volet data Tu construis des produits data : data platform, API, datasets partagés entre équipes, tableaux de bord que les métiers ouvrent tous les matins Tu vérifies que les données existent et qu’elles sont exploitables avant de lancer un cas d’usage Tu travailles au quotidien avec les data engineers et les data scientists, et tu sais lire et interpréter la donnée par toi-même Le volet IA Tu pilotes des produits IA : assistants, agents, recherche sur la documentation interne (RAG), modèles de prévision Tu fais équipe avec nos AI Engineers : tu comprends leurs contraintes et tu challenges leurs choix quand il faut Tu suis la performance des modèles et surtout leur adoption réelle par les utilisateurs Tu aides les métiers à comprendre ce que l’IA peut faire pour eux, et ce qu’elle ne fera pas Avec l’expérience, tu prends des sujets plus structurants, comme la stratégie produit, la gouvernance de la donnée ou le passage à l’échelle d’un pilote IA, et tu accompagnes les PM plus juniors. 🧭 Ton évolution Chez nous, ce sont tes résultats en mission qui font avancer ta carrière, jusqu’à un rôle de Lead si tu en as envie. Comme Hubvisory a aussi une practice d’AI Engineers et une practice Orga & Transfo, tu peux élargir ton périmètre sans changer d’entreprise. 💡 Pourquoi Hubvisory On fait du Product et de l’IA depuis 2016, et rien d’autre Tu interviens chez Dior, Decathlon, Leroy Merlin, France TV… Tu te formes régulièrement sur des sujets qui te passionnent, comme l’IA générative, la data, le design ou la stratégie produit, et chaque mois les Hub’times te permettent d’apprendre de ce que les autres consultants vivent en mission Ton salaire est revu deux fois par an, et jusqu’à 22 % des profits sont redistribués en intéressement, à parts égales 💰 Salaire : de 46 000 à 58 000 € brut annuel selon ton expérience, plus l’intéressement et les primes (commerciale, ancienneté sur mission, cooptation). 👤 Ton profil Au moins 2 ans d’expérience comme PM ou PO Les bases du métier sont solides : discovery, roadmap, priorisation, backlog, user stories, agile (Scrum, Kanban), outils comme Jira ou Confluence Tu as déjà travaillé sur un produit data (API, datalake, data platform, BI) ou sur un produit IA (machine learning, IA générative, agents). title: Senior Product Manager
description: UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services . We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. We are a certified B Corporation , upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society. ✨ Our values Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value: Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables. Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy. Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients. The role 🔍 One wrong number in a pitch deck can cost a banker a client. Our users send pitch decks, financial models and investment reports to clients every day, and AI now writes a growing part of them. Someone has to make sure what goes out is right. You will own that problem. You will build the product that checks deliverables before they leave the building: numbers that match between the Excel model and the deck, totals that add up, sources and footnotes that are there, disclaimers that are complete, AI-generated text that says only what the data supports. This is a Senior PM role (L3 on our career ladder). You frame the problem, not only the solution. The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 You will join the Product team: 5 PMs, 2 product designers and 2 product marketing managers. You will work every day with a product designer and with your own engineering squad. You will report to Matteo , our Chief Product Officer. How we work 🤖 We are an AI-first product team. We lead the move to AI tools across the whole company, and we hold ourselves to that standard first. We build with AI. Our designers build and maintain front-end experiences themselves, directly in Claude Code. PMs test working prototypes with clients before development starts. We discover with AI. We regularly co-design experiences with customers using vibe coding: we build and change the prototype with them, in the same session. What this means for you: Short loops. An idea goes from a client call to something clients can click in days. Real ownership. You own the problem, the customer and the go-to-market, not only the backlog. Room to grow. AI skills are part of our career ladder. As a Senior PM, you will build skills and agents the whole team uses, and help set how PMs work with AI at UpSlide. Team goals 🎯 We run two workstreams: we keep improving the features thousands of financial professionals use every day, and we are building our new AI product. We launched our first AI product in April 2026 and we are rebuilding the full product around AI. Verification is a core part of that bet. Financial firms will only let AI produce client work if they can trust the output. If we make trust measurable, we win the deals our competitors cannot. Your responsibilities 🖋️ Own the verification product (50%) Run discovery with bankers, financial advisors, PE and asset management teams. Learn how they review a deck or a model today, what they miss, and what an error costs them. Define what "verified" means for each type of deliverable: pitch deck, financial model, investment report. Build and own the roadmap across 2 squads. Say no to good ideas to protect the important ones. Plan a quarter ahead and adjust. Test prototypes on real client files before development starts. Drive adoption and revenue (30%) Define the tracking plan before launch. Run a monthly metrics review of your area. Partner with Sales on key deals and with Product Marketing on launches. Send a weekly update an exec can read in 2 minutes. Mentor 1 or 2 PMs and interview candidates. Set the quality bar for AI (20%) Build the eval sets and guardrails for verification. Track false positives as closely as missed errors: a checker that cries wolf gets switched off. Make the cost, latency and accuracy trade-offs with Engineering. Set the quality standard our regulated finance clients expect, and make it reusable for other AI features. You will work with Notion, Azure DevOps, Figma, Claude and, of course, PowerPoint, Excel and Word with UpSlide. Your goals ⚡ After 3 months: you know our users and their deliverables. You have mapped the most common and most costly errors in decks, models and reports, from at least 15 client interviews. You have a first eval set and a prototype tested with clients. After 6 months: the first verification checks are live with design partner clients. You can show their accuracy (errors caught, false alarms) and you have a roadmap for the next two quarters. After 9 months: verification is a paid capability. It moves a metric the company tracks, for example paid AI adoption in a segment from X to Y accounts, or win rate against a named competitor. At UpSlide we have a career path to help you grow. From Senior PM, you can move to Lead PM (individual contributor, owning a strategic bet across several squads) or Group PM (managing 2 to 4 PMs). You are a great fit if you have: Built or rolled out an AI product used by real customers. You have designed prompts and evals, made cost and latency trade-offs, and you know how to spot when the model is wrong. This is a must. 5+ years in product management in B2B software, with a product area you owned end to end. Taken an ambiguous problem, framed it, and turned it into a plan a team could execute. Moved a business metric (revenue, retention, win rate) and can explain how your roadmap did it. A habit of building with AI every day: prototypes, specs, data queries, interview synthesis. Comfort with data: you define tracking plans and change priorities based on what usage shows. Clear written English. Your updates are short, factual and easy to act on. Hybrid work: 3 days a week in the office. Location: Paris We'd love it if: You have worked as an investment banker or in financial advisory (M&A, valuation, transaction services). You have built pitch decks and financial models and lived through late-night review cycles. You have worked on quality, review or compliance products (document review, audit, data validation). You have sold to or worked with regulated financial firms and know their security and compliance demands. You speak French. ✨ If you don't tick all the boxes but you think you'd be a great fit, please apply and tell us why. Recruitment process Intro call with Andréa (30 min): your background, your motivation, logistics. Interview with Matteo, CPO (45 min): the AI products you built or rolled out, what worked, what did not, and why. Case study with a PM, a product designer and an Engineering Manager (60 min). Cross-functional interview with Sales or Customer Success lead (45 min): how you work with GTM teams and with demanding clients. Final interview with Philippe, CEO (30 min): values and long-term fit. 🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive! ⚡ On average, our process lasts 3 weeks. What we offer 🌍 International environment: French start-up with employees across Paris, London, Berlin, New York, and Singapore, as well as users in more than 60 countries 🌱 Training & professional development: Custom onboarding plan per role Internal and external group training Collaboration with our sister company, IPH , which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management 🎉 Company events: Annual seminars: a global seminar in France and a teaminar in your country Office socials: monthly apéro, goûter every Thursday, breakfast every other Tuesday, and a Children’s Christmas party on top of the employees’ Christmas party, etc. Group activities: weekly yoga classes, monthly karaoke sessions, an indoor rock-climbing group, and participation in solidarity walks 🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc. 💻 Hybrid work: 2-3 days in-office per week Up to €500 reimbursed for remote work equipment ✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT in 2026, with one taken for Solidarity Day 🍴 Meal vouchers (Tickets restaurants): Swile card with about 220€ per month 👀 Social & Economic Committee (Comité d’entreprise): Enjoy several benefits with HelloCSE 👩‍⚕️Health: Health insurance (mutuelle) with Alan covered at 50% and available from your first day. You can extend coverage to your partner and children Osteopathy sessions at the office, largely covered by UpSlide 🚆 Commute: Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide 👶 Family support: Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents Flexible return to work options Help for parents with children up to 6 years old: Either 4 days of fully paid sick-child leave, or, up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement 🌳 Sustainability engagements: Certified B-Corp since 2022, which means we not only care about profit, but also about people and the planet Our founders pledged to invest 10 million euros in social and environmental solutions Volunteer days: A paid working day where UpSliders volunteer to a charitable cause Annual veggie lunch: A catered lunch with plant-based foods to raise awareness on the environmental impact of meat consumption and highlight a sustainable alternative More about UpSlide On top of exciting business challenges in a fast-growing market, you will find a friendly, caring, and challenging culture You will be met with opportunities to acquire new skills, learn from others in a multicultural environment, and grow as a person UpSlide employees have committed to making a positive impact on the world. We obtained B Corp certification in 2022 with strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. UpSlide is now 30% owned by employees. More info here: upslide.net/en/from-a-to-b-corp-our-mission-for-positive-impact/ As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you've joined UpSlide ✨ Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: IT Architect - Business Domain
description: Hoe laat je een CRM, BPM, procesautomatisering, pensioenadministratie en maatwerk goed samenwerken? Hoe kunnen we AI en data concreet inzetten binnen het pensioendomein? Als onze IT Architect voor onze businessdomeinen vertaal je businessvragen naar concrete IT-oplossingen en praktisch advies. Je helpt teams en stakeholders om onderbouwde keuzes te maken over applicaties, platformen en integraties. Daarbij kijk je verder dan één systeem: je zorgt dat oplossingen werken in de praktijk én passen binnen de architectuur voor het pensioendomein. Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt bij het Architecture team binnen de afdeling Digital Strategy, Architecture & Innovation. Samen met collega-architecten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de architectuur van het totale pensioendomein. Jullie verbinden de behoeften van de pensioenbusiness met de ontwikkeling van het IT-landschap en bewaken gezamenlijk de samenhang en richting binnen het domein. Je werkt nauw samen met business-, change- en platformteams en leveranciers om architectuurkeuzes te vertalen naar uitvoerbare oplossingen. Als IT architect voor het pensioendomein ligt je zwaartepunt bij applicatie-, platform- en integratiearchitectuur. Je overziet de samenhang tussen klantbediening, pensioenprocessen, data en technologie en maakt concreet wat een verandering vraagt van de betrokken systemen. Je werkterrein omvat CRM, BPM, portalen, pensioenadministratie, gegevensuitwisseling, marketing technologie en maatwerkapplicaties. Je bent geen architect voor één platform, maar adviseert over oplossingen over de hele keten vanuit het perspectief van de businessbehoefte binnen de kaders van onze IT platformdiensten. Je verantwoordelijkheden staan niet op zichzelf, maar maken deel uit van de gezamenlijke uitdagingen van de gehele architectuurafdeling. Vanuit je expertise draag je samen met je collega-architecten bij aan de volgende opgaven voor het totale domein: - Vertalen van businessbehoeften naar concrete architectuurproducten zoals applicatie- en integratieontwerpen en heldere ontwerpkeuzes. - Adviseren over de inzet van CRM, Pega BPM, AI platform en andere platformen voor klantinteractie, workflow, casemanagement en procesautomatisering. - Afwegen wanneer standaardfunctionaliteit, hergebruik, configuratie of maatwerk passend is, met aandacht voor kosten, complexiteit, beheerbaarheid en leveranciersafhankelijkheid door middel van het toepassen van onze architectuurprincipes. - Ontwerpen van de samenhang tussen applicaties, API’s, gegevensstromen en koppelingen, in samenwerking met data- en technologiearchitecten. - Uitwerken van doel- en transitiearchitecturen en praktische roadmaps, met oog voor bestaande systemen, technische schuld en lopende veranderingen. - Samen met collega-architecten bewaken van de samenhang over domeinen heen en vastleggen van belangrijke keuzes in begrijpelijke, bruikbare architectuurproducten. Wat vragen we van jou? - Wo werk- en denkniveau. - Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een architectuurrol, met aantoonbare ervaring in het ontwerpen en begeleiden van IT-oplossingen. - Een stevige IT-basis en ervaring met enterprise-applicaties, CRM, workflow-, BPM- en AI en dataplatformen en maatwerkontwikkeling. - Ervaring met applicatie-integratie, API’s en gegevensstromen; je kunt technische ontwerpen doorgronden en hierover inhoudelijk adviseren. - Vermogen om businessvragen te vertalen naar uitvoerbare ontwerpen, concrete aanbevelingen en heldere afwegingen tussen oplossingsrichtingen. - Een praktische, verbindende werkwijze: je schakelt makkelijk tussen businessstakeholders, ontwikkelaars en leveranciers, maakt complexe keuzes begrijpelijk en wordt een teamspeler binnen het architectuurteam. - Ervaring met het vastleggen van architectuur en ontwerpbesluiten, bijvoorbeeld met ArchiMate en TOGAF of vergelijkbare methoden; bruikbaarheid staat voorop. - Ervaring met Pega BPM is een pré. - Ervaring binnen pensioenen, verzekeringen of andere gereguleerde sectoren is een pré. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een NS Business Card of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten. Salaris per maand: Op basis van cao schaal 17 HAY is de range € 5.991,23 tot € 7.988,31 op basis van 36 uur. Enthousiast? Reageer dan snel via de sollicitatie button! title: Technical Support Engineer, Zero Trust
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Singapore or Tokyo, Japan</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>The Cloudflare Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical questions via phone, email, chat and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, we are always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - for better service and future product development.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <p>Do you love solving complex technical issues and interacting with people? Are you passionate about providing premium-level support to customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced <strong>Technical </strong><strong>Support Engineer</strong><strong> for Zero Trust </strong>to join our team. You will work with our largest and most technically sophisticated customers on a variety of technical support issues to ensure they can deploy and operate Cloudflare's Zero Trust solutions with confidence. </p> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor, providing advanced support for enterprise customers using Cloudflare’s Zero Trust platform, including products like Access, Gateway, and Teams.</li> <li>Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to identity, device security, and secure application access.</li> <li>Work directly with customers to diagnose and remediate configuration and integration challenges with authentication protocols (e.g., SSO, SAML, OIDC) and network security settings.</li> <li>Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical guides, and troubleshooting documentation for internal and customer use.</li> <li>Partner with Cloudflare’s Product, Engineering, and Security teams to escalate and resolve advanced customer issues.</li> <li>Provide feedback based on customer interactions to drive product improvements and ensure alignment with user needs.</li> <li>Assist customers in identifying and responding to security incidents, leveraging Cloudflare’s threat intelligence and security tools.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have a minimum of 4 years experience working as a Support Engineer / Sr. Support Engineer supporting networking or web security products.</li> <li>Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers.</li> <li>Strong customer service orientation and communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>You have experience supporting and troubleshooting multi-factor mechanisms (TOTP, SMS, FIDO, U2F, WebAuth, EMAIL, Push MFA, etc).</li> <li>Hands-on experience with identity and access management (IAM) systems, such as Okta, Ping Identity, or Azure Active Directory.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of authentication protocols (SAML, OIDC, LDAP) and secure web gateway technologies.</li> <li>Proficiency in networking fundamentals, including DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and traffic routing.</li> <li>Experience supporting cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS application integrations.</li> <li>You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience).</li> <li>Relevant certifications such as Cloudflare Certified Zero Trust Specialist, CISSP, or CCSP.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Foundational Representations
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://redditinc.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p><strong>Location: </strong>Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands.</p> <p>The <strong>Ads Foundational Representations (AFR)</strong> team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with. </p> <p>Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Multimodal & Content Embeddings</strong> - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space. </li> <li><strong>Contextual and Behavioral Relevance </strong>- Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge Graph Embeddings - </strong>Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights. </li> <li><strong>User Intent Modeling -</strong> Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc. </li> <li><strong>LLM-based Representations</strong> - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes</li> </ul> <p>The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.</p> <p>As a <strong>Staff ML Engineer</strong>, you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution. </p> <p>Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy & designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis & engineering, modeling & automation).  </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Providing technical leadership and mentorship to MLEs in the team: driving designs & their review, establishing best practices in analysis, modeling and engineering, keeping the bar high. </li> <li>Working closely with team/org leadership developing technical strategy for content-based embeddings & relevance for Ads.</li> <li>Developing new or iterating on existing embedding models for advertising use cases, ranging from aggregation pipelines to two-tower architectures and sequence models.  </li> <li>Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings. </li> <li>Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop. </li> <li>Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the various features we develop, end-to-end experimentation from internal benchmarks to downstream recommender system offline metrics to online experiments. </li> <li>Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ML systems by writing automated tests, monitoring performance, and implementing best practices for model management.</li> <li>Participating in modeling and coding reviews: You will review work by other team members and provide feedback to ensure that it meets the team's standards for quality and performance.</li> <li>Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models.</li> <li>Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving standards and bar raising, leading complex cross-functional projects: from requirements, design to cross-team/functional alignment and execution without direct people-management authority. </li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to different audiences, both verbally and in writing. </li> <li>Strong track record of working on content rich NLP/CV problems at scale, and using embeddings as a tool to solve them. </li> <li>Established data-driven approach for ML system development. Excitement about working with data and readiness to look behind the metric numbers. </li> <li>Familiarity with the Ads domain and/or Search/Recommender systems.</li> <li>Experience with mainstream DL frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with our stack (Python, Pytorch, Airflow, BigQuery, Ray, k8s, kafka, GCP)</li> <li>Tech leadership experience: mentoring junior engineers and leading complex projects. </li> <li>Hands-on experience with using/fine-tuning/building LLMs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li> <li>Family Planning Support</li> <li>Gender-Affirming Care</li> <li>Mental Health & Coaching Benefits</li> <li>Private Pension plan with Employer-matching</li> <li>100% employer-sponsored group medical plan  </li> <li>Income Replacement Programs</li> <li>Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off</li> <li>Generous Paid Parental Leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.  We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.  We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.  For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our <a href="https://redditinc.com/policies/candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors</a>.</span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.  Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.</span></em></p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
