title: Customer Support Coach
description: <div class="content-intro"><p data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">What Makes Cloudbeds Unique</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="1">At <a href="https://www.cloudbeds.com/">Cloudbeds</a>, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.</p></div><p><strong>How You'll Make an Impact: </strong></p> <p>As a Customer Support Coach, you will be the voice of and advocate for our customers, providing exceptional support. By resolving questions and troubleshooting issues across multiple channels, you’ll ensure a seamless experience for our hotel partners. Your contributions will strengthen client relationships, promote software adoption, and shape the future of our platform by sharing valuable feedback. You'll also play a key role in creating training materials, updating support resources, and staying ahead of system updates, making a lasting impact on our customers and team.</p> <p><strong>Our Customer Support Team:</strong></p> <p>Join a dynamic, fully remote team of over 60 global Customer Support professionals united by our goal of delivering exceptional customer experiences across live chat, email, and phone. We pride ourselves on our supportive, diverse, and collaborative culture, where continuous learning, growth, and innovation drive everything we do. Be part of a team that values connection, celebrates success, and always strives to exceed expectations!</p> <p><strong>What You Bring to the Team:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assist and support our existing customers (hotel properties) daily in the use of our software</li> <li>Resolve customers' inquiries via phone, email, chat, or any other media that Cloudbeds uses to help customers</li> <li>Troubleshoot and make outbound calls for escalated issues</li> <li>Foster strong customer relationships with empathy to drive loyalty, retention, and increased software adoption.</li> <li>Gather customers' feedback and requirements for future releases of the software</li> <li>Use training materials and attend company-wide online training sessions to keep up-to-date with the latest system updates</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Sets You Up for Success: </strong></p> <ul> <li>1+ years of hands-on, front-of-house hospitality operations experience at a hotel or resort — Front Desk, Night Auditor, Guest Services, Revenue Manager, Assistant Manager, or similar role at a quality property. (Airline, event, or food & beverage-only experience does not meet this requirement.)</li> <li>Previous experience in customer service or similar is a plus</li> <li>Native or Fluent in English</li> <li>Native or Fluent in Spanish/Portuguese/French/German</li> <li>Excellent communication skills and a positive attitude</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving skills and emotional intelligence</li> <li>Great levels of learning agility</li> <li>A compatible graduation course or more than 2 years of proven experience in the area</li> <li>Skill with computers and systems</li> <li>Excellent internet/wifi connection</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Work Authorization:</strong> Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.</p> <p data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0">What to Expect - Your Journey with Us</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="2">Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.</p> <p data-path-to-node="3">Learn more online at <a href="https://www.cloudbeds.com/">cloudbeds.com</a></p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong data-path-to-node="4" data-index-in-node="0">Cloudbeds <a href="https://www.cloudbeds.com/press/?press_type=company-news&news_category=awards">Awards</a>:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="5"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,0,0">Winner – Hotel Management Software | HotelTechAwards (2026)</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,1,0">Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2026)</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,2,0">Overall Top 10 Hotelier's Choice | HotelTechAwards (2026)</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,3,0">Finalist – Property Management Systems (PMS) & Channel Managers | HotelTechAwards (2026)</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,4,0">Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,5,0">Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024)</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="6"><strong data-path-to-node="6" data-index-in-node="0">Discover our Benefits:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="7"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="7,0,0">Remote First, Remote Always</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="7,1,0">PTO in accordance with local labor requirements</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="7,2,0">Fully Paid Parental Leave</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="7,3,0">Home office stipend based on country of residency</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="7,4,0">Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="7,5,0">Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling, and knowledge transfer</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="8"><strong data-path-to-node="8" data-index-in-node="0">Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="9">Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! title: Product Owner
description: Bouw mee aan eerlijke, betrokken en goed presterende teams Wij geloven dat iedereen een eerlijke kans verdient om te groeien en beloond te worden voor wat hij of zij bijdraagt. Daarom bouwt Learned software die organisaties helpt met heldere rollen, eerlijke en objectieve beoordelingen, gerichte ontwikkeling en transparante beloning. Dat gebeurt in één doorlopend proces. Honderden bedrijven, van scale-ups tot corporates, werken al met Learned en dat worden er nog veel meer. Daarom zoeken we versterking in team Product. Jouw impact als Product Owner Als Product Owner speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons platform. Jij zorgt dat onze ambitieuze roadmap niet op papier blijft, maar écht landt. Je vertaalt strategie, klantbehoeften en ideeën naar productverbeteringen die het verschil maken voor onze klanten. Wat je doet Samen met de Product Lead bepaal je en bewaak je de roadmap. Je kiest ook wat níét gebeurt. Je houdt vier development squads op koers: planning, kwaliteit en voortgang. Je ontwerpt zelf prototypes op basis van prompts en ons design system, en stemt de details zorgvuldig af met UX. Businessbehoeften vertaal je naar scherpe requirements en heldere prioriteiten. Stakeholders houd je aangehaakt bij releases en voortgang. Risico’s en afhankelijkheden zie je aankomen voordat ze een probleem worden. Jij verbindt strategie, development, design en business, en zorgt dat iedereen dezelfde kant op beweegt: richting de groei van onze klanten. Wie ben jij? Je weet hoe je complexe productontwikkeling in een softwareomgeving tot een goed einde brengt. Je houdt overzicht als er veel tegelijk gebeurt, je let op details zonder het grote plaatje te verliezen, en je krijgt mensen Wat je meebrengt Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als Product Owner bij voorkeur in B2B SaaS Je hebt een 'AI-first' mindset en gebruikt AI (zoals Claude) handig voor het ontwikkelen van prototypes en het opzetten van features. Je hebt meerdere squads tegelijk begeleid in een multidisciplinaire omgeving met development, design en business Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en durft nee te zeggen als het product daar beter van wordt Je werkt vanzelfsprekend agile (Scrum of Kanban) en kent tools als Jira of Productboard Je beslist op basis van data en klantinzichten, niet op onderbuikgevoel Je woont in of rondom Utrecht en werkt minimaal 3 dagen per week op ons kantoor Wat kun je van ons verwachten? Een salaris tussen €4.500 en €5.500 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur en afhankelijk van ervaring) Een duidelijk groeipad naar Senior Product Owner Bij contractverlening de mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan een aandelenregeling Een MacBook en alles wat je nodig hebt om je werk goed te doen 25 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis Reiskostenvergoeding Pensioenopbouw via Brand New Day: 10%, waarvan wij 50% bijdragen Een jaarlijks persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 (o.b.v. fulltime) Een ambitieuze, internationale werkomgeving (meer dan 7 culturen!) waar we elkaar scherp houden én successen vieren Uiteindelijk komen we maar op één manier erachter of het klikt? Solliciteer snel en dan drinken we een (digitale) kop koffie! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Computational Biologist
description: About Proxima Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, Yosemite among others. Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time. In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions. Proximity-based therapeutics represent one of most promising frontiers in modern drug discovery with the potential to treat previously intractable diseases and target ‘undruggable’ proteins. Our technology combines proteome-scale structural data with state-of-the-art generative AI foundation models, and coupled with our talented team of scientists and engineers we are uniquely well-positioned to discover and develop a new class of medicines. Come join us! About You: Proxima is seeking highly-motivated Computational Biologists interested in building the leading AI-enabled drug discovery platform for novel induced proximity therapeutic modality. Successful candidates will work closely with the Computational Chemistry, Machine Learning and Application Engineering teams to tap into the wealth of evolutionary, structural and -omics data to unlock the full potential of unified machine learning representations and large-scale geometric deep learning generative models. Projects may include designing large-scale scientific workflows for mining public and unique in-house data; developing novel systems biology and structural biology computational methods, tools and algorithms; and/or designing, training and fine-tuning best-in-class machine learning models. In our projects we apply induced proximity approaches to some of the most challenging targets considered “undruggable” as well as discover, build and develop novel proximity platforms spanning across multiple targets and disease areas. We value individuals who want to make an impact, have a deep intellectual curiosity, enjoy solving challenging problems and have a track record of achievement. At Proxima, we believe that success is determined by talent and hard work, and individuals are given equal opportunities to grow and advance based on their abilities and contributions. Key Responsibilities: Develop pilot capabilities and create large-scale data pipelines from the ground up Collaborate with other teams across Proxima and partnering organizations to achieve project goals by contributing code, analyses, benchmarks, optimizations and ideas to ongoing research-driven projects Integrate biological insights into the next generation of AI/ML models for drug discovery Validate and interpret computational predictions by working closely with experimentalists Basic Qualifications: Hold an MSc or PhD degree in computational biology, bioinformatics or a related field Possess mixed academic and/or industrial experience, preferably in the biotech industry Have a strong background in computational structural or systems biology Demonstrate strong programming skills in Python, R and/or other languages Experience building reproducible and scalable computational biology workflows Experience designing and applying machine learning models Preferred Qualifications: Experience with geometric deep learning, graph neural networks, protein language models, transformers and representation learning is a plus Preferably have prior exposure to drug discovery problems Experience working with cloud-based infrastructure Agile project management Full-Time Employees at Proxima enjoy these Perks*: Highly competitive salaries Company Equity Package, everyone is a stakeholder! 401(k) + Company Match Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options) 13 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time Maternity leave 18 Weeks of fully paid leave + 6 weeks for Paternity leave In-Office Lunch (5 days per week) *for US based FTEs, country specific benefits apply for locations outside US Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Legal Counsel - Commercial and AI
description: About H: Our agents act on computers for our customers, clicking through software and filling in fields, so our contracts have to answer some awkward questions. Who owns what an agent produces? Who answers when an output turns out to be wrong? Can customer data train our models? Our terms already take a position on all three, and they're public: read our general terms of service and our data processing agreement , both in French, under French law, and last updated in June 2026. This job is drafting and negotiating contracts like these, and keeping them current as the product and the law move. H builds computer-use agents for enterprises, from Paris. In July 2026 we launched Computer-use Agents , fully managed agents that take actions on computers. What you own Our business teams bring in the deals. You'd write the paper behind them and lead the negotiation. When AI regulation or data protection law changes, you'd help work out what our contracts need to say now. You'd report to Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, who is also the data protection officer named in our DPA . What you'd be doing Drafting and advising on a wide range of contracts, AI service agreements among them, with customers, partners and suppliers. Working through the other side's mark-up. Our general terms cap our liability on paid services at the higher of €100 or the previous 12 months' fees, for example. When a customer's lawyers push on it, you'd work out where we hold. Then you'd make the argument. Turning new products and new AI law into contract changes and negotiation guidance. What we ship includes open-weight models: Holo3-35B-A3B is on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. Answering engineers and business teams on how to deploy AI within the rules. Customers can see on our Trust Center that we hold ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 1 and SOC 2 Type 2, and which subprocessors we use. When needed, questions outside contracts: employment, corporate or competition law. Who you'd work with Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, is hiring for this role. You'd join our Legal team and work closely with engineers and business teams. What we think it takes Likely a good fit if you Hold a master's in law and are admitted to the bar. Have a minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant legal experience. Know data protection law well (GDPR and the rules around it), along with IP, contract law and liability, and regulatory compliance. Have worked somewhere that was growing fast. Can explain a legal position plainly to an engineer. Work well on your own and adapt when plans change. An international outlook matters here too. Stronger still if you built that experience negotiating contracts at a tech or AI company. You do not need to have worked at an AI company before. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway. How we hire Three conversations. First a 30 minute call with our Talent team, then 30 minutes with Julie, and last a conversation with a member of our leadership team. Practicalities It's a hybrid job: you'd be in Paris with the team for three days in an average week. We offer a competitive package. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Lawyer
description: About us Omnilex started by building the AI workspace lawyers actually want to use, including the world's first AI-powered legal commentary, a living layer of legal understanding that redefines how lawyers work. In just one year, that product became the daily tool of thousands of legal professionals across Switzerland, Germany, and Liechtenstein, and a leading legal AI workspace in those markets. Now we are using that foundation to build something even bigger: the AI-native law firm. Every case our lawyers solve becomes a productized, AI-native service. Legal capability that scales, compounds, and can be deployed on demand for the next client. With a 4.5M raise, we're scaling this across Europe. You'll be joining a young, passionate, and dynamic team of 19. The role You are a lawyer, and you bring your book of relationships with you. You pick up real customer cases and solve them using Omnilex as your weapon. Then you do something almost no lawyer has ever done: you take what you just built and turn it into a productized, AI-native service that the next customer can run on demand. You own the customer end-to-end. You're the person they call, the person they trust, and the person whose name shows up when the contract gets renewed. The legal teams you work with are some of the most demanding in Europe, and they expect to talk to a lawyer. That's you. What you will do Solve the cases Pick up real customer matters. Do research, drafting, structuring arguments and deliver work product that holds up. Be the lawyer in the room when a customer hits a wall they cannot get over alone. Legal-engineer cases into AI-native services After each case, decompose what you did into reusable building blocks: prompts, workflows, templates, knowledge. Work with product and engineering to turn those blocks into services any customer can run on Omnilex. Maintain a portfolio of services you own and iterate with product and engineering until they are as good as the original work. Own the commercial relationship Be the named lawyer on the account. Senior partners, GCs, and heads of legal deal with you directly. Convert pilots into multi-year contracts, expand into new practice groups, more seats, and deeper workflows. Use your existing network to open doors that take Sales months to crack. What success looks like A library of AI-native services you authored is in production and used daily by companies. Customers in your portfolio renewed, expanded, and brought in referrals because of you. Revenue under your ownership grew meaningfully quarter over quarter. Who you are Swiss bar admission with 2 to 6 years of post-qualification experience. You currently work at a Swiss mid-size firm or boutique and run your own cases. You work directly with clients today, not through a partner. Portable client relationships: clients or referrers who would follow you, or a concrete plan to build them. An existing professional network of lawyers, GCs, partners or alumni. Commercial instinct: you can explain a legal solution to a client in five minutes, with a structure and a recommendation, without a script. A genuine interest in legal craft and in how AI is changing the practice of law. Comfortable working with managing partners, GCs, engineers and founders. Native German and fluent English. French is a plus. Why join Omnilex You will do legal work that actually matters. Cases for the most sophisticated legal teams in Europe. You will own a portfolio of customer relationships with real commercial upside. You will productize your own legal expertise. The services you build outlive any single matter and compound across the platform. Competitive salary and transparent ESOP. You are early enough that ownership means something. title: People & Workplace Manager
description: About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. The Role Davis is in a phase of strong acceleration . The team grows every month, our client base is widening and we are expanding in the US and in the Middle East. Our founders spend their days with developers, investors, partners and candidates, and every hour they lose to logistics is an hour taken from the company. Your job is to make sure that does not happen. The role sits at the centre of the company and has two sides. On the people and workplace side , you work with our Chief of Staff and own the employee journey, our team rituals and our offices, in Paris and in the new ones we open abroad. On the executive side , you work directly with our co-founders, from their calendars to their board meetings. You are the first point of contact for the team and for everyone who walks through our door. What you will be working on: Own the employee journey Owning the onboarding experience end to end, from equipment and access to the first few weeks, so new joiners can contribute from day one. Handling offboarding with the same care, along with the HR admin that comes with each arrival and departure. Being the first point of contact for the team's everyday questions and needs . Build culture and community Running and improving our team rituals , from team lunches and drinks to company gatherings. Organising our offsites and our presence at industry events . Creating moments that help people connect and celebrate progress , across offices and time zones. Listening to the team and turning feedback into concrete improvements . Shape our workplaces Running our Paris office end to end, from vendors and supplies to welcoming the clients and investors who visit us. Leading the opening of our new offices abroad over the coming months, from finding the right space to making it work for the team. Managing workplace vendors, contracts and budget , and handling invoices and expense reports . Support the founders Owning the founders' complex, multi-time-zone calendars and travel logistics , and protecting their time for the work that moves Davis forward. Preparing their key meetings with clients, investors and the board, and making sure every follow-up gets done. What We Are Looking For You have 1 to 3 years of experience in a fast-growing startup . You are fluent in French and in English . You have warmth and empathy , and a genuine interest in helping people feel good and work better. You anticipate needs before they are voiced, and once you start something, you see it through. You are at ease switching from a travel booking to an office issue to a board meeting in the same morning. You are rigorous with admin , and you have already handled invoices, expenses or onboarding. You are very comfortable using AI , and you learn fast . Nice to have Experience opening or setting up an office, ideally abroad. Experience in people operations in an international company. Event organisation, from offsites and team events to trade shows. Experience working directly with a CEO or founder. Familiarity with modern finance and HR tools (accounting, payroll, applicant tracking). An interest in real estate, architecture or AI. Why Join Davis Shape the Davis experience for every person who joins, at a moment the team grows every month. Open our offices abroad , and build how Davis works across countries. Work directly with the founders , in a seat that sees every part of the company. Grow with the company , as the role expands with Davis. Competitive salary and benefits , including meal vouchers, health insurance and a sports membership. A world-class team of AI researchers, engineers, architects and real estate experts, backed by world-class VCs. More About Davis The Team Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20 , and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle. Today our team brings together technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA, architects and deep real estate expertise, and it grows every month. We are small with an extremely high bar , and we intend to keep it that way. Why We Will Win Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated. Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work , AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager - Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL) + Market Interactions, Paris (Français & Anglais)
description: Job title: Product Manager - Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL) Lieu : Location: Paris, France — (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau) Team: Product Management Contrat : CDI Reporting To: Group Product Manager Merci de noter : ce poste est basé en France, vous devez y résider ou envisager de vous y installer, et il nécessite un droit de travail existant dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions cette possibilité poste par poste, alors n’hésitez pas à consulter régulièrement notre site carrières pour découvrir de futures opportunités. Le français et l’anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous remercions de soumettre votre CV en anglais. À propos de Kaluza Kaluza est l’Energy Intelligence Platform : nous transformons la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié. Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les équipements, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours. Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen. Ce que vous ferez Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec une équipe d’ingénieurs logiciels sur l’expansion belge de notre domaine Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL), l’un des domaines produit centraux de la plateforme Kaluza. Il gère les informations sur les clients, les comptes et les contrats, et porte les parcours client associés (par exemple un déménagement ou un changement de contrat). C’est un domaine full stack : une interface pour les conseillers du service client, des API qui exposent les données et des services backend qui portent les bases de données et la logique de workflow. Vous travaillez donc sur l’ensemble du domaine produit. Ce n’est pas un poste de product owner : vous portez des fonctionnalités de bout en bout, du dialogue avec les clients et les utilisateurs jusqu’à la livraison du logiciel, en animant le quotidien de l’équipe et la discovery. Des déplacements ponctuels en Belgique sont possibles (environ deux par trimestre). Traduire les exigences du marché belge en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché belge de l’énergie en exigences produit précises. Devenir le partenaire de confiance du client : travailler main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché belge pour comprendre leurs besoins, mener la discovery en ateliers afin de définir comment le produit fonctionne et de cadrer le périmètre, construire les exigences ensemble et bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vers vous en premier. Cette proximité vous aide à orienter ce que CAL construira ensuite. Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel, en interrogeant les données, en explorant les schémas d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez l’IA (par exemple Claude Code) chaque jour comme un multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer, pas seulement pour rédiger des documents. Aligner les équipes globales et locales sur toutes les fonctions : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, le QA et d’autres équipes, avec une influence full stack, en animant le quotidien de l’équipe (priorités, cérémonies, réunions), pour que chacun vise les bons résultats. Vous faites le lien entre les équipes globales et locales pour nourrir les priorités et la stratégie. Ce que vous apportez Idéalement, vous avez ou vous êtes : Une expérience avérée de Product Manager , de Business Analyst ou d’un rôle équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un parcours réussi de localisation de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux. Un français courant et un anglais professionel : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, et vous passez facilement de l’une à l’autre langue. De l’aisance en direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les profils seniors alignés et impliqués. Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard et concret, vous êtes à l’aise pour construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt que d’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les données et les modèles de données, les bases de données et les API, et vous savez prototyper avec les outils d’IA modernes. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur, mais vous pensez comme tel et vous tenez votre place dans une conversation technique. Vous raisonnez aussi bien sur un modèle de données que sur ce que l’utilisateur final voit à l’écran. Une communication claire et incisive, et l’habitude du travail transverse : vous savez aller à l’essentiel et expliquer la complexité technique et marché à des publics variés, clients compris. Vous collaborez avec l’ingénierie, le QA, le BA, le programme, le delivery, etc., pour livrer des solutions localisées. La maîtrise des outils d’IA à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et l’idéation jusqu’à la livraison et l’itération. Nos valeurs Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza : Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle. Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets. Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole. Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego. Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue. Nos avantages Rémunération & protection : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle Alan, prévoyance (assurance vie et décès) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage) Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport domicile-travail, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 € Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + 1 jour pour votre anniversaire + jours fériés + jours de RTT (11), congés « Moments That Matter », congé pour événement familial, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, flexibilité dans l’organisation du travail et éligibilité à un congé sabbatique (Career Break) Venez comme vous êtes Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur la base du mérite et du potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis de vous lire. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre careers page et sur LinkedIn. Notre politique de protection des données des candidats est disponible here . Compensation: €46K – €63K • €46K – €63K Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. This is a hands-on, full-stack product role — you'll work across the whole domain and alongside PMs from other domains and from the global billing teams to ensure the overall billing journey from meter to bill meets the requirements of French clients. Collaborate intensely with clients and in-country experts to understand their unique needs and requirements, negotiate scope, and build a roadmap. Deep dive into French energy market regulations , translating complex compliance needs into detailed product specifications for the billing system. Define and manage detailed product requirements for features related to country-specific needs from getting a read to generating a bill (meter reading protocols, invoice formats, taxation rules, payment methods, and regulatory reporting). Work closely with engineering, UX, and QA teams to ensure the successful implementation and testing of localised billing functionalities. Act as the go-to expert for global teams on specific French market nuances related to energy billing and customer journeys. Continuously monitor changes in French energy legislation and market practices, proactively adapting the product roadmap to maintain compliance and competitiveness. A track record in regulated markets where billing complexity matters, energy, telecoms, financial services, or similar. Familiarity with the French energy market (ENGIE, CRE, switching, tariff structures) is advantageous. Exceptional ability to translate abstract regulatory text or client requirements into clear, actionable, outcome-driven requirements for development teams. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, legal, operations, client success) to deliver localised solutions. Excellent stakeholder and client management skills , able to lead conversations across requirements, scope, expectations, and roadmap alignment, and communicate technical & market complexity clearly to varied audiences. Proficiency in AI tools throughout all stages of the product lifecycle — from discovery and ideation to delivery and iteration.Fluent in French and English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both. A builder's mindset — you're autonomous, learn fast, and aren't afraid to go deep. Comfortable with ambiguity and pace — you can operate effectively when not everything is defined, know when to make a call, and aren't afraid to escalate or ask for help when it matters. Fluent in French and very comfortable in English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both Kaluza Values Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business: Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together We want the best people We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. title: hbo-stage Analyseren kwaliteit bouwvergunningen BAG
description: hbo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste student die graag in data duikt en op zoek gaat naar opvallende patronen en verbanden? Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG). Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen. Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid. Je onderzoekt onder andere: Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties? Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG? Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen? Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed en de woningmarkt. We maken statistieken over (bouw)vergunningen, ontwikkeling van de woningvoorraad, (gemiddelde) WOZ-waardes, eigendomsverhoudingen, tijdelijke woningen, woningtransformaties en nog heel veel meer. We doen statistisch onderzoek op verzoek van organisaties in de publieke sector. En we beheren en verwerken data voor CBS-collega’s en werken samen met diverse organisaties, waaronder het Kadaster, de ministeries van BZK, VRO en EZK en Eurostat. We publiceren regelmatig over de dynamiek van de Nederlandse vastgoed- en woningmarkt. Onze nieuwsberichten halen regelmatig journaals, nieuwssites en voorpagina’s van landelijke dagbladen. En daar zijn we trots op! Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een hbo opleiding in de studierichting toegepaste wiskunde, data science of sociale wetenschappen. Je hebt affiniteit met de woningmarkt. Je hebt kennis en wellicht ervaring met R/rmarkdown en/of Python en SQL databases. Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en enthousiast om met data aan de slag te gaan. Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te ontdekken, neemt graag initiatief en denkt actief mee. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook graag de samenwerking op. Je deelt gemakkelijk je ideeën en bevindingen en staat open voor nieuwe inzichten en feedback. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: samenwerkt met ervaren experts binnen hun vakgebied; gaat werken met grote databases (SQL); kennis opbouwt van de BAG en het registratieproces bij bronhouders; analyses samenvat in data visualisaties en overzichtelijke tabellen. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking. What’s in it for you? Je komt te werken in een gedreven team waar werkplezier, samenwerking en ontwikkeling belangrijk zijn. Als Logistiek Teamleider krijg je een verantwoordelijke en afwisselende rol waarin je direct bijdraagt aan de prestaties van het logistieke team. Je krijgt ruimte om mee te denken over verbeteringen, collega's te helpen groeien en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen BERG. title: Senior Customer Success Manager (with Ed-Tech experience)
description: Are you passionate about transforming how large organizations learn and develop? Imagine being the trusted advisor to some of the world's most prestigious brands, guiding them through learning journeys that change how their HR teams perform. At AIHR, we are looking for a full-time Senior Customer Success Manager / Learning Consultant (with Ed-tech experience) who will turn every learning initiative into a clear story of performance improvement and organization-wide impact. Join us and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of the HR industry! About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world's market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, including companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. Our goal is to upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR professionals. We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. We strive to provide the world's best courses and excellent support to our customers, while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. As a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility, with countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and to craft your own role. Role and Responsibilities As a Senior Customer Success Manager (with Ed-tech experience) , you enable AIHR's largest B2B clients to run successful learning initiatives and build a culture of learning. At AIHR, we call this role Learning Consultant rather than Customer Success Manager, because your focus goes beyond account management. You act as a strategic advisor, guiding customers in designing and implementing learning journeys that drive measurable impact. You own a dedicated portfolio of our largest and most complex enterprise customers, from onboarding to adoption, all the way to renewal. What does that look like in practice? Strategic partnership: You build strong, multi-level relationships with senior stakeholders (CHROs, VPs and Heads of HR, Heads of L&D) and make sure AIHR stays aligned with their business objectives. Joint Impact Plans: You diagnose customer needs and co-create a Joint Impact Plan that connects our learning solutions to their business goals, with clear metrics to show return on investment (ROI). Enterprise onboarding and adoption: You onboard large customers and design the change management and communication strategy that embeds the AIHR platform in their learning culture. Portfolio health: You take full ownership of your portfolio's health. You use the Customer Health Score in HubSpot to spot risks early and act before they turn into churn. Commercial partnership: You co-own commercial goals with our Growth Account Executives. Your deep customer knowledge shapes the renewal and expansion strategy for your accounts. Team excellence: You mentor other Learning Consultants and help develop the team's best practices and playbooks. You are successful when your clients' learners show improved work performance, not just when they complete a program, and when AIHR's impact makes them want to grow the partnership. Ultimately, your client's success is your success. Your goal is to develop their learners into T-shaped HR professionals . On a typical day You arrive at our beautiful office in Rotterdam or Amsterdam, grab a coffee, and after a quick chat with colleagues, you fire up your MacBook to check your calendar. You start by reviewing your portfolio in HubSpot, our single source of truth, paying close attention to the Customer Health Score to prioritize your actions for the day. Your morning starts with a Quarterly Strategic Check-in with the VP of HR at one of your key accounts. You present a clear story of their progress and ROI, using learning and engagement data you analyzed with the help of an AI skill. Afterward, you have a 1-1 with your manager, Emilie , to build a multithreading strategy for an account where you only have one champion. Later, you spend time with Dieter, one of our superstar SMEs, to plan a thought leadership session for your customer's HR leadership team. After a delicious lunch in the office with the team, you dedicate time to a new enterprise client, Ahold Delhaize, documenting their business objectives to build their Joint Impact Plan and rollout communication strategy. You then join Jessica, our Growth Account Executive, to align on the commercial strategy for an upcoming multi-year renewal, so you show up as one team. Next, you sit down with a newer Learning Consultant to prepare a difficult conversation with one of their customers. Before the day ends, you contribute to an internal project, sharing customer feedback about new features and improvements with the product team, including insights you summarized by feeding call transcripts into Gemini. To wrap up the week, you join the team for a drink during our weekly activity, celebrating joint successes and getting to know new colleagues. title: Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – AI & Digital Natives (East)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: NYC, Boston, Atlanta, Miami OR Carolinas</strong></p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare's North America Startups segment is growing its U.S. East go-to-market team. The goal is to win the fastest-growing AI-native and digital native companies early and grow with them as they scale. A new generation of companies is building AI models, agents, AI apps and developer tools, and many of them can go from seed funding to global scale in under two years. Cloudflare wants to be the platform they build, run and secure on from their first line of code through their IPO.</p> <p>As the Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – East, you will lead the managers and Account Executives (AEs) covering venture-backed AI and digital native companies across the eastern U.S., including New York, Boston, the DC area, Atlanta and Miami. You'll own revenue, hiring and Cloudflare's reputation in the East Coast startup and venture community, while keeping the Cloudflare culture. This role suits builders who like speed, technical buyers and the challenge of turning fast usage growth into lasting, multi-million-dollar customer relationships.</p> <p>You'll set strategy for the region and lead a team that sells to founders, CTOs and heads of engineering and infrastructure. Your team will:</p> <ul> <li>Move fast deals forward without losing sight of the long-term account</li> <li>Turn companies already on Cloudflare's free and pay-as-you-go plans into committed contracts</li> <li>Work with Product, Developer Speedboat, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and the Cloudflare for Startups program to make Cloudflare the default choice for AI-native builders</li> </ul> <p>Success means startups that love Cloudflare and recommend it, have grown alongside us from early stage to scale, and run their most important workloads on our Developer Platform, AI products, application security and network.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Drive revenue growth</strong> across new customers, expansion and conversion of pay-as-you-go accounts to contracts. Build a sales motion where usage growth opens the door to the next use case.</li> <li><strong>Lead a team of Regional Sales Directors</strong> and their Startup Account Executives. Also lead indirectly, the Solutions Engineers, Business Development Reps, Customer Success and Field Marketing teams who support startup accounts.</li> <li><strong>Build the East Coast startup sales team.</strong> Work with your Ecosystem and Recruiting to hire people who are technical, sharp about the business and comfortable talking with founders and engineers.</li> <li><strong>Spot breakout companies early.</strong> Use funding rounds, usage data, hiring and developer adoption signals to find likely winners, then win them before they lock into AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel or other platforms.</li> <li><strong>Make venture investors a growth channel.</strong> Build relationships with VC firms, accelerators and startup programs across the East Coast, working with the Cloudflare for Startups and Workers Launchpad teams to bring in companies at the earliest stages.</li> <li><strong>Help shape the product roadmap.</strong> Bring what AI-native customers need back to Product and Engineering, and run design-partner relationships with leading startups that influence what Cloudflare builds next.</li> <li><strong>Adapt our sales process for startups.</strong> Use and influence Cloudflare's sales methodology for faster deals with technical buyers. Bring discipline to forecasting usage-based revenue, contracts sized for growth and expansion planning.</li> <li><strong>Balance short-term and long-term revenue.</strong> Close fast deals while also building multi-year relationships with companies expected to become tomorrow's large enterprise customers. Work with Enterprise leaders on clean handoffs when accounts move to that segment.</li> <li><strong>Represent Cloudflare in the East Coast startup scene</strong> at founder events, AI meetups, investor portfolio sessions and developer communities.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring</h2> <ul> <li>12+ years of sales experience, including 3+ years managing managers (second-line leadership), with a track record of beating targets in a high-growth segment</li> <li>Experience selling cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, application security or data and AI infrastructure to startups, digital natives or high-growth tech companies</li> <li>Proven success in usage-based businesses, including converting product-led or pay-as-you-go customers to committed contracts and expanding from there</li> <li>Credibility with technical buyers: comfortable at the whiteboard with CTOs and founders talking about how their AI systems are built, latency, how they scale and what it costs per request or token</li> <li>Strong ties to the East Coast venture and startup community</li> <li>A history of hiring and developing great AE managers and AEs, and building a team people want to join</li> <li>Disciplined forecasting and pipeline management in fast-moving, high-volume deal environments</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build processes, programs and playbooks where none exist</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,1,0">For New York City and Boston based hires: Estimated annual salary of $418,000 - $575,000 OTE</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Austin, TX</li> <li>San Francisco, CA</li> </ul> <p><strong>Available Term</strong></p> <ul> <li>Winter (January - April 2027) </li> </ul> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare’s mission is to help build a better Internet—and our Communications team is responsible for telling that story to the world and to our own employees. Across Public Relations, Social, Internal, Visual, and Executive Communications, we support major company announcements, Innovation Weeks, internal employee platforms and news, our public social channels and executive communications.</p> <p>Cloudflare moves fast, and so does our work. We're looking for a builder who is just as curious about how organizations communicate as about the technology behind it. You might be studying information science, data science, HCI, digital media, journalism, cognitive science, business or information systems, or communications with a strong technical streak, or coming from a coding bootcamp or self-taught path. You'll work at the intersection of AI, automation, and employee and corporate communications, identifying opportunities to eliminate manual work, connect disconnected systems, and build tools that make our team smarter and more effective.</p> <p>By the end of the internship, you’ve built new tools or processes for how we can better communicate or collaborate. </p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Automate the everyday:</strong> Build workflows that can save the team time—like creating a dynamic, shared visual calendar that pulls milestones automatically from multiple team trackers, auto-populating our weekly internal newsletter with top press coverage, or keeping our internal wiki (Company Hub) continuously updated with the latest stats or coverage highlights.</li> <li><strong>Own a flagship AI project:</strong> Sit down with teammates across PR, Social, Design, and Internal Comms to uncover an opportunity to use AI to reimagine a time-consuming or fragmented process. Own the process from discovery through prototyping, testing, and deployment.</li> <li><strong>Improve AI knowledge and retrieval:</strong> Partner with Communications and the Agentic Solutions Team to improve how internal AI tools access, organize, and retrieve information and share with employees. Help identify gaps in existing knowledge sources, improve content quality and structure, and test the accuracy and usefulness of AI-generated responses.</li> <li><strong>Share what you build:</strong> Teach the team how to use the tools you build and share and learn from other interns and teams across the company. Present flagship AI project during company-wide intern presentations.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Technical foundation:</strong> Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a field such as information science, data science, human-computer interaction, digital media, business or information systems, journalism, communications, or a related technical field.</li> <li><strong>AI enthusiast:</strong> Experience building with AI tools, including LLMs, AI agents, or AI-assisted development tools.</li> <li><strong>Systems thinker:</strong> Experience working with APIs, webhooks, or integrating different systems.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on problem solver: </strong>You enjoy uncovering problems and figuring out how to solve them. You’re not afraid to ask for help or proactively reach out to others across the company to get answers.</li> <li><strong>Availability:</strong> Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship, with 3-5 days in office.</li> <li><strong>Understands the value of communications:</strong> Recognizes how effective communications improves engagement, connection, and alignment. You don't need a communications background, but you're interested in how technology can improve the way organizations communicate.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated hourly rate of $27.00/hr.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Market Researcher
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Turn market signals into GTM strategy for Marketing. Notion is a collaborative AI workspace for teams and companies, operating in a market where AI is changing how teams evaluate software and get work done. This role will help Marketing understand how customers, competitors, and the broader market are responding, including shifts in brand perception, then turn that understanding into sharper messaging, growth strategy, and audience strategy. You’ll own the market research relationship with GTM partners across global markets and regional teams, and expand Notion’s thought-leadership research capability through original work on topics like AI transformation and ROI. This role is based in New York City or San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE - Build a trusted market research practice and become a standing strategic partner for GTM planning, brought into launch planning early enough to shape the work. - Own brand tracking as a clear input into how Notion understands awareness, consideration, and perception, and translate those signals into sharper messaging and GTM priorities. - Connect customer, competitive, product, and top-of-funnel research across global markets to inform growth strategy and audience strategy. - Raise the bar for Notion’s research capabilities across decision support and thought leadership, building original studies on topics like AI transformation and ROI that give Marketing and Sales a credible point of view in the AI landscape. - Use AI as a research collaborator and workflow layer to connect data, scale analysis, surface patterns, and make insights easier for stakeholders to use, while improving the quality of decisions, not just the speed of delivery. SKILLS YOU’LL BRING - Strong quantitative research craft, including the ability to design and run research sprints, surveys, and MaxDiff studies, and to choose the right method for the decision at hand. - Deep understanding of brand tracking and top-of-funnel research, with the judgment to place those signals in the broader customer, competitive, and product context. - Strategic judgment: you can challenge the brief, connect market and product data, and turn ambiguous evidence into a clear recommendation that changes GTM priorities. - Experience working across global markets and regional teams, flexing across Product, Creative, and GTM while distinguishing local context from patterns that should shape broader strategy. - AI fluency and systems thinking: you use AI and data workflows thoughtfully to connect research infrastructure, scale insight delivery, and make the broader team more effective Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $196,000 - $219,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

The team is responsible for designing and operating the metadata systems that track every object in R2, building and shipping developer-facing features, and ensuring the reliability and performance of these systems at global scale.</p> <p>You'll be joining a team that operates at the intersection of distributed databases, large scale storage infrastructure, and edge computing;  building systems that need to be correct, fast, and reliable.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Design and implement features in a metadata system, backed by a distributed SQL DB,  that serves every R2 API operation, ensuring correctness, performance, and compatibility with the S3 API surface.</li> <li>Build and operate production services on Cloudflare Workers and Kubernetes that handle high throughput metadata operations with strong consistency and durability guarantees.</li> <li>Own the schema, data model, and query patterns for a metadata layer managing billions of objects across multiple distributed database clusters.</li> <li>Own projects end to end; from design docs and schema changes through implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring.</li> <li>Participate in oncall rotations, drive incident resolution, and write postmortems that improve reliability.</li> <li>Use AI tools extensively to accelerate development, debugging, and operational tasks. We expect engineers to leverage AI as a core part of their workflow.</li> <li>Collaborate across teams (storage infrastructure, networking, other platform teams) to coordinate capacity planning, API contracts, and cross cutting initiatives.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Strong programming skills in TypeScript, Go, or similar languages.</li> <li>Experience with distributed databases; schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and understanding consistency/performance tradeoffs at scale.</li> <li>Experience building or operating large scale distributed systems with strong reliability requirements.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts such as object storage, edge computing, or service oriented architectures.</li> <li>Understanding of reliability and observability practices: monitoring, alerting, performance tuning, and incident response.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical decisions clearly and coordinate across teams.</li> <li>Comfortable working with AI coding tools as part of a daily development workflow.</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, or edge computing platforms is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 -
