title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description: About HappyRobot HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Application Security Engineer to help secure our product and platform through hands-on security architecture and engineering. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and compliance teams, taking ownership from identifying risks through designing, implementing, and rolling out solutions. We’re a lean security team, so your work will span security reviews, vulnerability management, platform hardening, automation, incident response, and compliance engineering. Alongside finding and fixing vulnerabilities, you’ll identify opportunities to prevent entire classes of risks through shared security controls and centralized enforcement. You’ll help decide where these investments matter most and build solutions that teams can adopt as the company grows. What You’ll Do Design and implement shared security controls that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities and centralize enforcement across applications and services. Partner with engineers on architecture and threat modeling, translating risks into concrete designs for authorization, service identity, tenant isolation, and data protection. Build security controls and secure defaults into application frameworks, service templates, and infrastructure modules, making them straightforward for teams to adopt. Develop automation that connects security tools with engineering workflows, adds context to findings, and automates remediation where appropriate. Own vulnerability management across internal findings, automated tooling, external assessments, and researcher reports. Review code, perform targeted security testing, and manage vulnerabilities through verified remediation. Use recurring findings to identify where a shared control or architectural change would prevent similar issues. Support the compliance team by implementing technical controls, automating procedures, and validating that controls operate as intended. Help investigate security incidents and use the findings to improve architecture, controls, and detection. What We’re Looking For 5+ years of experience in application security, product security, or software engineering with substantial security ownership. Strong understanding of web, API, and distributed-system security, including authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, and sensitive data handling. Experience taking security controls from architectural design through implementation and adoption across multiple services or teams. Ability to design defense in depth, establish clear trust boundaries, and limit the impact of compromised components or credentials. Strong coding skills: you can review production code, contribute fixes, and build maintainable tooling and shared security components. Experience integrating security tools into engineering workflows and using context and automation to reduce manual work. Sound technical judgment, clear communication, and the independence to take an ambiguous problem through to a working solution. Why join us? Work closely with engineers building AI systems used in critical enterprise operations. Own substantial security projects and help shape a growing security program. Have the autonomy to design solutions, implement them, and see their impact in production. Join a company backed by leading investors. Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Our Operating Principles Extreme Ownership We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us. Craftsmanship Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching. We are “majos” Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego. Urgency with Focus Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy. Talent Density and Meritocracy Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win. First-Principles Thinking Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible. The personal data provided in your application and during the selection process will be processed by Happyrobot, Inc., acting as Data Controller. title: Test Engineer
description: Wij zijn op zoek naar een test engineer met een brede technische interesse die techniek graag combineert met organiseren en samenwerken. Hoe mooi is het om als eerste een installatie aan te zetten en te testen of alles werkt zoals bedoeld en voldoet aan de verwachtingen van de opdrachtgever? Je werkt met uiteenlopende systemen, zoals camerasystemen, branddetectie, luchtbehandeling, voedingsverdeelkasten, verlichting, netwerken en waterinstallaties. Kortom: een compleet technisch gebouw, waarbij jij helpt om alles goed en aantoonbaar werkend op te leveren. Dit wordt jouw baan Je brengt samen met de testmanager in kaart wat er getest moet worden, stelt testplanningen en -protocollen op en bewaakt de voortgang. Je bereidt onder andere FAT-, PAT- en iFAT-testen voor, zorgt dat de juiste mensen, systemen en componenten beschikbaar zijn en begeleidt de daadwerkelijke testuitvoering. Bevindingen leg je zorgvuldig vast en je bewaakt dat deze worden opgevolgd. Je hoeft daarbij niet vanaf dag één specialist te zijn in alle systemen. Je werkt samen met ervaren testmanagers, testcoördinatoren, engineers en technische specialisten en krijgt de ruimte om je inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op je plek Je wordt onderdeel van de vakgroep Technische Installaties binnen het cluster Ontwerp van Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten. Samen met circa 140 collega's werk je aan de grootste multidisciplinaire infrastructurele projecten van Nederland, zoals tunnels, bruggen, sluizen, energieprojecten, waterzuiveringen en hoogspanningsinstallaties. Binnen het project werk je nauw samen met collega's uit ontwerp, uitvoering en projectbeheersing. Je krijgt veel ruimte om richting te geven aan het testproces en kunt daarbij terugvallen op ervaren collega's en technische specialisten. Afhankelijk van het project werk je op locatie, vanuit een Dura Vermeer-kantoor of vanuit huis. Als eerste opdracht voorzien we een rol op het project Landstations, waarbij we de locatie realiseren waar de wind energie vanuit windparken op zee wordt omgezet naar het landzijdige nationale elektriciteitsnet. Je werk daarmee direct mee aan de verduurzaming van onze elektriciteitsvoorziening. Dit breng jij mee Een hbo / wo opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde, industriële automatisering of een vergelijkbare richting; Een brede interesse in technische installaties en de motivatie om verschillende systemen te leren doorgronden; Je kunt technische tekeningen en documentatie lezen of bent gemotiveerd om dit verder te leren; Je werkt gestructureerd en kunt technische informatie vertalen naar een praktische aanpak; Je communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen en vindt het leuk om techniek en coördinatie te combineren; Ervaring met testen, commissioning, FAT/SAT of technische projectcoördinatie is een pré. title: Afstudeerstage AI Adoption
description: Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen? Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom hebben we de afgelopen periode een stevig fundament gelegd voor AI binnen onze organisatie. Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen. De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt. Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten. Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen. Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk. De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen. HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. Wat ga je doen? Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan. Concreet ga je onder andere: Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers. Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten. Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen. AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers. Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen. De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden. Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent. Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen. Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven. Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie. Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken. Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie. Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen. “We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. Er ligt een fundament en steeds meer collega’s werken ermee. De interessante vraag is nu: hoe zorgen we dat AI voor veel meer mensen écht onderdeel wordt van hun dagelijkse werk? Ik zoek iemand die het leuk vindt om daar samen met mij de volgende stap in te zetten.” – Els Marchal, AI Transformation Lead Wie ben je? Je volgt een relevante hbo-opleiding, zoals Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, ICT, Business Informatics, Data & Business, Human Resource Management, Learning & Development, Communicatie of vergelijkbaar. Je hebt interesse in AI én de manier waarop mensen nieuwe technologie adopteren . Je vindt het leuk om voor groepen te staan en anderen iets nieuws te leren. Je kunt complexe onderwerpen op een eenvoudige en praktische manier uitleggen. Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd. Je bent nieuwsgierig en stelt kritische vragen. Je vindt het interessant om data te analyseren en inzichten te vertalen naar concrete acties . Je kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende doelgroepen en niveaus van AI-ervaring. Je vindt het leuk om trainingen, materialen en nieuwe manieren van leren te ontwikkelen. Je durft initiatief te nemen en ideeën in de praktijk uit te proberen. Ervaring met tools zoals Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT en Power BI is een pre. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent naar AI en enthousiast wordt van de vraag: hoe zorgen we ervoor dat mensen AI daadwerkelijk goed gaan gebruiken? Wat bieden wij jou? Een afstudeeropdracht met directe impact op de organisatie. Intensieve begeleiding door de AI Transformation Lead. Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap. De kans om ervaring op te doen met AI-adoptie en organisatieverandering . Praktijkervaring met het ontwikkelen en geven van AI-trainingen, demo’s en workshops. De mogelijkheid om met echte adoptiedata te werken en te onderzoeken welke interventies daadwerkelijk effect hebben. Een actieve rol binnen het AI Champions-programma. Werken aan actuele AI-vraagstukken binnen een internationale organisatie. Een hybride werkomgeving vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere. Een informele en betrokken werksfeer waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand (obv 32 uur). Aan het einde van je stage heb je niet alleen een sterke afstudeerscriptie, maar ook praktische ervaring opgedaan met AI-adoptie, training en organisatieverandering binnen een internationale organisatie . Je hebt zelf trainingen en demo’s gegeven, met echte adoptiedata gewerkt en gezien wat ervoor nodig is om medewerkers daadwerkelijk mee te krijgen in een AI-transformatie. Wij zijn HG! Bij HG, een toonaangevend Europees merk in specialistische reinigings- en onderhoudsproducten, geloven we dat een huis een plek moet zijn waar je zorgeloos kunt leven. Met aandacht voor de plek waar je woont en voor de spullen die je omringen. Daarom ontwikkelen wij onze producten zo dat ze veilig doen wat ze beloven. De missie van HG is om jou te helpen optimaal van je huis te genieten, zonder je zorgen te maken over wat er mis kan gaan. Dit realiseren wij met onze zeer effectieve, veilige en specialistische reinigingsoplossingen, gecombineerd met deskundig advies. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere zetten wij ons dagelijks in voor superioriteit, innovatie, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid. Met een sterke aanwezigheid in Europa en daarbuiten blijven wij continu investeren om een nog grotere impact te maken. HG doet wat het belooft. Nog vragen? Onze collega Ilse de Groot (Corporate Recruiter) neemt alle tijd om antwoord te geven. title: Post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS)  - CDD de 12 mois
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS) pour rejoindre le département INFRES de Télécom Paris. Contexte scientifique : les cadres de vérification existants supposent généralement des modèles finis et précisément définis, dont les actions et les relations de transition sont connues. Ces hypothèses sont difficiles à maintenir dans les systèmes modernes d’IA agentique, où les actions peuvent être générées dynamiquement, les environnements peuvent évoluer et les informations sur le système peuvent être incomplètes. Le projet Sound or Silent (SoS) vise à combler cette lacune en étudiant une nouvelle approche d’IA agentique correcte par construction. L’idée centrale consiste à intégrer le raisonnement stratégique et la vérification formelle directement au processus décisionnel des agents autonomes. Au lieu de vérifier un agent uniquement après son développement ou de surveiller son comportement après l’exécution, SoS étudie la possibilité de produire des actions formellement certifiées conformes à une spécification donnée. Selon cette approche, une action candidate n’est exécutée que s’il est établi qu’elle appartient à une stratégie garantissant les propriétés requises. Si une telle garantie ne peut être établie, l’agent s’abstient d’agir. Atteindre cet objectif exige d’étendre les techniques de vérification stratégique à des environnements ouverts, évolutifs et partiellement spécifiés, et d’étudier des notions de correction adaptées à une information incomplète. Le projet explorera également une architecture associant un composant génératif non fiable, chargé de proposer des actions ou des stratégies candidates, à un noyau de vérification formelle de confiance, chargé d’en contrôler la correction. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’expressivité des modèles formels sous-jacents, au coût de calcul de la certification et au compromis entre garanties formelles et capacité des agents à accomplir des tâches utiles. Les travaux associeront des développements théoriques à la réalisation et à l’évaluation expérimentale de prototypes, dans des scénarios de planification autonome, d’agents d’IA utilisant des outils et de coordination multi-agents. L’objectif général est de poser les fondements de systèmes d’IA agentique dont l’autonomie est encadrée par des garanties stratégiques formellement vérifiables. Vos missions principales seront de : Mener des travaux de recherche sur l’IA agentique correcte par construction Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique de Télécom Paris Vous devrez être titulaire d’un doctorat ou d’un diplôme équivalent et disposer de solides connaissances en méthodes formelles, logique et vérification de modèles. Une expérience dans les systèmes multi-agents, les logiques stratégiques, la vérification à l’exécution ainsi que dans le développement d’agents fondés sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM) sera également attendue. Vous devrez maîtriser le développement logiciel et l’implémentation d’algorithmes, ainsi que la démarche de recherche scientifique, notamment la formulation de problématiques, la conception d’expériences et l’analyse de leurs résultats. Une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, sera indispensable. Enfin, vous devrez faire preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles ainsi que d’un esprit de synthèse. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). Vous bénéficierez de : 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT) flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service) télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75% Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne... A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé Informations diverses : Date limite de candidature : 15 janvier 2027 Type d'emploi : CDD de 12 mois Description de poste détaillée ici Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. title: Ingénieur.e de recherche pour le pilotage de l'activité hospitalière (H/F) - CDD 14 mois
description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Ce poste, ouvert au sein d’IMT Mines Albi, est rattaché au Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) qui compte à ce jour environ 70 personnes. Le centre s’intéresse à la cinétique des organisations et au développement de solutions d’aide à la décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs et incertains. Ceci est mis en pratique par la représentation, la modélisation et l’analyse des données de ces organisations afin de formaliser de la connaissance conduisant à la prise de décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs, incertains et/ou perturbés. Le CGI est structuré selon quatre axes de recherche appliquée : Axe FLOWS : Systèmes logistiques flexibles pour un monde durable ; Axe DISCS : Systèmes numériques pour la gestion des crises et la sécurité ; Axe WHOPS : Systèmes organisationnels pour la santé et le bien-être ; Axe TRACE : Résilience territoriale, agilité et économie circulaire. Huit expertises scientifiques et techniques sont au cœur de ces axes de recherche : Ingénierie systèmes, Ingénierie des modèles, Théorie de la décision, Recherche opérationnelle, Technologies immersives, IA générative, IA symbolique, et IA connexionniste. Les chercheurs et ingénieurs du CGI exploitent et contribuent particulièrement aux paradigmes scientifiques suivants pour réaliser les projets de recherche ou formation : l’Internet Physique, la Physique des Décisions, les Jumeaux Numériques Organisationnels. Le poste à pourvoir concerne l'un des projets de recherche de l'axe WHOPS. Le but de ce projet est de répondre à un besoin exprimé par l'Agence Régionale de Santé (ARS) et un hôpital de la région parisienne. La personne recrutée sera intégrée à une équipe de chercheurs en ingénierie organisationnelle pour la santé, ce qui garantira un accompagnement visant une montée en régime rapide et un suivi régulier des activités de l'ingénieur(e) recruté(e). DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : Le contexte général du projet concerne le pilotage des capacités hospitalières et l'anticipation des tensions sur l'offre de soins. Il s'agit d'un enjeu majeur pour les établissements de santé, les institutions en charge de la planification de l'offre de soins, et plus largement, pour l'ensemble des professionnels impliqués dans l'orientation des patients. L'objectif général du projet est de développer et expérimenter, en s'appuyant sur des données réelles provenant du système d'information d'un hôpital, des outils innovants d'analyse et de prévision-prédiction de l'activité hospitalière, essentiels pour améliorer l'anticipation et le pilotage des capacités (ressources humaines et lits). Parmi les outils et solutions envisagés, un intérêt particulier porte sur les principes du jumeau numérique asynchrone permettant l'analyse rétrospective des parcours patients et la simulation "in silico" de scénarios prospectifs. D'autres outils et techniques, concurrents ou complémentaires, notamment à base de projections statistiques et d'intelligence artificielle, devront aussi être explorés. De manière générale, l'ingénieur(e) de recherche recruté(e) interviendra sur les développements et les travaux de recherche visant l'objectif général du projet. Plus précisément, la mission consiste à : Analyser les données associées aux flux de patients et les déterminants organisationnels et médicaux influençant les durées de séjour et l'occupation des lits ; Développer des modèles permettant d'estimer et d'anticiper l'évolution des taux d'occupation des capacités hospitalières ; Développer des outils d'aide à la décision destinés aux professionnels hospitaliers et aux acteurs de la régulation ; Produire une méthodologie reproductible et transférable à d'autres établissements ou territoires de soins ; Documenter tous les travaux de développement dans des dossiers techniques à destination d'autres développeurs. Rédiger des notices d'utilisation pour les utilisateurs finaux des modules ou application. Rédiger ou participer à la rédaction de publications scientifiques pour valoriser les travaux réalisés. Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables : Méthodologies de recherche et développement, incluant notamment les étapes de spécification des besoins, d’analyse de la littérature, de conception de solutions logicielles et organisationnelles, d’expérimentation, de validation, et de dissémination des résultats. Connaissances fondamentales des langages, outils et méthodes de traitement et d'analyse de données ainsi que des notions en interfaçage utilisateur. Compétences en simulation à événements discrets à l'aide d'outils du commerce (Witness, FlexSim, AnyLogic, …) ou à l'aide de bibliothèques de développement (SimPy, SimJulia, Salabim, …). Connaissances générales du système de santé français et si possible expérience (stage, emploi) en milieu hospitalier. Capacités et aptitudes : Communication, écoute, pédagogie, et interaction avec des chercheurs du CGI comme avec des professionnels de santé à l'hôpital. Esprit d'équipe, collaboration, force de proposition, synthèse, rigueur technique et scientifique, autonomie. PROFIL RECHERCHE : Le(la) candidat(e) devra être titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou d’un Master M2. Son domaine d’activité se situe en génie industriel, en informatique ou en sciences de données et en intelligence artificielle. description: Présentation de Télécom SudParis : Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. référencement naturel et la visibilité de l’école dans les moteurs de réponse et les IA génératives (SEO / GEO / AEO) et gérer la présence sur les annuaires de référence (type Onisep) • Mesurer title: ENGINEER/POST DOC POSITION : Stretchable Wearable Platform for Augmented Perception: System Integration and Embedded Optical Interconnects - CDD 12 months
description: Joining Mines Saint-Étienne means committing to an institution where science and innovation build a more sustainable future. It is a school of excellence where everyone has the opportunity to unlock their full potential and contribute to tackling the challenges of tomorrow. Ranked among the top engineering schools in France and recognized worldwide, our school, a member of the Institut Mines-Télécom , educates the talents of tomorrow while actively addressing major industrial, digital, and environmental challenges. By joining us, you become part of a community of 528 members of staff, 2,500 students and take part in an ambitious project: combining academic excellence, cutting-edge research, and positive societal impact. The Institut Mines-Télécom brings together France’s leading Grandes Ecoles to tackle major industrial, digital, energy, and environmental challenges. With its eight public Grandes Écoles and two affiliated Graduate Schools, it is the leading public institute dedicated to engineers and managers. Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions. 🎯 What we expect from you ? The Flexeo technology enables the development of individual electronic devices on ultraflexible substrates. Within the Flexeo3D project , the objective is to integrate these devices into stretchable matrices to develop wearable prototypes for augmented perception. The postdoctoral researcher will contribute to the development of a complete, autonomous system integrating sensors, a microcontroller, a power source and sensory-feedback actuators, in close collaboration with two PhD students working on sensing and haptic feedback technologies. The ultimate goal is to integrate the system into an ergonomic, breathable wearable sleeve. A key challenge is the development of flexible and stretchable interconnections between system modules. Particular attention will be paid to investigating optical communication channels as a potential solution for data transmission. This will involve a state-of-the-art review, the design and fabrication of dedicated test structures, and the evaluation of optical bus communication technologies. Building on the developed integration technologies, the researcher will contribute to the realization of a fully functional wearable demonstrator, in close collaboration with the researcher responsible for the electronic system design. Experimental work in the laboratory and technological development are essentialand will partly be conducted in our cleanroom and our prototyping Platform (ID-Fab) These efforts will contribute to the creation of radically new demonstrators, opening new avenues for exploration in augmented 🔍 What we are looking for ? A person with a PhD or Master's degree in Engineering Sciences, physics and material science. The ideal profile we would like to recruit is the following: Knowledge · Engineering sciences, optics and optoelectronic devices. · Thin-film fabrication processes · 3D design. Experience and practical skills · Hands-on experience in guided optics and optical/optoelectronic devices. · Practical experience in experimental development, prototyping and laboratory work. · Experience with stretchable devices would be an advantage. Personal qualities · Resourceful, pragmatic and curious, with a hands-on mindset (mandatory). · Autonomous and proactive, with the ability to work in a collaborative R&D environment. · Good scientific communication skills. If you feel that your background and skills are a good fit for this position, even if you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply ! 🌍 Why join Mines Saint-Étienne ? We support each of our employees on the path to excellence, with the conviction that together, we can have a lasting and significant impact on our world. Joining Mines Saint-Etienne is the opportunity to find: • A stimulating environment: Cutting-edge experimental resources, a welcoming working environment and a solid international network (T.I.M.E., EULIST). • A real impact: Contractual research projects worth €11 million/year, mainly with industrial partners, A science culture centre, La Rotonde , which has been committed to science outreach for 25 years, welcoming over 50,000 visitors per year. • An incomparable quality of life: 49 days of paid leave, partial remote working, 75% reimbursed public transport, financial support for carpooling and cycling and a social barometer where 83% of employees praise the quality of life at work. Let's build a more sustainable future, through science, engineering, and projects that make sense. 📩 Apply now ! 🔗 Application materials (resume - maximum 2 pages- , cover letter - maximum 1 page-, letter of recommendation if applicable, proof of identity) should be submitted via the RECRUITEE platform before December 20th, 2026 : https://institutminestelecom.recruitee.com/o/engineerpost-doc-position-stretchable-wearable-platform-for-augmented-perception-system-integration-and-embedded-optical-interconnects-cdd-12-months As part of its Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion policy, the École des Mines de Saint-Étienne is committed to fair treatment of all applicants. description: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. title: Senior Presales Consultant Identity & Trust (m/w/d)
description: At G+D Netcetera, we create digital solutions that make interactions more secure, convenient and seamless. Our Identity & Trust business line combines our expertise in digital identity, authentication and identity management with trusted digital services such as electronic signatures and seals. Join us and help turn complex Identity & Trust challenges into solutions that create real value for our customers. Your Responsibilities Lead functional and technical solution consulting throughout the sales process for our Identity & Trust portfolio. Understand customer needs and translate them into compelling solution concepts, architectures and integration approaches. Design and deliver product demonstrations, Proofs of Concept and customer workshops for both business and technical stakeholders. Together with Sales and relevant specialists, create proposals and respond to RFIs/RFPs, coordinating solution architecture, effort estimation and technical contributions. Advise customers across topics such as Digital Identity, CIAM/IAM, authentication, identity verification, digital onboarding, electronic signatures and Trust Services. Work closely with Sales, Product Management, Solution Architects and delivery teams and ensure a structured handover into implementation. Bring insights from customers, competitors and market developments into our portfolio, positioning and value proposition. Lead and build your own pipeline, initiate relationships and ideate how to utilize G+D Netcetera’s product suite to catch interest of customers. Strong understanding of modern software architectures, APIs, cloud/SaaS and system integration. Ability to translate complex functional and technical requirements into clear solution concepts and compelling customer presentations. Experience with product demonstrations, workshops, Proofs of Concept and RFIs/RFPs in collaboration with technical and business experts. Strong communication and presentation skills and confidence working with both technical specialists and executive-level decision-makers. A structured, independent and solution-oriented way of working, taking ownership from initial customer requirements through to handover. Fluent in German and English and willing to travel. Nice-to-have Relevant professional experience in at least one area of our Identity & Trust portfolio, such as Digital Identity, IAM/CIAM, authentication, identity verification, digital onboarding, electronic signatures or Trust Services. Knowledge of eIDAS 2.0, EUDI Wallets, Verifiable Credentials and decentralized identity. Familiarity with identity technologies and standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, FIDO2/Passkeys or Keycloak. Experience with electronic signatures, electronic seals, PKI or qualified trust services. Experience with security- or regulatory-driven solutions in Financial Services, Insurance or Public Sector. Understanding the business models of Digital Identity and Trust Services A relevant degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Business Administration or a comparable field. title: Senior Technical Account Manager (Austin, Seattle, Denver)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, Denver, Seattle, </p> <h4><strong>About the Department</strong></h4> <p>The Technical Account Team plays a crucial role in ensuring a seamless experience for Cloudflare users, ranging from individual developers to Fortune 500 enterprises. By providing expert technical support and resolving complex issues across multiple channels, the team enhances customer satisfaction and drives product improvement.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, Technical Account Managers (TAMs) serve as trusted advisors, delivering high-touch technical guidance and advocacy for our top Enterprise customers. Acting as the eyes and ears of the company, TAMs capture valuable customer insights to influence service enhancements and future product development.</p> <h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4> <p>As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the post-sales support experience for Cloudflare’s largest Enterprise customers, ensuring smooth operations and proactive technical guidance. As the primary technical point of contact, you will manage support interactions, troubleshoot issues, drive escalations, and advocate for customer needs. </p> <p>You will act as an architectural governance partner, continuously mapping customer environments against industry best practices and Cloudflare's Well-Architected framework. By proactively identifying security gaps, single points of failure, and performance bottlenecks, you will prevent incidents before they impact production. </p> <p>Working closely with Account Teams, Product, Engineering, and partnering with Customer Support, you will align technical solutions with customer roadmaps and business objectives. This role requires a mix of technical expertise, customer service excellence, and strategic problem-solving to ensure high customer satisfaction and retention.</p> <p>For TAMs specializing in Network Services, you will focus on optimizing customer Cloudflare configurations, ensuring the reliability and security of their network infrastructure.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary technical support contact for assigned Enterprise customers.</li> <li>Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships with Product, Engineering, Account Executives, Professional Services, and Partners to support every phase of the customer journey.</li> <li>Leverage AI-driven tools and workflows to optimize daily operations, including incident summarization, case prioritization, and automated handover documentation, to increase team productivity and focus on strategic customer advocacy.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal teams to ensure high customer satisfaction, delivering world-class technical support and advocacy.</li> <li>Provide actionable customer feedback to Product and Engineering teams to help shape product improvements.</li> <li>Maintain a comprehensive understanding of customer environments and Cloudflare deployments, ensuring proactive issue resolution and long-term optimizations.</li> <li>Develop and maintain a rolling Technical Risk & Gap Register for each enterprise account, tracking architectural drift, legacy configurations, and emerging security threats, while prioritizing remediation paths with customer stakeholders. </li> <li>Conduct Quarterly Support Reviews, including SLA adherence, incident reviews, and deep-dive analysis of top ticket drivers, as well reviewing future-state resilience, capacity planning, and proactive feature adoption. </li> <li>Act as a point of escalation during business hours and provide backup support for global TAMs in other time zones.</li> <li>Partner with the account team to drive strategic customer engagements, including technical planning, roadmap alignment, and incident response.</li> <li>Partner with Cloudflare’s Threat Intelligence and Product teams to proactively evaluate customer environments against newly discovered vulnerabilities (Zero-Days, emerging DDoS vectors), ensuring defensive configurations are deployed ahead of potential exploits. </li> <li>Ensure timely resolution of support tickets, working with backend teams as needed.</li> <li>Establish continuous drift-detection workflows to ensure customer configurations don't deviate from established security baselines, compliance standards, or optimal performance thresholds. </li> <li>Travel up to 25% of the time to support customer engagements.</li> <li>Ability to work one weekend per month.</li> <li>Utilize AI-powered analytics to conduct proactive configuration health checks and architectural reviews, identifying systemic risks and providing strategic infrastructure optimization recommendations.</li> <li>Streamline the creation of technical documentation—including HLDs, LLDs, and post-incident reports—by leveraging AI workflows to ingest and summarize technical data, ensuring consistent, high-quality deliverables.</li> <li>Deploy AI-assisted incident management tools to enhance communication precision, including real-time impact assessment, automated status updates, and rapid synthesis of complex technical event details.</li> </ul> <h4>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h4> <p>We are seeking a highly motivated customer-focused technical expert with the following skills and experience:</p> <h4><strong>Technical Expertise</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of networking concepts, including Layer 7 technologies and routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, IPSec, and GRE.</li> <li>Experience with security technologies (Firewalls, IPS, DDoS mitigation, WAF).</li> <li>Knowledge of system integration, multi-vendor environments, and data center deployments.</li> <li>Proficiency in diagnostic and troubleshooting tools (traceroute, WireShark, dig, cURL).</li> <li>Familiarity with the OSI Model, proxies, application & network security.</li> <li>Passion for Cloudflare’s products and a strong desire to help customers succeed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Customer & Business Acumen</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimum 8 years of experience in a customer-facing, technical support, or account management role.</li> <li>Proven ability to work with Fortune 500 companies and senior leadership.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, ability to work independently, and handle multiple priorities.</li> </ul> <p>This role is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of Cloudflare’s Enterprise customer experience, helping businesses optimize their network performance and security while shaping the future of our products.</p> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Denver based hires: Estimated annual salary of $114,000 - $157,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p>

title: Senior Systems Engineer, Network Protocols & Distributed Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> London, Lisbon, or Austin - (Hybrid)</p> <p>Join the team helping shape the future of the Internet. We’re building high-performance systems that handle a <em>quarter of the Internet’s traffic</em>. Our work influences open standards (like QUIC, MASQUE, and ECH), involves close collaboration with the IETF, and pushes the boundaries of what's possible in networking and security.</p> <p>You don’t need to be an HTTP or cryptography expert to join — we’re looking for excellent engineers who love tough problems, want to learn deeply, and are excited to contribute to one of the most technically demanding areas of infrastructure.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and operate systems that terminate HTTP and TLS at Internet scale</li> <li>Migrate core infrastructure from NGINX to a next-gen Rust-based proxy</li> <li>Measure and improve protocol performance across real-world traffic</li> <li>Contribute to open source and industry standards</li> <li>Learn from and work alongside some of the leading engineers in this space<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>You might be a good fit if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have solid systems programming experience (Rust, C, or similar)</li> <li>Thrive in complex technical domains and enjoy learning new things</li> <li>Care about building reliable, secure, and performant software</li> <li>Are motivated by impact — technical, operational, and on the Internet itself</li> <li>Come from a background that’s underrepresented in tech — we value diverse perspectives<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Perks include:</strong><strong><br></strong>Flexible work hours • Take-what-you-need vacation • RSUs • ESPP • Meaningful technical challenges every day</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €54,000 - €75,000.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking to improve latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while preserving quality and reliability.</p> <p>You will work with kernel and platform engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and resolve performance and quality regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts under real-world workloads.</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own optimization projects for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.</li> <li>Compare inference engines and recommend serving configurations suited to individual workloads.</li> <li>Diagnose model-quality and performance regressions during production rollouts.</li> <li>Improve LLM and VLM endpoint latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.</li> <li>Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, and NVIDIA Dynamo.</li> <li>Develop production model-compression workflows covering quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.</li> <li>Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving. For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture.</li> <li>Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets.</li> <li>Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead.</li> <li>Build reproducible benchmark harnesses measuring TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token. Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets.</li> <li>Collaborate with GPU kernel and platform engineers to trace bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.</li> <li>Produce design documents, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Strong engineering skills in Python and PyTorch.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack, such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or an equivalent internal system.</li> <li>A strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks involving KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.</li> <li>Ability to quantify trade-offs among latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost.</li> <li>Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism.</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration skills across research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience title: Data Analyst (EN)
description: Help launch our new temping product and drive commercial impact! At YoungOnes, data is at the start of every decision. Our Data & RevOps team has a seat at every table and takes a leading role in where the company goes next. Two years ago we rebuilt our data environment in Databricks from scratch, and it is fully ready for the future. There are few better environments to work in. We are looking for a Data Analyst with a focus on product, who also supports our marketing and commercial teams with deeper analyses. Someone with experience who is ready to take responsibility, and who does not stop at a report but actively steers on the outcome. What will you do? Your main focus is product. Next to that, you support marketing and the commercial teams, which keeps your work varied. Product In the flexible work market, companies used to choose between temping (uitzenden) and freelancers. Since last year we have been bringing a new proposition to market that sits in between: non-service temping. It combines the legal certainty of temping with the flexibility and personal control of freelancing, all through our platform. This is an important step in our strategy towards one app for work. Take the lead in tracking the progress of this new proposition; Define the KPIs and funnel that show whether the proposition is working; Analyse the full journey of workers and clients, from onboarding to repeat shifts; Spot problems early and actively steer where you see them; Translate insights into concrete improvements together with product and development; Work in a select team that operates as a startup within the company. Commercial & marketing support Next to product, you are the analytical sparring partner for our commercial teams and marketing. You go beyond the standard reports and dive deeper when questions get complex. Deliver deeper analyses for the commercial teams, for example on client potential, retention and growth opportunities; Support marketing with insight into campaign results and ROAS. This role is diverse, but above all it gives you a lot of freedom to take initiative and make an impact. Your team You will join an effective Data & RevOps team with 3 Analysts, 2 Engineers, a Performance Manager and 2 Process aAnalysts. You report to the Head of Data. The data itself is interesting: we support a two sided marketplace with workers on one side and clients on the other. AI is built into the design of how we work and makes the technical side of your job more simple. We use Genie within Databricks, which fully understands our data environment, Claude to connect multiple systems, and Gemini for quick support on smaller tasks. What are we looking for? We are looking for someone who: Has at least 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst or Commercial Analyst; Has experience tracking and steering product performance, and/or with commercial or marketing analytics; Is strong in SQL and familiar with Python/PySpark and a visualisation tool such as Power BI or Amplitude; Has experience with Databricks, or is eager to work in it; Uses AI tooling naturally to work faster and smarter; Takes ownership and dares to make choices and influence stakeholders; Communicates clearly with both technical and non technical colleagues; Is already residing in the Netherlands and is allowed to work in the country and speaks fluent English (Dutch is a plus); We are not looking for someone who only delivers reports. We want someone who takes the lead, sees problems before others do and makes sure something is done about them. What do we offer? A gross salary between €4,300 and €6,100 based on full-time employment; 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek; 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance; We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp; Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, biweekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months, sport tournaments, and much more; A leading role in a new proposition that is key to our strategy; One of the best data environments to work in, with Databricks and AI built in; A company that is truly data driven, where your insights shape decisions; A high level of autonomy, freedom and responsibility. YoungOnes is a place where you learn fast, build fast and see results fast. Ready to take the lead? Then we would love to hear from you. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Data Analist (NL)
description: Bouw mee aan onze nieuwe propositie en maak commerciële impact! Bij YoungOnes staat data aan de wieg van elk besluit. title: Software / Full-Stack QA Engineer
description: 🌊 Who are we? We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging. Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive. As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in. Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we're proud of. We're committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow. The Role You'll own software quality across AURA, our mobile app, cloud services, and internal tooling. That covers the whole chain: from a REFILL+ or Aquablu BOLD system generating telemetry, through the data pipeline and our central database, to the screen a partner or client looks at. You decide what must be tested. Our QA Automation & Pipeline Engineer builds the framework to run it, and you test directly wherever automation isn't in place yet. The engineers own the software; you own the confidence that it works. What You'll Do Own test strategy, test design, and QA execution across AURA, the mobile app, cloud services, and internal tooling. title: Senior Backend Developer
description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built. How we work We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here. We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard. Your first year In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival. By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team. Who we are looking for You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load. You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache. You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies. You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end. You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong. You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises. You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over. English is your working language. German is a plus. What makes you stand out You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax. You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model. You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama. You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it. The team We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action. We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you. The facts Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith Pensum: 100% Start: As soon as possible Language: English; German a plus Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls How to apply Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
