Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Neobank App. This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release. What You'll Own Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services. Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans. Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams. Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys. Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions. Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations. Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity. What We're Looking For Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role. Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows. Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products. Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning. Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management. High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance. Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage. The Kind of Builder We Want Starts from user problems, not feature lists. Can make decisions with incomplete information. Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch. Works well with engineering without hiding behind process. Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort. This Role Is Not For People who only write decks and do not drive execution. PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering. Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions. People who launch features and then stop caring. PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the Netherlands. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Evals
description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. About the team Join the AI team at Prosus, a global technology group with businesses in food delivery, e-commerce, classifieds, travel and payments. We build LCM, the Large Commerce Model: our own foundation model, trained on billions of transactions and interactions from proprietary data across the portfolio. LCM already powers search, recommendations and marketing in production at iFood. We are extending it across our companies around the world and to businesses outside the group, while broadening its capabilities in agents and real-time prediction tasks. Your work will shape what LCM learns next and feed directly into products used by millions of people. About the role Evaluation is the core of everything we do. We build from the evals: we define how success will be measured before developing a capability, and use the results to guide training, model selection and deployment. We already have hundreds of evaluations spanning domain knowledge, commerce and gaming, with plans to expand their coverage, depth and scale. This work builds on ProLLM, the public benchmarking platform we ran for real-world use cases until our coding assistant benchmarks became saturated. Since then it has been a private benchmarking platform for Prosus companies. We plan to open it again to publish our commerce benchmarks, covering both agentic and decision-making tasks. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to own the development of these evaluations and the platform that runs them. The work involves defining meaningful tasks, curating evaluation data, implementing reliable scoring, investigating model behaviour and making results useful for research and product decisions. In our flat team of around 30 engineers, you’ll work directly with applied scientists, training engineers and domain experts. You’ll help teams contribute evaluations and build the infrastructure and automation needed to run them throughout model development. In the first three months, we expect you to take technical ownership of part of the evaluation platform, deliver a set of new or improved evaluations with curated data and calibrated difficulty, and work with scientists to use them in a training or release decision. What the role involves Design evaluations with scientists and domain experts, translating intended capabilities into representative tasks, datasets and success criteria. Cover current applications and capabilities we want future models to acquire. Curate evaluation data and calibrate task difficulty, so that evaluations are neither saturated nor out of reach and still separate models of different quality. Work with domain experts on sourcing, annotation and review, within data provenance, permitted use across companies and privacy requirements. Own the development and operation of the evaluation platform across training checkpoints, deployed models and external baselines. Support distributed execution, reproducible configurations, trace inspection and comparison of results, while managing runtime and cost. Develop programmatic checks, outcome-based scoring and LLM-based graders. Calibrate automated judgments against expert reviews, investigate disagreements and test whether graders reward superficial answers or reject valid solutions. Analyse model outputs and agent trajectories, including tool calls, environment state and task outcomes. Distinguish model failures from problems in the evaluation, quantify uncertainty and explain what changed between versions. Maintain versioned tasks, datasets, graders and environments, with protected held-out tests and contamination checks. Expand coverage as models improve, retaining useful regression tests and adding harder tasks where existing tests no longer distinguish performance. Prepare commerce benchmarks for public release on ProLLM, including public mirror sets and evaluation code, where the data can be shared. Integrate evaluations into training and release workflows, with dashboards and regression checks that support concrete decisions. Work with portfolio teams to establish whether offline improvements correspond to better outcomes in online experiments. Build tools and agents that help generate candidate tasks, run evaluations and investigate failures, validating their outputs before adoption. Review contributions and mentor engineers so teams can extend the suite consistently. Minimum qualifications At least five years of ML or software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on work building and evaluating ML systems. Experience owning evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or model-quality systems that informed training or deployment decisions. Strong Python and experience with PyTorch, Transformers or comparable ML libraries, alongside reliable production software development. Practical knowledge of experimental design and statistics, including sampling, uncertainty, repeated trials and comparisons across model versions. Experience running inference or evaluation workloads at scale and debugging failures across models, data, scoring code and infrastructure. Clear communication and the ability to turn ambiguous results into defensible recommendations. Preferred qualifications Experience with language-model training or post-training. Experience with agent or gaming environments. Experience with human evaluation, LLM-as-judge calibration, recommendation metrics or online experimentation. Contributions to evaluation frameworks, public benchmarks or research. What we offer Ownership of the evaluation platform and the evaluations that guide LCM’s research, training and deployment. Access to proprietary domain data, GPU infrastructure and external models for comparison. Direct collaboration with researchers, engineers and portfolio teams, with scope to publish methods and benchmarks, including through ProLLM, where the work can be shared. Colleagues who have released Hugging Face models with more than 100 million downloads, authored papers at NeurIPS, created benchmarks and built multiple production AI systems. Current ML frameworks and unlimited access to coding assistants. A base at our Amsterdam office and AI House, with relocation support. We also consider remote arrangements for candidates with particularly strong experience relevant to the role. Competitive compensation and a top-spec MacBook Pro. If you want to build the evaluations that shape what a foundation model learns, we’d like to hear from you. Please include examples of evaluations or platforms you have built, how you established that their results were reliable, and the decisions those results informed. Why Prosus? At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next. Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing. Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page . Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have. Want to know more about life at Prosus? About the team Join the AI team at Prosus, a global technology group with businesses in food delivery, e-commerce, classifieds, travel and payments. LCM already powers search, recommendations and marketing in production at iFood. We are extending it across our companies around the world and to businesses outside the group, while broadening its capabilities in agents and real-time prediction tasks. Your work will shape what LCM learns next and feed directly into products used by millions of people. About the role We’re looking for experienced applied scientists in two tracks: pre-training, and post-training and continual learning. Each scientist will own a focused research direction within a track. The areas below describe the team’s research agenda; we are looking for depth in one or more of them. The role involves designing experiments, writing the code to run them, analysing results and developing training methods that other teams can use. Scientists own the research questions, training objectives and evidence needed to decide whether a change works, and work with ML engineers to turn successful experiments into reliable training runs. We are a team of around 30 engineers with a flat structure, working directly with portfolio companies to define problems, evaluate models and bring successful work into production. In the first three months, the expectation is to establish strong baselines in a chosen research area, develop and evaluate an improvement, and work with the relevant teams to test it in a downstream application. Track 1: Pre-training This track focuses on continued pre-training of open-weight models on commerce data, including how we represent that data, allocate training compute and transfer capabilities to smaller models. Research areas include: Studying scaling behaviour, data mixtures and compute allocation to decide what goes into the next training run. Developing mid-training methods, including data refinement, annealing schedules, context extension and alignment between text and semantic IDs for users, items and merchants. Designing training sequences from user histories, merchant catalogues and market data, and studying how representations transfer across companies, languages and commerce categories. Building synthetic data pipelines and measuring their contribution through controlled comparisons with real data. Distilling the base model into smaller models, including through on-policy distillation, and measuring the trade-offs between quality, inference cost and latency. Developing evaluations that help select pre-training runs and predict downstream performance, including checks for temporal leakage, generalisation to new users and items, and retention of existing capabilities. Tabular foundation models are a possible specialisation: pre-training and in-context learning on structured commerce data, using synthetic and real tables and comparing results with established tabular methods. Relevant experience includes continued pre-training or mid-training, data mixture research, scaling laws, tokenisation, entity representations, distillation, or tabular foundation models such as TabPFN and TabICL. Track 2: Post-training and continual learning This track focuses on adapting LCM to commerce tasks and learning from interactions after deployment. The goal is to turn signals from a continuous stream of billions of user sessions across the portfolio into regular updates to model weights, while retaining the capabilities the model has already learned. Research areas include: Developing post-training methods using supervised fine-tuning, preference optimisation such as DPO, and reinforcement learning with verifiable or learned rewards, including GRPO and PPO. Learning from session histories, searches, clicks, purchases, repeat orders and operator feedback. This includes data selection, credit assignment and reward design that account for exposure bias, delayed outcomes and the difference between observed engagement and incremental business value. Studying how to combine new interactions with historical data, how frequently to update models, when an update is ready for deployment, and how to preserve performance as user behaviour and catalogues change. Building RL environments with simulated users, catalogues and multi-step commerce tasks, including inspecting trajectories, validating rewards and testing whether improvements in simulation transfer to real interactions. Developing reward models and LLM-based graders, calibrating them against expert judgments and observed outcomes, and testing for reward hacking, sycophancy and excessive concentration on popular items. Training decision models for rankings, offers and promotions using contextual bandits or offline RL, with off-policy evaluation to estimate value and uncertainty, identify gaps in the available evidence and inform controlled online experiments. Developing automated experiments that propose and test changes to training methods, prompts, tools or agent control flow, evaluated on held-out tasks and regression tests before acceptance. Relevant experience includes language-model post-training, reinforcement learning, reward modelling, agent training environments, continual learning, or offline RL and bandits applied to real decisions. The training experience required will depend on the research direction. Responsibilities across both tracks Define success with portfolio teams and evaluate models against strong baselines, including existing production systems, accounting for inference cost, latency and the business outcome the model is meant to improve. Design reproducible experiments with appropriate ablations, uncertainty estimates and failure analysis, using future-period and held-out evaluations, and test whether offline improvements hold online. Work with data and engineering teams on provenance, permitted use across companies and privacy-aware handling of customer histories. Publish research and contribute models, benchmarks, environments and training methods to open source where the work and data can be shared. Mentor colleagues, review experiment designs and communicate findings clearly enough to support training and deployment decisions. Minimum qualifications A PhD or equivalent industry research experience in machine learning, computer science, statistics or a related field. At least five years of research or applied science experience in machine learning, including doctoral research, with hands-on experience designing and running model-training experiments. For Track 1, this should include pre-training or mid-training of language models. For Track 2, it should include language-model post-training, or reinforcement learning and decision-model training relevant to the specialisation. Evidence of original research through papers, released models, public benchmarks, open-source projects or significant research contributions to deployed systems. Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with experience implementing experiments and debugging training runs in a shared research codebase. Work on large language models requires hands-on experience with distributed training. Sound experimental judgment, including strong baselines, statistical analysis and the willingness to report negative results. Clear written and verbal communication. Preferred qualifications Experience implementing and debugging training methods in frameworks such as Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, NeMo RL, verl or OpenRLHF, depending on the chosen track. Research in recommender systems, generative retrieval, semantic IDs or user behaviour modelling. Experience with synthetic data, model distillation or compression for production. Experience working with marketplace or commerce data and evaluating changes through online experiments. What we offer Autonomy to design experiments and make technical decisions within your research direction. Proprietary commerce data, B300 and H200 GPUs for large-scale training, and external models for evaluation and benchmarking. The opportunity to take research from early experiments through publication and deployment, working directly with portfolio teams on products used by millions of people. Colleagues who have released Hugging Face models with more than 100 million downloads, authored papers at NeurIPS, created benchmarks and built multiple production AI systems. An uncapped budget to recruit and mentor research interns for your projects, with access to candidates through our connections with leading universities. Current ML frameworks and unlimited access to coding assistants. A base at our Amsterdam office and AI House, with relocation support. We also consider remote arrangements for candidates with particularly strong experience relevant to the role. Competitive compensation and a top-spec MacBook Pro. Use experiments to decide which approaches warrant larger training runs and which should be revised or stopped. Lead selected research projects through implementation, training and evaluation, staying directly involved in writing code, inspecting data, debugging runs and analysing failures. Establish evaluation methods that separate real improvements from leakage, noise and benchmark overfitting, and work with portfolio teams to test whether offline gains hold in controlled online experiments. Mentor scientists and engineers through joint research, experiment reviews and technical discussion, and advise on work that crosses project boundaries. title: Senior Data Engineer, Training Data Platform
description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. About the team Join the AI team at Prosus, a global technology group with businesses in food delivery, ecommerce, classifieds, travel and payments. We build LCM, the Large Commerce Model: our own foundation model, trained on billions of transactions and interactions from proprietary data across the portfolio. LCM already powers search, recommendations and marketing in production at iFood. We are extending it across our companies around the world and to businesses outside the group, while broadening its capabilities in agents and real-time prediction tasks. Your work will shape what LCM learns next and feed directly into products used by millions of people. About the role We’re looking for a senior data engineer to build and operate LCM’s training-data platform, covering acquisition, processing, synthetic generation, quality evaluation and dataset versioning. Our core data includes events, sessions, orders, catalogues and feedback, supplemented by external sources and generated examples. In our flat team of around 30 engineers, you’ll work with scientists and ML engineers to turn these sources into reproducible datasets and measure how changes to the data affect model performance. You’ll also build tools and agents that automate preparation, task design and quality analysis. In the first three months, we expect you to take ownership of a part of the platform, such as a pipeline, the dataset versioning layer or the quality checks, deliver a reproducible dataset that a research project uses in a training run, and work with scientists to measure how your data changes affect model quality. What the role involves Build acquisition and processing pipelines for portfolio data and relevant public and licensed sources, including connectors and content extraction. Turn commerce records into ordered histories and link behaviour to outcomes without leaking future information. Develop the shared platform for inspecting sources, configuring processing and publishing training datasets. Operate distributed workflows, monitor reliability and cost, and implement access controls and retention requirements. Work with scientists, engineers and the relevant teams on data provenance, permitted use across companies and privacy-aware handling of customer histories. Implement dataset versioning and lineage across source snapshots, processing code and dataset configurations, so releases can be reproduced and traced to the training runs that used them. Build quality checks for completeness, freshness, duplication, extraction accuracy and coverage. Combine automated checks with sampled review to investigate problems that aggregate metrics can miss. Provide tools for source tagging, sampling and weighting, and maintain evaluation datasets with temporal splits and overlap checks. Experience with cloud storage, workflow orchestration and operating pipelines through source changes, failures and backfills. Practical knowledge of data quality, versioning and lineage, and the ability to translate evolving research requirements into reliable implementations. Preferred qualifications Experience with LLM datasets, commerce data, content extraction, synthetic data generation or agents for data tasks. Experience with AWS, Databricks or EMR. Strong distributed-data engineering experience is welcome without prior experience on an LLM team. Access to proprietary commerce datasets, distributed processing infrastructure and models for generation and evaluation. Scope to make technical decisions and build reusable tools across portfolio companies. Colleagues who have released Hugging Face models with more than 100 million downloads, authored papers at NeurIPS, created benchmarks and built multiple production AI systems. title: Senior Product Manager, New Database Product
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. title: Senior Solutions Architect, APJC (Developer Platform) - India Market
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Location:</strong> Bengaluru, India </h3> <h3><strong>About Developer GTM</strong></h3> <p>The Developer GTM organization is a highly collaborative startup within Cloudflare, dedicated to attracting, inspiring, and growing the next generation of builders. We are redefining developer acquisition in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to create accessible and exciting pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare—whether through ecosystem partnerships, high-impact content, or creative field engagement.</p> <p>We are a diverse team of builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the most empowering and exciting place for developers to build.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Solutions Architect for the Developer Platform, you will shape and lead the regional technical strategy for our customer and partner engagements across APJC.</p> <p>In this role, you will partner closely with engineering leaders, architects, developers, security teams, and executives to define architectures, validate technical approaches, and confidently transition production workloads onto Cloudflare. Rather than focusing on a single account, you will operate across a dynamic portfolio of engagements, ensuring broad impact.</p> <p>A central part of your role involves translating your field experience into reusable organizational knowledge. You will create architectural frameworks, provide technical guidance, and champion the needs of regional customers directly to our product teams. This is a senior, individual-contributor role that beautifully balances hands-on architecture, executive collaboration, and regional technical leadership. You will report directly to the Director of Developer GTM, APJC.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Shape Strategy:</strong> Guide the technical strategy for Developer Platform customers and partners across the region.</li> <li><strong>Design & Translate:</strong> Transform business, application, security, and operational requirements into secure, scalable, and highly maintainable architectures on Cloudflare.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate & Advise:</strong> Partner with engineering executives and senior stakeholders to advise on application modernization, distributed systems, AI architecture, and platform strategy.</li> <li><strong>Facilitate Discovery:</strong> Lead architecture discovery sessions, technical workshops, proofs of concept, design reviews, and production-readiness discussions in a supportive, consultative manner.</li> <li><strong>Create Frameworks:</strong> Establish reference architectures, architectural standards, and governance patterns that empower our customers and the broader APJC field organization.</li> <li><strong>Stay Hands-On:</strong> Build, review, and troubleshoot representative applications and integrations.</li> <li><strong>Champion the Region:</strong> Serve as a Developer Platform technical leader through presentations, written guidance, and internal enablement.</li> <li><strong>Mentor & Grow:</strong> Support and mentor fellow solutions architects and technical colleagues navigating complex customer engagements.</li> <li><strong>Bridge Teams:</strong> Build effective, continuous feedback loops between customers, field teams, and product leaders, translating regional needs into actionable product and go-to-market recommendations.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h3> <p>By the end of your first year, you will have:</p> <ul> <li>Become a trusted technical advisor and collaborative partner to customers, partners, and internal leaders.</li> <li>Established clear, actionable technical strategies and adoption plans for priority engagements.</li> <li>Helped customers successfully validate and launch their production workloads on Cloudflare.</li> <li>Published reusable reference architectures and field guidance that elevate the entire team.</li> <li>Improved the field organization’s ability to position, architect, and deliver Cloudflare’s developer and AI solutions.</li> <li>Cultivated the technical leadership of your colleagues through active mentorship and enablement.</li> <li>Provided product teams with consistent, evidence-based insights into regional customer requirements and adoption barriers.</li> <li>Become recognized as a supportive, authoritative Developer Platform leader across APJC.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Meaningful Experience:</strong> A strong background in solutions architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or a related customer-facing technical role. While candidates often bring 10+ years of experience, we care most about your demonstrated scope, impact, and ability to deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Language Skills:</strong> Professional fluency in English and a major language spoken in India, with the ability to comfortably lead technical and executive discussions in both languages, to support clients in that region. A significant portion of your portfolio will consist of clients based in India.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Collaboration:</strong> A track record of owning complex technical strategies involving developers, infrastructure teams, security stakeholders, and senior executives.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> Deep working knowledge of distributed application architecture (compute, storage, networking, security, reliability, and observability).</li> <li><strong>Hands-On Capability:</strong> Software-development experience, including the ability to build or review production-quality applications and proofs of concept (preferably in JavaScript or TypeScript).</li> <li><strong>Ecosystem Knowledge:</strong> A strong understanding of modern web technologies, serverless/cloud-native architectures, modern software-delivery practices, and at least one major public cloud platform.</li> <li><strong>Influential Leadership:</strong> A proven ability to influence without direct authority, thoughtfully mentor colleagues, and turn individual solutions into shared organizational capabilities.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Excellent written, presentation, and facilitation skills tailored for developer, architectural, and executive audiences.</li> <li><strong>Travel:</strong> Ability to travel up to 30%, primarily within APJC, including India (supported by flexible planning).</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience building and operating production applications on Cloudflare’s Developer communities in India.</li> <li>A background in public speaking, technical writing, open-source contribution, or community building.</li> <li>Relevant cloud or architecture certifications.</li> <li>A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, OR equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Important Note: </strong><em>At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p style="margin: 0in; font-family: Arial; font-size: 11.0pt;">Estimated Annual Salary: $214,000 -$336,000 OTE </p> <p style="margin: 0in; font-family: Arial; font-size: 11.0pt;">This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plan. title: System Engineer - Network Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Cloudflare's Network Engineering Team builds and runs the infrastructure that runs our software. The Engineering Team is split into two groups: one handles product development and the other handles operations. Product development covers both new features and functionality and scaling our existing software to meet the challenges of a massively growing customer base. The operations team handles one of the world's largest networks with data centers in 190 cities worldwide and a couple of large specialized data centers for internal needs.</p> <p>About the role</p> <p>Cloudflare operates a large global network spanning hundreds of cities (data centers). You will join a team of talented network automation engineers who are building software solutions to improve network resilience and reduce engineering operational toil.</p> <p>You will work on a range of tools, infrastructure and services - new and existing - with an aim to elegantly and efficiently solve problems and deliver practical, maintainable and scalable solutions. title: Hypotheekadviseur
description: Je eigen klantenportefeuille opbouwen, onafhankelijk adviseren en de vrijheid krijgen om jouw vak op jouw manier uit te oefenen. Voor een financieel dienstverlener in Zuid-Limburg zoekt Bommel Uitzendbureau een ervaren hypotheekadviseur die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt. Je helpt klanten bij belangrijke financiële keuzes: van hun eerste woning tot een complexere financiering. Daarbij kijk je verder dan de hypotheekaanvraag. Je leert klanten kennen, maakt mogelijkheden begrijpelijk en bouwt aan een relatie voor de lange termijn. De organisatie combineert de persoonlijke sfeer van lokale kantoren met de opleidingsmogelijkheden van een grotere financiële dienstverlener. De vestigingen zijn volop in ontwikkeling, waardoor jouw ideeën en initiatief direct kunnen bijdragen aan de groei. Wat je gaat doen · Je voert adviesgesprekken en vertaalt de persoonlijke situatie, wensen en financiële mogelijkheden van klanten naar passend hypotheekadvies; · Je adviseert over uiteenlopende woon- en financieringsvragen, van startershypotheken tot complexe financieringen; · Je begeleidt het volledige hypotheektraject, van de eerste inventarisatie tot het passeren bij de notaris; · Je bouwt een eigen klantenportefeuille op en onderhoudt langdurige relaties met bestaande en nieuwe klanten; · Je herkent commerciële kansen in de regio en zet deze om in nieuwe contacten en adviesgesprekken; · Je denkt actief mee over de ontwikkeling van de hypotheekdienstverlening en de groei van de vestigingen. Wat wij vragen · Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring als hypotheekadviseur en kunt zelfstandig klanten adviseren en dossiers begeleiden; · Je beschikt over de diploma’s Wft Basis, Wft Vermogen en Wft Hypothecair Krediet; · Je legt financiële onderwerpen helder uit en helpt klanten om weloverwogen keuzes te maken; · Je combineert een persoonlijke, klantgerichte aanpak met commercieel inzicht; · Je werkt zorgvuldig, neemt initiatief en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van jouw advies; · Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar. Wat wij bieden · Een salaris van € 3.120 tot € 5.304 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring; · Een zelfstandige adviesfunctie met vrijheid om je eigen klantenportefeuille op te bouwen en jouw aanpak vorm te geven; · Een betrokken team, korte lijnen en ruimte om mee te denken over de groei van de organisatie; · De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken; · 29 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen; · 8% vakantiegeld en een pensioenregeling waarbij de werkgever twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt; · Een reiskostenvergoeding, een fietsplan en de mogelijkheid om voordeliger te sporten; · Een introductieprogramma van drie dagen waarin je de organisatie en je collega’s leert kennen; · Vakgerichte opleidingen en mogelijkheden om aanvullende Wft-certificaten te behalen; · Onbeperkt toegang tot meer dan 200 onlinetrainingen voor jouw professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Ook dan maken we graag kennis met je. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Front Office Stagiaire
description: Als Front Office Stagiaire ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze gasten! Wanneer zij voor het eerst het hotel binnenkomen geef jij ze een warm welkom in het hotel en help je bij het inchecken. Meelopen naar de kamer? Ook leer je tijdens de stage meer over de administratieve handelingen en verwerk je binnenkomende reserveringen. Leonardo Hotel Papendrecht kent 87 moderne kamers en 10 volledig uitgeruste appartementen van ongeveer 100 m2. Ons hotel is het enige hotel in de Alblasserwaard en kent een klein, maar heel hecht team! Onze gasten hebben de mogelijkheid om Dordrecht en Rotterdam te bezoeken met de waterbus, over de Maas langs alle havens. Na een dagje sightseeing, een bezoek aan de Erasmusbrug of de bekende molens van Kinderdijk, kunnen onze gasten genieten van een heerlijke diner bij Chef’s! Food & Drinks. Deel jij jouw favoriete uitjes met onze gasten? WIE BEN JIJ? Jij bent op zoek naar een stage die aansluit bij jouw (hotel)opleiding. Hospitality zit in jouw bloed en je hebt een passie voor het vak. Samenwerken doe jij graag! Je bent een echte team-player. Jij bent flexibel beschikbaar en onregelmatig werken vind jij geen probleem. Jij beschikt goede kennis over de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Deze stage is beschikbaar per 4 januari 2027. WAT KRIJG JIJ VAN ONS (NAAST EEN FIJN TEAM NATUURLIJK)? Als MBO student ontvang jij een stagevergoeding gebaseerd op €750,- bruto per maand fulltime, die bestaat uit €670,- stagevergoeding en €80,- onkostenvergoeding. Wij hanteren variabele betalingsperiodes van 4 of 5 weken per keer, volgens het aantal gewerkte dagen en gewerkte uren. Dus de ene maand krijg je wat minder en de andere maand wat meer. title: Senior HR Adviseur
description: Maak impact op HR, organisatie en medewerkers Wil jij als Senior HR Advisor complexe HR-vraagstukken vertalen naar praktisch en toekomstgericht HR-beleid? Je bent een ervaren sparringpartner voor het HR-team en de business en draagt bij aan complexe HR-casuïstiek, organisatieontwikkeling en strategische HR-projecten. Je combineert een brede HR-expertise met een praktische aanpak. Van arbeidsrecht en verzuim tot HR-processen, beleid, data en systemen: jij weet wat er nodig is om onze HR-dienstverlening continu te verbeteren. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior HR Advisor : adviseer je over complexe HR-vraagstukken, arbeidsrecht, verzuim, arbeidsvoorwaarden en organisatieveranderingen; ondersteun je HR Business Partners en management bij individuele en collectieve HR-casuïstiek; draag je bij aan strategische HR-projecten rondom onder andere cultuur, organisatieontwikkeling, transformatie en HR-beleid; vertaal je HR-strategie en wet- en regelgeving naar duidelijke en werkbare processen en oplossingen; werk je samen met HR Operations aan een professionele en efficiënte HR-dienstverlening; analyseer en verbeter je HR-processen en systemen; zet je HR-data en technologie in om betere beslissingen en procesverbeteringen mogelijk te maken; werk je actief met HR-systemen zoals AFAS en kijk je verder dan alleen de gebruikerskant om processen slimmer in te richten. Wie ben jij? Je bent een ervaren HR-professional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie, advies en uitvoering. In cijfers: Een bruto salaris tussen €4.000,00 en €5.000,00 o.b.v. 40 uur per week (op basis van je ervaring); Een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé vinden wij belangrijk: 30 vakantiedagen per jaar en de mogelijkheid om meer bij te kopen; 8% vakantiegeld; Voor je eigen duurzaamheid: Maak gratis en onbeperkt gebruik van onze eigen sportruimte "The Box" op de Priva Campus, met diverse lessen in bijvoorbeeld CrossFit, Pilates en Spinning; Deelname aan de pensioenregeling van Priva; Opleidingsmogelijkheden via onze eigen Priva Academy. title: Inside Sales Representative
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London, the UK</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a critical sales role responsible for driving high-volume, high-velocity net new business acquisition sales in a remote selling model within the commercial segment across EMEA, specifically UKI. Operating as full-cycle territory owners similar to an AE, ISR manages the end-to-end sales process from self-sourcing pipeline, qualifying opportunities and closing deals in partnership with SE and Partner Organisation.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Build your own pipeline:</strong> Find new business across your assigned territory (UKI) through high-volume outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn and social selling, using tools like Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and AI outreach</li> <li><strong>Run the whole sales cycle remotely:</strong> Lead discovery and qualification calls using MEDDPIC, give engaging virtual presentations and live product demos, and negotiate and close new business against an ACV quota.</li> <li><strong>Explain the value of Cloudflare's platform:</strong> Connect commercial-segment customers' business and technical problems to the right Cloudflare products, such as Application Security and Performance, Zero Trust/SASE and the Developer Platform, and show the value they'd get.</li> <li><strong>Work closely with other teams:</strong> Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical validation, and with the Partner Organisation to co-sell and close deals faster. Work with Marketing and BDR teammates on campaigns and events that create pipeline.</li> <li><strong>Run your territory with data:</strong> Keep your Salesforce pipeline accurate and your forecasts reliable, track your activity and conversion numbers, and use what you learn to consistently meet or exceed your targets</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>1 - 3 years of experience in a sales role, preferably in SaaS or tech sales, such as: </li> <ul> <li>BDR/SDR background with strong outbound experience in a high-paced environment</li> <li>SMB or Transactional sales experience with high volume, high velocity sales motion</li> </ul> <li>Strong track record of meeting or exceeding quota </li> <li>Strong discovery and qualification skills using frameworks like BANT, MEDDIC </li> <li>Excellent presentation and interpersonal communication skills (verbal and written) as well as time management skill</li> <li>Experience using CRM like Salesforce, outbound/prospecting sales tools (e.g. LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesforce Sales Engagement Outreach etc)</li> <li>Tech-savvy and technically curious - quick to learn technical products, comfortable to run live demos independently, data-driven mindset  </li> <li>Highly accountable and self-driven, customer-centric individuals</li> <li>Multilingual abilities (depending on the coverage regions)</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Regional Vice President, Sales Benelux & Nordics
description: About Us At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale. We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry. More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale. About the role We're hiring a Regional Vice President in EMEA to own and lead our Benelux and Nordics business. You'll inherit a team of four quota-carrying enterprise AEs across two hubs: Amsterdam and Stockholm and be responsible for building the management layer, operating model and partner ecosystem that takes both the Benelux and Nordics regions from early traction to consistent, scaled revenue. This is a Director-level hire with second-line ambition. You'll report directly to the VP EMEA and operate with meaningful autonomy across pipeline, hiring, partner relationships and executive engagement. What you'll own Team leadership and performance Lead, develop and expand the Enterprise Sales teams across Benelux and Nordics from day one Run weekly pipeline reviews, deal coaching sessions and forecast calls with precision and consistency Identify and close performance gaps early: coach the team to close larger deals faster and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder cycles Build a culture of accountability and development; create clear career paths for senior individual contributors, including first-line management opportunities as the team scales Revenue Own the Benelux and Nordics regional number: quarterly and annual quota attainment across all two sub-regions Build and maintain a healthy pipeline that supports consistent delivery and predictable forecasting to VP EMEA and leadership Engage directly in strategic deals as executive sponsor, bringing credibility and commercial weight to enterprise negotiations Establish the region's strongest lighthouse accounts across key industry verticals, building referenceable wins that anchor LangChain's market position in the Benelux and Nordics regions Hiring Manage multiple open roles across Benelux and Nordics simultaneously: owning the full hiring lifecycle across pipeline, assessment, and closing Partner with the retained search firm and internal talent team to move at pace without compromising on quality Define the headcount profile for Benelux and Nordics regions beyond Q1 and feed into H2 planning, ensuring the team is built ahead of the revenue curve Partner ecosystem Owns hyperscaler and GSI/RSI relationships (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, and key SIs) across UKI, Nordics and Benelux Develop a structured partner motion that generates qualified pipeline and supports deal acceleration, reduces risk and drives expansion Represent LangChain at partner QBRs and executive engagements in region Market presence Represent LangChain as a keynote-ready leader at partner events, customer engagements, and industry conferences across the region: including KubeCon, Money20/20, Nordic AI summits and customer EBCs Build LangChain's brand with technical buyers, CIOs, and innovation leaders across Benelux and Nordics most important enterprise accounts Bring intelligence on the Benelux and Nordics markets back to the VP EMEA and product teams to inform roadmap and go-to-market positioning What we're looking for Experience 8+ years in enterprise SaaS sales, with at least 3 years in a regional or sub-regional leadership role managing quota-carrying AEs Demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding regional revenue targets across multiple quarters Experience managing teams across multiple countries and time zones, with the cultural intelligence to operate across Benelux and Nordics Background selling to technical buyers (engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams): you understand how developer tools get evaluated and adopted Experience in the AI, data, or developer tooling space strongly preferred; familiarity with the LangChain ecosystem is a meaningful plus Leadership You've run teams of 6+ AEs before and know the difference between managing and coaching You can hold a forecast conversation with a VP and a deal coaching session with an AE in the same afternoon and add value in both You hire well and fast. You know what good looks like for enterprise AE profiles and you can run structured hiring processes across four open roles simultaneously You've built or contributed to a partner motion before: you understand what "partner pipeline" means in practice, not just in theory Operating style You bias toward action. You don't wait for a playbook to be handed to you: you build it You're comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage scale. This is not a role with a fully defined motion; you'll shape a significant part of it You communicate clearly and directly, to your team and to leadership You're present in the market. You attend the right events, know the right people and build relationships that translate into pipeline and retention Compensation Philosophy: We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. title: Product Manager Soft Fabrics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Hunter Douglas is wereldwijd marktleider in raamdecoratie en een toonaangevende producent van architecturale producten. Wij zijn een merk dat u kent en vertrouwt. Met meer dan 100 jaar ervaring in innovatie hebben wij onze industrie mede vormgegeven met unieke producten die baanbrekend design en functionaliteit combineren. Onze producten zijn wereldwijd te vinden in miljoenen woningen en commerciële gebouwen. Wij zijn op zoek naar gedreven, intelligente, creatieve en ondernemende mensen. Door uitdagende functies en versnelde groeimogelijkheden te bieden, gedreven door een gezamenlijke ambitie om succesvol te zijn, creëren wij een omgeving waarin uw carrière zich verder kan ontwikkelen.</p> <p>In ruil voor uw expertise bieden wij een competitief en uitgebreid arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket, zodat u zich gewaardeerd voelt voor de bijdrage die u levert. Onze ambitie is om het snelst groeiende en meest geliefde raamdecoratiebedrijf ter wereld te worden. <em>Wat is uw ambitie?</em></p></div><p><strong>Product Manager Soft Fabrics</strong></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p>Wil jij bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van hoogwaardige stoffen die hun weg vinden naar klanten door heel Europa? Krijg je energie van de combinatie van productontwikkeling, commercie en projectmanagement? Dan is dit een mooie kans om als Product Manager Soft Fabrics onderdeel te worden van ons Product Team.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Jouw rol</strong></p> <p>Als Product Manager Soft Fabrics ben je verantwoordelijk voor het product en het commerciële succes van onze collecties voor gordijn- en meubelstoffen. Design is verantwoordelijk voor de creatieve ontwikkeling van de stoffen. Vanuit Product Management vertegenwoordig jij de markt-, klant- en businessbehoefte. Je brengt markt- en klantinzichten in en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke productbriefings en commerciële uitgangspunten. Vervolgens bewaak je samen met Design het ontwikkelproces en stuur je op een succesvolle productintroductie en optimale productlevenscyclus. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Sales, Marketing, Procurement, Supply Chain en het Design Team.</p> <p> </p> <p>Je combineert projectmanagement met commercieel inzicht, data-analyse en een passie voor textiel. Een veelzijdige rol waarin je veel verschillende mensen en disciplines bij elkaar brengt.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Wat ga je doen?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Je beheert het fabrics-portfolio gedurende de volledige productlevenscyclus, van concept tot uitfasering.</li> <li>Samen met Design vertaal je marktinzichten naar productbriefings en commerciële uitgangspunten voor nieuwe stoffen en collecties.</li> <li>Je coördineert productontwikkelingsprojecten van conceptfase tot marktintroductie, waarbij je samenwerkt met Design voor de ontwikkeling van nieuwe stoffen en collecties.</li> <li>Je bewaakt planning, voortgang, risico's, budget en afstemming tussen de verschillende betrokken teams.</li> <li>Je bent gedurende het ontwikkelproces een commerciële en strategische sparringpartner voor Design.</li> <li>Je analyseert markt-, klant- en verkoopdata en vertaalt inzichten naar kansen voor het portfolio.</li> <li>Je ondersteunt bij prijsstelling, productpositionering en businesscases.</li> <li>Je werkt samen met Sales en Marketing aan productintroducties, trainingen en commerciële tools.</li> <li>Je zorgt voor goede productinformatie en bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor interne en externe stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Dit breng jij mee</strong></p> <p>Je bent een junior/medior professional die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van het verbinden van mensen, ideeën en projecten. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante ervaring in bijvoorbeeld productmanagement, projectmanagement, category management of een vergelijkbare functie.</p> <p> </p> <p>Daarnaast heb je:</p> <ul> <li>Een hbo diploma in bijvoorbeeld Bedrijfskunde, Marketing, Textieltechnologie of een vergelijkbare richting.</li> <li>Sterke projectmanagement- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden.</li> <li>Commercieel inzicht en een klantgerichte instelling.</li> <li>Een analytische, data-gedreven manier van werken.</li> <li>Ervaring met het managen van meerdere projecten en stakeholders tegelijk.</li> <li>Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.</li> <li>Interesse in AI en de mogelijkheden om hiermee productiviteit, inzichten en bedrijfsprocessen te verbeteren.</li> <li>Ervaring binnen een productieomgeving, textiel, interieurproducten of een industriële omgeving is een pré.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Je bent georganiseerd, proactief en hands-on. Je houdt gemakkelijk overzicht, ook wanneer er verschillende belangen en deadlines spelen. Tegelijkertijd werk je graag samen en weet je anderen mee te krijgen in jouw aanpak.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Waarom deze rol?</strong></p> <p>Je komt terecht bij Artex in Aarle-Rixtel, maar bent deel van het Product Team van Hunter Douglas met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam. Hunter Douglas is een wereldwijd toonaangevende speler in raamdecoratie en architecturale producten, met meer dan 100 jaar ervaring in innovatie.</p> <p>Als Product Manager Soft Fabrics krijg je de ruimte om eigenaarschap te nemen, ideeën in te brengen en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de toekomst van ons stoffenportfolio. Je werkt samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en landen en hebt een belangrijke rol in het verbinden van design, commercie en productontwikkeling.</p> <p> </p> <p>Wil jij jouw ervaring inzetten in een rol waarin product, commercie en design samenkomen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <div><span style="font-size: 8pt;"><em>Door hieronder je sollicitatie in te dienen, geef je vooraf toestemming om sms-berichten te ontvangen om je op de hoogte te stellen van updates over de status van je sollicitatie en om gedurende je sollicitatieproces met je in gesprek te gaan. description: Functie Reliability engineer Beschrijving functie De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden. De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken. Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn. Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf. Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren. Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties. title: Security Architect
description: Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products. Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: Physical/embedded device security. OT (operational technology) network security. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines. What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. What you will be doing As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. Security standards, policies, and design patterns library Security architecture review process Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work. To succeed in this role: You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security " You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. In addition, you have the following technical expertise: Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries Zero trust architecture principles Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) The following competence is desired: OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) Container and Kubernetes security Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) What we offer you 💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 🏦 Excellent pension contribution . 🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. ⏰ Flexible working hours . 🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 🏋️ Free onsite gym . 🎉 Vibrant, open culture . description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with.
